jobs.title: GTM Operations, Agent Development (London)
jobs.description:
About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

What you’ll do

  • Support the business of Agent Development: Serve as the strategy and operations partner to Agent Dev leadership, and bring the same operational rigor to Agent Dev that powers our Sales organization.

  • Stand up the operating cadence: Partner with Agent Dev leaders to provide clear visibility into business health, including pipeline, deployment progress, utilization, expansion opportunities, and risks.

  • Operationalize best practices for enterprise agent deployment: Help define and scale the playbook for how Sierra builds, evaluates, launches, and expands AI agents at large enterprises.

  • Drive account expansion strategy: Work closely with account teams to identify whitespace, prioritize expansion opportunities, and build repeatable motions that convert post-sale momentum into durable revenue growth.

  • Turn insight into action: Analyze complex datasets and translate findings into clear, executive-ready recommendations that drive high leverage decisions.

  • Build internal tooling with AI: Leverage AI-native tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to build lightweight internal systems, automate workflows, and create operational leverage across Agent Dev.

What you’ll bring

  • 5-7 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or strategy and operations at top-tier technology companies.

  • Strong analytical rigor with the ability to work with large datasets and translate analysis into executive-ready insights and clear business actions.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting sales, post-sales, or commercial teams in a strategy and operations capacity.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-changing environments, with the ability to independently structure complex problems and drive them to resolution.

  • Commercial instinct and business judgment, with a clear understanding of how enterprise technology products are landed, deployed, and expanded.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor.

  • A growth mindset, coachability, and willingness to roll up your sleeves. No task is too small if it helps the team win.

Even better...

  • Technical fluency and coding comfort: You have built apps or internal tools before and can confidently use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to create production-ready internal solutions.

  • Previous 0-1 operating experience at a growth stage technology company.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Counsel - Regulatory (UK)
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Join our Regulatory Legal team, the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken's product offerings across the EU and UK and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. We're a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice – partnering directly with Compliance, Product, and senior leadership to keep our licensed entities running smoothly and our regulators well served.

You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on:

  • Product advice covering Payward's growing offerings in the UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things)

  • Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under the UK Cryptoasset Regime) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and

  • Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise

We're looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector).

This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK

 

The opportunity

  • Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions

  • Support the team's active licensing applications and other in-flight UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel

  • Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations)

  • Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities

  • Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., the UK Cryptoasset Regime, FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, operational resilience requirements (e.g., the FCA/PRA regime), outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business

  • Foster a culture of clarity, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk tradeoffs, and decision-ready recommendations

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, or equivalent)

  • 6+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution (e.g., a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, or crypto services provider) or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams

  • Direct experience supporting regulator engagement with the FCA (or equivalent regulator), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence

  • Substantive experience advising on the UK Cryptoasset Regime (i.e., FCA authorisation for regulated cryptoasset activities under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026)

  • Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the UK, including account-access and open banking obligations

  • Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations

  • Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime)

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one

 
 
 

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with the UK's onshored MiFID regime (as retained and modified under UK law, originally derived from EU MiFID II) and its application to investment services, including derivatives, equities, and emerging tokenised financial instruments

  • Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.description:
About the Team

The Enablement Lead (EL) team enables organizations to turn OpenAI products into real, sustained impact through world-class enablement and training execution.

Our mission is to help customers successfully adopt and operationalize AI across their organizations. We partner with enterprises to translate the potential of OpenAI’s technology into durable capability—through structured training, technical enablement, and scalable deployment programs.

By helping customers move from experimentation to production, the EL team accelerates time-to-value, deepens product adoption, and helps make OpenAI indispensable to how organizations work.

About the Role

The Enablement Lead, Knowledge Work is a specialist post-sales enablement role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. This role is responsible for designing and delivering enablement experiences that support a repeatable adoption framework, driving sustained activation, expanding breadth and depth of usage, and measurable business value across OpenAI’s product suite, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents.

This role blends strong product fluency, instructional design, and customer advisory. You will lead live workshops, deliver services, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from everyday business users to technical practitioners and executive leaders, helping customers understand not just what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them effectively in real world workflows.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches of new product capabilities, and helping customers translate product features into tangible outcomes across teams and business functions. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage by shaping how enablement drives measurable customer impact.

This role is based in London/Dublin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective enablement patterns that support adoption across business and technical teams within enterprise organizations.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated product areas, building deep expertise, supporting internal enablement, identifying emerging customer use cases for new product surfaces, and aggregating customer feedback to inform product development.

  • Lead customer enablement across the full customer lifecycle, from initial onboarding through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption.

  • Design and deliver high-impact engagements, including onboarding sessions, advanced capability trainings, executive briefings, hackathons, and hands-on workshops for audiences ranging from senior leaders to working teams.

  • Drive customer activation, sustained usage, and measurable business value through structured enablement programs designed for durable, organization-wide adoption.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Delivery Leads to drive adoption across our core product suite.

  • Develop and refine reusable training assets, playbooks, and best practices based on patterns observed across customers and regions.

  • Gather customer feedback from training and enablement engagements, synthesize themes across accounts, and relay insights to internal stakeholders to inform product and program improvements.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated product areas, building deep expertise, supporting internal enablement, identifying emerging customer use cases for new product surfaces, and aggregating customer feedback to inform product development.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in customer facing, enablement, or instructional roles, engaging C-level, business, and technical audiences in complex enterprise environments.

  • Possess exceptional presentation and communication skills, particularly when translating AI capabilities into clear, practical value for senior and executive level audiences.

jobs.title: Vil du være med i teamet vårt?
jobs.description:
Miljøarbeidertjenesten Stokmarknes har flere ledige stillinger:

• 4 stillinger mellom 34 til 80 % med for tiden kun nattarbeid. 2 stillinger har arbeid hver tredje helg, en stilling kun helg og de øvrige med arbeid hver annen helg.
• 7 stillinger mellom 36 og 76 % i for tiden to delt turnus med arbeid hver annen helg
• 13 stillinger med arbeid kun på helg i for tiden to delt turnus
Stillinger på helg passer også til deg som er student eller skoleelev.

Om oss:

Miljøarbeidertjenesten gir opplæringstjenester og praktisk bistand til personer med ulike funksjonshemminger, og personer med psykisk utviklingshemming.
Du bør like å jobbe selvstendig, men også i team. Du må kunne jobbe med utfordrende atferd. Det er ønskelig om du har erfaring fra å jobbe med utviklingshemming, men ikke et krav.
Vi ønsker oss engasjerte og faglig dyktige fagarbeidere som kan tilrettelegge og skape en god hverdag for våre beboere. Vi søker deg som vil sette livskvalitet i fokus. Vi har et godt fagmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige ansatte i tjenesten. Disse består av vernepleiere, sykepleier, miljøterapeuter, hjelpepleiere, helsefagarbeidere og miljøassistenter/pleiemedarbeidere. Det er gode muligheter for faglig utvikling hos oss.
Vi søker deg som har evne til å veilede og motivere beboere og medarbeidere og skape god dialog med pårørende. Tverrfaglig samarbeid med aktuelle samarbeidspartnere må påregnes.

Kvalifikasjoner

• Off. godkjent helsefagarbeider
• Annen relevant helse- og sosialfaglig utdanning kan også vurderes
• God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
• Gode ferdigheter i kommunikasjon og samhandling
• Ønskelig med førerkort klasse B
• God digital kunnskap
• Det kan åpnes også for at personer med annen relevant kompetanse og/eller med erfaring fra denne type arbeid, kan bli vurdert for stilling.

Personlige egenskaper

• Du må kunne samarbeide godt med leder, kolleger, beboere og deres pårørende
• Du må kunne jobbe systematisk og målrettet og følge avdelingens rutiner
• Du må være villig til å lære nye ting både gjennom opplæring og ulike nettkurs og andre kurs med fysisk oppmøte
• Du må kunne se, og se etter mulighetene og ressursene som bor i det enkelte mennesket
• Du må like å jobbe i et spennende miljø der ingen dager er like
• Du er lyttende og løsningsorientert, positiv og kreativ
• Fleksibilitet, «stå-på- vilje» og like varierte arbeidsdager
• At du med faglig tilnærming til aktuelle problemstillinger i tjenesten, setter beboerne i fokus
• At du har godt humør og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
• Er sterk psykisk og fysisk og liker faglige utfordringer

Vi tilbyr

• Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø
• Utviklende og spennende stilling der få dager er like
• Et godt fagmiljø med fokus på utvikling
• Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
• Flyttegodtgjørelse etter kommunens interne reglement

I disse stillingen har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje. Med pensjonsrett i KLP får du medlemspris og gunstige betingelser på en rekke bank, forsikring og spareprodukter.

Les mer her: https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt

Hadsel kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile kommunens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Hadsel kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.
Regjeringen har vedtatt nedskriving av studielån med kr 25.000,- pr. år innføres for enkelte kommuner i Norge. Hadsel kommune er omfattet av dette, under forutsetning av at en bor i kommunen.

Les mer mer: https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/ny-ordning-for-sletting-av-utdanningsgjeld-slik-vil-det-fungere/id3058902/

Språkkunnskaper

Norsk er arbeidsspråk i Hadsel kommune og som søker må du kunne snakke, lese og skrive så godt norsk at du både kan samarbeide med andre og utføre arbeidsoppgavene dine selvstendig.

Intervju

Kvalifiserte søkere vil bli innkalt til intervju.

Ansettelse

• Tilsettingen skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og avtaleverk
• Lønn etter avtale i forhold til utdanning og praksis.
• Politiattest uten bemerkning jf. Helse- og omsorgsloven § 5-4 må dokumenteres før signering av arbeidsavtale.

Offentlighet

Opplysninger om søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten, jf. Offentlighetslovens § 25.

Søknaden

Søknaden må inneholde søknadsbrev og CV, legg gjerne ved attester og vitnemål.
Referanser kan oppgis i søknaden.


Søknader sendes elektronisk ved bruk av "Søk her".


Velkommen som søker til Hadsel kommune - Et hav av muligheter! Vi ser frem til en søknad fra akkurat deg! Så hiv deg over tastaturet og søk jobb hos oss da vell


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Miljøarbeidertjenesten gir opplæringstjenester og praktisk bistand til personer med ulike funksjonshemminger og personer med psykisk utviklingshemming. Tjenesten består av følgende avdelinger: Miljøarbeidertjenesten Stokmarknes avd. 1 (inkludert avlastningsbolig) Miljøarbeidertjenesten Stokmarknes avd. 2 Miljøarbeidertjenesten Melbu avdeling 1 Miljøarbeidertjenesten Melbu avdeling 2 (inkludert Seljeveien aktivitetssenter)

jobs.title: Exterior Parts Design Engineer / Component Owner
jobs.description:
Company description:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Job description:

We are looking for an experienced Exterior Parts Design Engineer with minimum 3 years of automotive experience in the development of exterior body components and plastic parts. The role combines hands-on design responsibility with technical leadership of components and subsystems throughout the complete product development lifecycle.

In this role, you will act as Component Owner for assigned exterior components and subsystem areas throughout the entire product development process. You will be responsible for the design and development of exterior body parts such as bumpers, grilles, spoilers, trims, claddings, wheel arch moldings, and other related plastic components. A key part of the role involves creating and maintaining 3D CAD models and drawings in accordance with OEM standards and requirements.



You will lead technical activities and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of components and subsystems. This includes driving design reviews, risk assessments, technical problem-solving, and engineering decisions, while managing interfaces between exterior systems and the surrounding vehicle architecture.



You will also be responsible for planning and monitoring design activities, deliverables, timing, and maturity status for your assigned components. Working closely with suppliers, you will support development and industrialization activities, as well as engineering change management throughout the project lifecycle. In addition, you will participate in DFMEA, tolerance analysis, design verification, and validation activities to ensure robust and high-quality solutions.



As a key technical contact, you will regularly communicate project progress, technical status, and potential risks to customers and other project stakeholders, contributing to successful project execution and customer satisfaction.



Profile description:

To thrive and succeed in this role, we believe you have:


    Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or equivalent.
    3+ years of experience in automotive exterior component development.
    Strong knowledge of plastic component design and injection molding processes.
    Experience with automotive exterior systems and visible Class-A related components.
    Experience as Component Owner, Technical Lead or equivalent responsibility is highly meritorious.
    Proficiency in CATIA V5/V6, Creo, NX or similar CAD systems.
    Knowledge of GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and automotive product development processes.
    Experience coordinating suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams.



As a person

We are looking for a confident and engaging leader with a strong ability to build trust and manage relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. You are experienced in driving and leading technical activities forward, even without formal line management responsibility, and are motivated by achieving results through collaboration and influence. As a person, you are structured, proactive, and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to identify opportunities and address challenges effectively. You communicate fluently in English and can adapt your message to different audiences. Furthermore, you have a strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a focus on delivering high-quality results on time while keeping customer value and business needs at the forefront.

We offer:

At AVL, you will become part of a global engineering company at the forefront of development, simulation, and testing for the future of mobility. As the world's largest independent company in this field, with more than 12,000 employees worldwide, we drive innovation to create a greener, safer, and better mobility future.







Our expertise spans the entire value chain, from early concept and development phases through to industrialization and series production. We work with cutting-edge technologies in electrification, software, autonomous driving, digitalization, and energy-efficient powertrain systems, helping our customers shape the mobility solutions of tomorrow.







At AVL, you will find a workplace where you can grow, make an impact, and contribute to advancing technological innovation that truly makes a difference for the future of mobility.



Interested?







In this recruitment process, we apply continuous selection. This means that the recruitment process may move quickly, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

  





We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Personal Care Assistants for a 16-Year-Old Girl Living in Bromma
jobs.description:
Plusfamiljen är ett familjeägt assistansbolag som i närmare 20 år har stöttat människor med funktionsvariation att leva livet fullt ut – på sina egna villkor. Hos oss möter du värme, engagemang och en kultur där vi sätter både kunder och medarbetare först. Vårt uppdrag är att skapa en personlig och kvalitativ assistans där omtanke, professionalitet och engagemang går hand i hand. Att arbeta hos oss innebär att bli en del av något större – vi gör skillnad för människor som behöver det allra mest.

Personal Care Assistants for a 16-Year-Old Girl Living in Bromma

We are currently looking for a Personal Care Assistant to support an active 16-year-old girl who lives with her wonderful family in Bromma, Stockholm.

As a Personal Care Assistant, you will play an important role in creating a safe, supportive, and enjoyable everyday life based on her individual needs and abilities. You will provide active support in daily activities, play, and communication, while also assisting with all aspects of personal care, transfers, and mealtimes.

To be a good match for our client, you should be a positive, warm, calm, reliable, attentive, and patient person. You are proactive, able to read different situations, and comfortable working independently. We also appreciate someone who is creative and enjoys coming up with new activities and experiences. As our client is very active, it is essential that you do not have any physical limitations that would prevent you from keeping up with her daily activities.

We are looking for someone who wants to make a meaningful difference in another person's life over the long term. You should be responsible, compassionate, and responsive to the needs of others.

To apply for this position, you must:

    Be at least 18 years old.
    Be able to provide a criminal record extract.
    Provide two relevant references.

At the request of our client, we are only accepting applications from female candidates. As the family has a dog, applicants must not have a dog allergy.

Position Details

The position begins in early September and offers approximately 80% employment.

Working hours vary and include:

    Morning shifts: 2 mornings per week (7:00 AM–9:00 AM)
    Weekend shifts with varying hours:

    Daytime: 9:00 AM–2:30 PM
    Evening: 2:30 PM–9:00 PM

Additional hours are available during school holidays. Flexibility is appreciated, as there may occasionally be a need to cover extra shifts.

What We Offer

Many of our employees have been with us since our company was founded in 2006, something we are very proud of. We want our employees to enjoy their work and feel that what they do truly makes a difference. As a Personal Care Assistant, you play an invaluable role in another person's life—and often in the life of an entire family.

As part of our team, you will receive:

    A dedicated contact person—your manager—who will provide practical guidance and ongoing support.
    A collective bargaining agreement, ensuring both your current and future employment security.
    Occupational insurance and a wellness allowance.
    Training and support whenever needed.
    A fixed hourly salary.
    Holiday pay and evening/weekend supplements in accordance with the collective bargaining agreement.

We warmly welcome your application!

To learn more about us and why you should choose Plusfamiljen as your employer, please visit our website at www.plusfamiljen.se.

The application deadline is 31 September, but positions may be filled before this date.

If you have any questions, please contact the Client Manager at alexander@plusfamiljen.se.

    Contributing to both long-term strategy and hands-on operational initiatives.

Are You the Leader We're Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced IT leader who understands how technology can enable business success. You are equally comfortable discussing long-term strategy with senior stakeholders as you are rolling up your sleeves to solve operational challenges.

To succeed in this role, you likely have:

    A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
    Several years of experience within IT Infrastructure and Security.
    Experience driving modernization, transformation, and operational excellence initiatives.
    Strong knowledge of Information Security principles and best practices.
    Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international or/and decentralized environment.
    Experience leading projects and cross-functional initiatives.
    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
    Fluent in Swedish and English both written and spoken.
    Permanent authorization to work in Sweden.

It is considered an advantage if you have:

    Experience with mergers and acquisitions, including IT integration projects.
    Experience with cloud platforms and modern workplace technologies, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.

About you:

You are a business-oriented and collaborative leader who thrives on translating technology into business value. While you are comfortable setting strategic direction, you are equally willing to engage in operational challenges when needed. Your ability to build trust, foster collaboration, and navigate the balance between global standardization and local requirements enables you to successfully drive change in an international environment.

In this recruitment process, Cibes Lift Group is partnering with Jefferson Wells. You will be employed directly by Cibes Lift Group.



Apply by clicking "Ansök nu" in the advertisement. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.

For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact:

Marjo Carlson, recruitment consultant; 070 377 06 64, marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se

Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than September 25, 2026. Selection and interviews are conducted on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

Welcome to Cibes Lift Group and the opportunity to make a real impact on the future of Infrastructure & Security.

Cibes Lift Group is one of the world's most innovative manufacturers of space-saving lifts designed for fast and easy installation, also offering a wide range of conventional lift solutions. Thanks to the wide range of lift products and a flexible design concept, the lift solutions of Cibes Lift Group adapt to the requirements of public, commercial, and private settings. Sales, installation, and maintenance services are provided by a global network of subsidiaries and partners. The company group is headquartered in Gävle, Sweden, and has production facilities in Sweden, Poland, China, and USA. jobs.title: Familieterapeut
jobs.employer: BUFETAT NORD LOFOTEN OG VESTERÅLEN FAM VERN  KTR
jobs.description:
Om stillingen og arbeidsstedet

Ved Lofoten og Vesterålen familievernkontor har vi nå ledig en fast 100 % stilling som familieterapeut. Stillingen har fast kontorsted i Svolvær.

Familievernet gir tilbud til familier, par og barn som selv oppsøker tjenesten med ulike typer relasjons problemer. Tjenestetilbudet består av familie- og parterapi, grupper, kurs og bistand til foreldresamarbeid der foreldrene ikke bor sammen. Familievernet utfører også lovpålagt mekling mellom foreldre med formål om å hjelpe dem med å finne gode løsninger for barn etter samlivsbrudd. 

Lofoten og Vesterålen familievernkontor har hovedkontor på Stokmarknes og et fast utekontor i Svolvær med to stillinger. Kontoret har til sammen 6,5 stillinger og dekker kommunene i Lofoten og Vesterålen, med et samlet innbyggertall på om lag 54 000.

Som familieterapeut hos oss blir du en del av et engasjert og kompetent fagmiljø. Sammen med dyktige kollegaer får du bidra til det vi mener er et av samfunnets viktigste oppdrag – å skape gode rammer for vekst og utvikling for barn, unge og familier.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet bestå av:

  • terapi og rådgivning for familier, par og enkeltpersoner med samlivs- og relasjonsutfordringer
  • mekling for foreldre etter ekteskapsloven og barneloven
  • foreldresamarbeid og -veiledning
  • kurstilbud for ulike målgrupper i vårt område
  • utadrettet og forebyggende arbeid
  • deltakelse i fagutviklingsarbeid
  • støttet tilsyn 

Noe reisevirksomhet samt andre arbeidsoppgaver må påregnes.


Hvilken bakgrunn har du?

Du må ha:

  • minimum treårig høgskole/universitetsutdanning, gjennomført bachelor eller tilsvarende 180 stp. innen sosialfag
  • relevant videreutdanning tilsvarende 60 stp., fortrinnsvis i familieterapi
  • relevant erfaring fra terapeutisk arbeid
  • gode kliniske ferdigheter
  • god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne på norsk
  • god IT-kompetanse

Det er også ønskelig at du har erfaring fra:

  • samarbeid med andre instanser
  • barnesamtaler
  • arbeid med vold i nære relasjoner
  • å holde kurs

Det er også ønskelig at du har førerkort kl. B.


Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • møter mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner med respekt, trygghet og forståelse
  • har et sterkt engasjement for par- og familiearbeid og er motivert for faglig utvikling og nye utfordringer
  • samarbeider godt med andre, samtidig som du arbeider selvstendig og tar ansvar for egne oppgaver
  • er åpen for veiledning, refleksjon og faglige innspill
  • trives i et lite fagmiljø og bidrar aktivt til et godt faglig og sosialt fellesskap
  • arbeider strukturert og systematisk, samtidig som du er fleksibel, kreativ og løsningsorientert

Hva får du hos oss?
  • Stillingen er plassert i statlig lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 1173 klinisk sosionom, 1496 klinisk barnevernpedagog, 1534 spesialutdannet miljøterapeut, 1185 spesialutdannet sosionom eller 1510 spesialutdannet barnevernpedagog, p.t. kr 620 000 - 720 000 pr. år. 
  • Lønn og stillingskode vurderes etter utdanning og erfaring. 
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode låne-, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger (http://spk.no). Fra lønnen trekkes 2 % pensjonsinnskudd.

I tillegg til dette kan vi også tilby:

  • mulighet til å trene i arbeidstiden i inntil en time i uka
  • kantinetilbud og tilgang til treningsrom
  • fleksibel arbeidstid innenfor bestemte rammer
  • kurs og kompetanseheving
  • gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • et engasjert og godt fagmiljø der du vil ha gode støttespillere i arbeidshverdagen
  • varierte, spennende og givende arbeidsoppgaver

I tillegg til dette får du være med på å løfte oss slik at vi kan gi barn, unge og familier et enda bedre tilbud, og det mener vi har en stor verdi i seg selv.


Opplysninger til deg som søker
  • Vi søker etter de best kvalifiserte kandidatene uavhengig av kulturell bakgrunn, alder, hull i CV eller funksjonsevne, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss.
  • Stillingen er for tiden lagt til Lofoten og Vesterålen familievernkontor, kontorsted Svolvær.
  • Politiattest må fremlegges ved ansettelse, jf. Familievernkontorloven § 2 a, og forskrift om politiattest § 7. Denne attesten skal ikke legges ved søknaden.
  • Du kan be om å ikke bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Dette må i så fall begrunnes. Vi kontakter deg dersom ønsket ditt ikke tas til følge.
  • Prøvetid i henhold til statsansatteloven.
  • Du må oppgi minimum to referanser av faglig relevans og nyere dato.

Opplever du tekniske utfordringer når du fyller ut søknaden, anbefaler vi at du tar kontakt med teknisk support hos Grade Jobbnorge.


Hva skal søknaden din inneholde?

For å bli vurdert som søker må du fylle ut feltene for utdannelse og arbeidserfaring, samt legge ved relevante vitnemål og attester med bekreftet stillingsstørrelse.

Vitnemål for utdanning tatt i Norge skal lastes opp fra Vitnemålsportalen. 

Har du utdanning fra utlandet må du legge ved godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Barne-, ungdoms- og familieetatens fem regioner har som hovedoppgave å drive etatens institusjoner og familievernkontor. 

I tillegg har regionene ansvar for fosterhjemsrekruttering og oppgaver knyttet til adopsjon. 

Barn, unge og deres familie skal få riktig hjelp til rett tid uansett hvor de bor i Norge. 

Bufetat sine fem regioner​ rapporterer til Barne-, ungdoms- og familiedirektoratet som er underlagt Barne- og familiedepartementet.

jobs.title: Teamleader tankstation - Vast contract
jobs.description:
Klaar voor de volgende stap in de retail? Heb jij leidinggevende ambities, hou je van afwisseling en passen flexibele werkuren perfect in jouw privéleven? Dan is deze uitdaging iets voor jou!

Als teamleader ben je de rechterhand van de stationmanager en zorg je er samen met het team voor dat alles vlot verloopt. Afhankelijk van de grootte van het station neem je verantwoordelijkheid op binnen de shop, het restaurant, de administratie of een combinatie van deze domeinen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je ondersteunt de stationmanager in de dagelijkse werking
  • Je stuurt collega's aan en begeleidt nieuwe medewerkers tijdens hun opleiding
  • Je stelt de personeelsplanning op en voert evaluatiegesprekken
  • Je beheert bestellingen, facturen en administratieve opvolging
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de shop en/of het restaurant steeds vlot en efficiënt draaien
  • Geen enkele dag is dezelfde: je krijgt een gevarieerd takenpakket met veel verantwoordelijkheid én ruimte om initiatief te nemen

Praktisch:

  • Voltijdse functie van 36 uur per week
  • Flexibel uurrooster met shiften tussen 04.30 uur en 22.15 uur
  • Afwisselend vroege, dag- en late shiften
  • Je ontvangt je planning steeds ruim op voorhand, zodat je werk en privé goed kan combineren
  • Flexibel uurrooster, weekendwerk of werken op feestdagen is voor jou geen probleem
  • Eigen vervoer is belangrijk om tot aan het station te geraken

jobs.title: SERVICE ADVISOR
jobs.description:
Manpower Office People is specialist in de rekrutering van bediendeprofielen. Wij gaan steeds voor de ‘perfecte match’ tussen werkgever en sollicitant! Voor onze klant zijn wij op zoek naar een SERVICE ADVISOR.
Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van klantencontact én een passie heeft voor wagens? Dan kan deze functie als SERVICE ADVISOR jou op het lijf geschreven zijn. Je komt terecht bij een gevestigde speler binnen de mobiliteitswereld waar kwaliteit, service en teamwork centraal staan. Je werkt in een moderne omgeving waar klanten elke dag rekenen op de expertise van een SERVICE ADVISOR voor een vlekkeloze dienstverlening.
 


Jobomschrijving

Wat ga je doen als SERVICE ADVISOR?

  • Je verwelkomt klanten en luistert actief naar hun vragen rond onderhoud, herstellingen en facturatie.
  • Je plant afspraken in en volgt dossiers nauwkeurig op via telefoon en e-mail.
  • Je stelt offertes op, verwerkt werkorders en stemt af met leasingmaatschappijen.

jobs.title: Truck and Heavy Equipment Technician/builder
jobs.description:
The Truck and Heavy Equipment Technicians / Builders will be responsible for building, maintaining, assembling, and repairing custom truck bodies, trailers, and heavy machinery in our modern workshops.

This position provides an excellent balance of technical variety, combining precise welding/assembly with electrical, hydraulic, and finishing tasks.

Blueprint Interpretation & Execution: Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical drawings/blueprints, and independently execute the build from start to finish.

1.Welding & Assembly

  • Perform high-quality construction and assembly work customized for heavy trucks and trailers.
  • Conduct full preparatory duties independently, including cutting plates, drilling holes, bending metals, and sawing tubes/profiles.
  • Execute precise semi-automatic (MIG/MAG) welding to structurally secure assemblies onto vehicle chassis.
  • Perform final technical assembly of all painted components and auxiliary parts onto the vehicle after coating is completed by colleagues.

2.Electrical Systems

  • Integrate and connect advanced machinery, including heavy-duty truck-mounted cranes, container systems, and lifting gear to the main truck chassis.
  • Complete comprehensive electrical connections from end-to-end (A to Z), matching specific project requirements from basic prep-wiring to complete, complex electronic installations.
  • Perform post-installation diagnostics, systematic testing, fault-finding, and troubleshooting to resolve any electrical complications.

3.Hydraulic Systems

  • Install and connect complete hydraulic circuits from end-to-end directly onto trucks and heavy machinery.
  • Independently bend heavy-duty piping and compress/press high-pressure hydraulic flexible hoses.
  • Conduct operational quality checks, pressure tests, and error detection to safely identify and repair fluid leaks or system failures.

4.Spray Painting / Preparation

  • Occasionally assist with necessary surface preparation when required, including degreasing, sanding, and filling components or complete structural assemblies

jobs.title: Demi Chef de Partie Koude keuken / Hulpkok
jobs.employer: LA BUTTE AUX BOIS LANAKEN NV
jobs.description:
Ter ondersteuning van het keukenteam van Bistrôt Le Ciel onder leiding van Executive Chef, Pieter Beurskens, zijn we momenteel op zoek naar een Demi Chef de Partie en Hulpkok

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het werk dat je is toevertrouwd door de chef, in deze functie is dat gericht op de koude keuken of als hulpkok waarbij je nog meer taken krijgt toevertrouwd

  • Je helpt bij de mise-en-place van gerechten

  • Je wast, schilt, en versnijdt alle ingrediënten

  • Je bereidt garnituren, koude sauzen, voor- en nagerechten, salades, …

  • Je dresseert en werkt volgens de instructies van de chef

  • Je ziet toe op de kwaliteit, smaak en visuele presentatie van de borden

  • Je zorgt voor de hygiënische bewaring van voedingsmiddelen

  • Je maakt werkinstrumenten en je werkplek schoon en staat in voor orde en netheid in de keuken

  • Je respecteert veiligheidsnormen tijdens de werkzaamheden

Als hulpkok krijg je uiteraard meer taken toevertrouwd.

Werken in de keuken moet je energie geven en je bent iemand die goed onder stressvolle omstandigheden kan presteren en rustig blijft tijdens drukke shifts

Ervaring is minder belangrijk dan de wil om door te zetten en kwaliteit te leveren. Je moet bereid zijn om 4 lange dagen te werken waarbij de planning soms kan schuiven maar je zeker zaterdag beschikbaar moet zijn.

La Butte aux Bois is 's avonds moeilijk bereikbaar met openbaar vervoer, eigen vervoer is aangewezen

We zoeken toegewijde mensen die 4 dagen een lange shift willen doen en ook op feestdagen en in weekends willen meedraaien.

Ben jij de persoon die:

  • Gedreven is en gestructureerd werkt?

  • Stressbestendig is en onder druk kan werken?

  • Graag in een team werkt en leergierig is?

  • Gepassioneerd is om de verwachtingen van onze gasten te overtreffen?

  • De puntjes graag op de ‘i’ zet?

jobs.title: All round technician
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take up technical challenges in a dynamic, high-tech, and interdisciplinary environment? Would you like to join a fast-growing team and play a key role in shaping the future of our technology and company? Then please send us your application! To strengthen our team, we are looking for a skilled and resourceful individual.

THE JOB

In this role, you will first learn to understand the working of the equipment of Molecular Plasma Group. Then you will be responsible for the lab equipment of Molecular Plasma Group and if needed also to build and/or repair this. In a later phase, you will assist with the installation and servicing of Molecular Plasma Group’s equipment at customer sites. This will require only a limited portion of your time, less than 10%. As on of the first persons in this role at Molecular Plasma Group, you will have the opportunity to establish the job and define the service workflow based on your experience.

THE TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Arranging and assembling the MPG machines, including mechanical and electrical setup of new plasma equipment, supporting acceptance tests and approval on customer site.

• Support in engineering projects

• Maintaining the R&D plasma machines in the Molecular Plasma Group lab. Ensuring that all equipment is available for testing by the scientific team. This includes daily cleaning of the atomizers and setting of the machines.

• Organize the refilling of the cartridges, including shipping to the end customer.

• Arranging the installation, including the mechanical and electrical set up of new customer equipment, supporting the acceptance testing and sign-off at the customer site.

• Installing and connecting electrical components (power supply, controls, motors, PLCs, etc.).

• Reading, interpreting and updating electrical diagrams and installation drawings.

• Performing test procedures and functional checks of our machine.

• Diagnosing malfunctions and performing repairs.

• Define the spare parts needed for machine maintenance from a service perspective, provide feedback on design related issues with ease of maintenance and report any feedback to engineering for improvement.

• Provide input for and/or ensure a good setup of the service organization.

• Organize 3D printing activities.

WHY WORK FOR US

In this challenging role, you get the opportunity to build the new organisation, travel the world (up to 10%), supporting our customers in their operations in the cold plasma technology. We offer flexibility in shaping the role as needed and fitting your skills. Next to that, you will get:

• A good salary depending on your background and knowledge.

• 20 holidays per year + 12 ATV days.

• Laptop and mobile phone.

• Meal vouchers.

• A chance to join dynamic, and growing team, with the opportunity to develop yourself.

THE ALL-ROUNDER TECHNICIAN JOB REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:

Relevant technical education or bachelor level (mechanical, electrical, or related field), combined with at least 2 years of experience in a comparable role. You will recognize in yourself:

  • A hands-on mentality, independent, pro-active, solution-driven and eager to learn.
  • Experience in assembly or testing of high-tech equipment is an advantage.
  • Flexibility and ability to cope with the dynamics of a start-up environment.
  • basic knowledge on warehouse
  • Affinity with programming (Labview, others) is a great added value.
  • Support the colleagues in the laboratory.
  • Being able to build good relations with customers.

jobs.title: DigiTribe - Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
The Azure Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Azure platform services to provide a secure, scalable, and resilient cloud foundation for the organisation. The role ensures platform reliability, security, governance, and operational excellence through automation, Infrastructure as Code, and standardized cloud services. Acting as a key liaison between operations, architects, security teams, and application owners, the engineer translates business and technical requirements into enterprise-grade Azure platform capabilities. All Azure resources, configurations, and platform services must be deployed and managed exclusively through TerraForm and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring consistency, compliance, and repeatability across all environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, operate, and continuously improve the Microsoft Azure platform, ensuring a secure, scalable, and resilient cloud foundation for application and product teams.
  • Deploy, manage, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services using Infrastructure as Code (TerraForm), ensuring all resources are fully automated, version-controlled, and reproducible.
  • Develop and maintain Azure Landing Zones, governance frameworks, platform standards, and reusable cloud services aligned with enterprise architecture principles.
  • Monitor platform health, performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency while performing troubleshooting, patching, capacity management, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Collaborate with cloud architects, security teams, DevOps teams, and application owners to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable cloud services.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, GitOps practices, automation frameworks, and platform engineering capabilities to improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Manage and optimize Azure networking, connectivity, private access patterns, DNS, and hybrid integration services between Azure and enterprise environments.
  • Ensure compliance with security, governance, backup, disaster recovery, regulatory, and operational standards across the Azure platform.
  • Manage Azure identity, authentication, authorization, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Managed Identities, and identity governance controls.
  • Operate and maintain core Azure platform services including networking, Storage, compute, container platforms, monitoring, security services, and platform management tooling.
  • Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, documentation, self-service capabilities, and platform engineering best practices.
  • Support incidents, problems, changes, service requests, and root cause investigations while maintaining agreed service levels and operational excellence.
  • Provide technical guidance and enablement to engineering teams consuming Azure platform services.
  • Enforce the principle that all Azure deployments, configurations, and modifications are performed exclusively through TerraForm and approved CI/CD deployment pipelines, with no manual changes permitted in production environments.
  • Promote cloud security best practices, Zero Trust principles, and operational resilience across the Azure estate.
-

jobs.title: Commercieel bediende (vakantieverhuur)
jobs.description:
Word jij ons vrolijke gezicht van de vakantiepret?

Voor een immokantoor in Oostduinkerke zoeken wij een commercieel bediende vakantieverhuur. Van gezellige strandhuisjes tot luxe appartementen met uitzicht op zee.

 

Wat ga je doen:

• Als commercieel medewerker verhuur ben je de held(in) die potentiële huurders met open armen ontvangt (figuurlijk dan, hè!).

• Je bent een ster in het verkopen van dromen - je vertelt vol passie over de accommodaties, de omgeving en alle leuke dingen die Oostduinkerke te bieden heeft.

• Geen boeking is jou te veel! Je regelt reserveringen, beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail of social media, en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt.

• Je zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het volledige proces van de verhuur, waarbij je alles nauwgezet zal opvolgen en je schouders zet onder het project van opstart tot het opstellen van de reservatie.

• Ook na de boeking sta je paraat. Je controleert de schoonmaak (indien nodig verzorg jij de finishing touch) en zorgt ervoor dat de gasten zich welkom voelen vanaf het moment dat ze binnenkomen.

 

Praktische zaken neem jij er met plezier bij.

• Iemand met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en een sprankelende persoonlijkheid. Jij bent het zonnetje in huis!

• Een geboren verkoper die moeiteloos iedereen weet te overtuigen.

• Je bent een kei in multitasken en houdt het hoofd koel, zelfs als het druk is.

• Ervaring in de toerisme-, horeca- of verhuurbranche is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Als je maar barst van de motivatie!

• Zaterdag werken vormt voor jou geen probleem.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - PV & BESS Projects (remote work)
jobs.description:

Bright Watt Partners is an innovative EPC company delivering renewable energy projects across six European countries. They specialize in new installations, repowering services, and eco-friendly component recycling. By using their own machinery and in-house workforce, they ensure complete control over quality and scheduling.

- Securing large-scale PV, BESS, and PV+BESS projects in Europe for implementation through EPC contracts, construction, or strategic partnerships, - Actively seeking out new projects, analysing the market and developers' pipelines, and reaching out to project owners, developers, and investors, - Leveraging an extensive network of business contacts in at least one of the following markets: Germany, Ireland, Denmark, or Sweden, to secure new projects and partnerships, - Managing business opportunities from initial contact, through qualification and negotiations, to securing the project and closing the deal, - Building and developing a strong project pipeline and continuously monitoring their status, potential, and opportunities for collaboration, - Evaluating projects from a commercial and business perspective and collaborating with technical teams

Requirements:
- College degree; - 2 years of professional experience; - Excellent negotiation and communication skills, excellent interpersonal skills, the ability to work independently, and a results-oriented mindset; - Excellent command of English; - Experience in acquiring new projects and developing the pipeline, from initial contact to a concrete business opportunity; - Experience in Business Development, Project Origination, Sales, or Project Development, preferably in renewable energy, the energy sector, or construction; - An extensive network of contacts in the German, Irish, Danish, or Swedish markets, particularly among developers, IPPs, investors, and project owners; - Good knowledge of the renewable energy market and large-scale PV and/or BESS projects.

How to apply

Language of the documents that should be submitted: English
Whom documents should be sent to: Directly to the employer
Where documents should be sent: email: marta.oliwia.wozniak@brightwattpartners.com

jobs.title: Jeugdwelzijnswerker OverKop/JAC Ninove
jobs.description:
Je bent aanwezig tijdens de vrije ontmoetingsmomenten in OverKop en legt op een laagdrempelige manier contacten met jongeren. Je bent vlot aanspreekbaar voor iedereen en participeert in de dagelijkse werking. Vanuit die aanwezigheid detecteer je hulpvragen bij de jongeren, gaat met hen in gesprek en vormt op die manier de brug naar maatgerichte ondersteuning en hulpverlening.

Je komt terecht in de teamwerking van OverKop Ninove, JAC Ninove en De Knoop Ninove.

Als outreachende JAC-medewerker neem je volgende taken op:

- Je bent samen met je collega jeugdwelzijnswerker vanuit vzw Habbekrats verantwoordelijk voor de openingsmomenten van het OverKop-huis. Er zijn minimaal twee openingsmomenten per week.
- Je zorgt ervoor dat het OverKop-huis een veilige en toegankelijke plaats is voor jongeren.
- Je zet actief en outreachend in op bekendmaking van en toeleiding naar het OverKop-huis en De Knoop. Hiervoor werk je vooral samen met de scholen in Ninove.
- Je bent een luisterend oor voor de jongeren, zowel op straat, als in OverKop als in het JAC en zet in op een vertrouwensband.
- Je werkt een aanbod uit rond vrije tijd en mentaal welzijn.
- Je zet je in voor een positieve groepsdynamiek.
- Je kent het welzijnslandschap van de regio en verwijst de jongeren door naar een aanbod dat aansluit bij hun noden.
- Je werkt nauw samen met je collega van OverKop en zorgt samen actief voor de uitbouw van een verbindende overlegstructuur en afstemming met lokale samenwerkingspartners (onderwijs, welzijn, vrije tijd…). De Knoop Ninove is hierbij een belangrijke partner.

- Je hebt een diploma hoger onderwijs (bachelor of graduaat) in een menswetenschappelijke richting (zoals toegepaste psychologie, orthopedagogie of sociaal werk).
- Je hebt ervaring, kennis en inzichten in het werken met en voor jongeren in maatschappelijk kwetsbare positie. Bij voorkeur heb je een eerste ervaring in de hulpverlening.
- Je hebt een hart voor en een sterke affiniteit met kinderen en jongeren en hun context.
- Je werkt vanuit een ervaringsgerichte en outreachende aanpak: je gaat dus op een laagdrempelige, wervende en empowerende manier aan de slag met jongeren en collega’s. Je voelt je comfortabel om je in de leefwereld van jongeren te begeven.
- Je kan verbinding maken met jongeren, vrijwilligers en lokale partners. Je bent daarbij respectvol, diplomatisch en constructief kritisch.
- Je schrikt er niet voor terug om zelf het heft in handen te nemen en autonoom je takenpakket vorm te geven in samenspraak met je directe collega en teamverantwoordelijke. Bij CAW Oost-Vlaanderen staan engagement, duidelijkheid, verantwoordelijkheid, een lerende mindset, impact en innovatie centraal. Vanuit deze principes gaan we aan de slag.
- Je stelt je flexibel op en bent indien nodig bereid tot avondwerk en uitzonderlijk tot weekendwerk. Ook werken tijdens de schoolvakanties is voor jou geen probleem.
- Je kan je goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Franstalige gesprekken schrikken je niet af.
- Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B.

jobs.title: Verantwoordelijke Hotel Brugge
jobs.description:
Jij bent hét gezicht van Sleep & Go in Brugge.

Je ontvangt gasten met een warme glimlach en staat in voor een vlotte werking van de vestiging. Je combineert operationele receptietaken met coördinerende en administratieve verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorg jij ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt – van de eerste check-in tot de wekelijkse rapportage.

Liefst ben je zo vrij als een zelfstandige, maar binnen de zekerheid van loondienst. Het beste van die 2 werelden heb je bij ons!

Je kan rekenen op je collega’s van onze hoofdzetel om jou te assisteren bij administratieve opvolgingen en uitdagingen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Gastvrij onthaal: Je verwelkomt gasten aan de receptie, beheert sleutels en handelt administratie rond contracten en betalingen correct af. De receptie is geopend van 9u-10u en 16u-20u.
  • Dagelijkse werking: Je ziet toe op de werking van de residentie, volgt procedures nauwgezet op en bewaakt een efficiënte werkstroom. Dat betekent dat jij zorgt dat alles logisch en vlot verloopt: planningen zijn duidelijk, taken worden goed verdeeld en onverwachte situaties los je snel op zonder dat de rest stilvalt.
  • Operationele controles: Je inspecteert de hotelkamers en zorgt dat alles in orde is bij aankomst en vertrek van gasten.
  • Coördinatie team: Je stelt planningen op en stuurt je schoonmaakploeg en klusjesmannen bij.
  • Flexibiliteit: Je ben bij noodgevallen beschikbaar voor je gasten.
  • Administratie & rapportage: Je beheertgroepsboekingen, en rapporteert wekelijks over de werking van de vestiging aan het management.
  • Stockbeheer: Je zorgt voor een tijdige aanvulling van stockbeheer denk aan linnen, kleerkasten, lepels, tassen...
  • Je hebt een talenknobbel. Frans, Nederlands, Engels,... je spreekt deze talen vloeiend.
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk ingesteld en barst van energie, vooral omdat je zo graag zelfstandig werkt.
  • Wij bieden een studio in ons gebouw aan. Verhuizen is uiteraard een vereiste.
  • Jij hebt een klantgerichte houding en streeft altijd naar positieve recensies.
  • Je bent flexibel naar permanentie toe en bereid om ook in het weekend te werken.

jobs.title: DevSecOps Security Analyst | Vacancy Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building secure cloud environments and embedding security into every stage of software delivery? In this role, you will help shape a security-first culture by integrating security into development processes, strengthening cloud environments, and enabling teams to deliver resilient applications at scale.

What you'll do

  • You design, build and maintain automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Working closely with development, cloud and operations teams, you help implement security-by-design practices across AWS and Azure environments.
  • You assess cloud security posture, identify risks and lead remediation efforts to improve compliance with security frameworks and benchmarks.
  • You support the security of containerized platforms and infrastructure-as-code solutions by promoting secure configurations and automation.
  • You provide expertise on secure coding standards, DevSecOps tooling and application security practices, helping teams strengthen their security maturity.
  • By monitoring key security indicators and supporting incident investigations, you contribute to the continuous improvement of Luminus' cyber resilience.
     

What you bring

  • Proven experience in DevSecOps, cloud security or application security, with a strong understanding of CI/CD environments and security automation.
  • Experience working with security technologies such as SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management solutions, Terraform and software supply chain security practices.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud and container technologies, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and related security concepts.
  • Your understanding of application security principles, OWASP guidelines and vulnerability management enables you to identify and address security risks effectively.
  • A collaborative mindset that allows you to work effectively with developers, cloud experts, project teams and external partners.
  • Professional proficiency in English and fluency in Dutch and/or French.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About you and this role

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.

We now have an exciting opportunity for a Senior R&D Specialist – Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in Seneffe, Belgium.

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.

Responsibilities

  • Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges.
  • Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities.
  • Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology.
  • Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance.
  • Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving.
  • Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community.
  • Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.

Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR.
  • Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis.
  • Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges.
  • Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.

Additional Notes

  • This position does not offer relocation assistance
  • Please submit your application in English to be eligible for consideration in the selection process.

Benefits – What Dow offers you

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

  • Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
  • Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
  • Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.
    • Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
  • Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
    • Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
  • Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
  • Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
  • Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
  • Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
  • Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
  • Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
  • Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
  • On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
  • Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

jobs.title: CE Distribution Driver
jobs.description:
As a CE driver, you carry out regional distribution runs and deliver goods safely, accurately and with a strong focus on customer service to a wide range of customers.

You will join a growing transport company specialised in national distribution. Safety, reliability and customer focus are key. You can count on clear agreements, personal guidance and a working environment where drivers are valued.

You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck. You carry out distribution runs for various customers and are given the necessary independence and responsibility. The planning team provides clear structure, and you have fixed points of contact you can turn to with any questions.

- You carry out regional or national distribution runs for a variety of customers.
- You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck.
- You transport goods safely and professionally.
- You follow the schedule and ensure punctual deliveries.
- You communicate with customers in a friendly and professional manner.
- You take responsibility for your routes and equipment.
- You can count on support from the planning team and HR.
- You receive internal training and guidance from experienced colleagues and coaches.

You work from Monday to Friday. You start each day between 4:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m., depending on your route schedule. - Vaardigheden:
You are customer-oriented and punctual.
You take responsibility while on the road.
You have a flexible and professional attitude.
You preferably live within a 20-kilometre radius of Desteldonk.
You enjoy working independently and value clear agreements.

- Attesten:
Valid CE driving licence, valid medical fitness certificate, Code 95 Certificate of Professional Competence and digital tachograph driver card.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No specific diploma required.

- Vakkennis:
Experience as a driver or in distribution transport is an advantage, but not required.

- Talenkennis:
You speak Dutch, French or English.

Als poetsvrouw of poetsman sta je in voor de schoonmaak. (afstoffen, stofzuigen, dweilen, schuren, ...) bij personen met een hulpbehoefte. Naast het poetsen kan je als poetshulp eventueel ook lichte huishoudelijke taken uitvoeren (wassen en strijken).

  • Je bent een enthousiast en hulpvaardig persoon die graag wil werken in een huiselijke sfeer;

  • Je kan vlot omgaan met personen met een hulpbehoefte;
  • Een diploma of ervaring is niet nodig, ervaring met je eigen huishouden is voldoende om te beginnen;

jobs.title: (Fach-) Bauüberwacher Bahn - Alle Gewerke (m/w/d)

Als (Fach-) Bauüberwacher Bahn bei der AVISOL GmbH in Griesheim werden Sie Teil eines dynamischen Teams, das sich auf anspruchsvolle Infrastrukturprojekte im Schienennetz spezialisiert hat. In einer familiären und flexiblen Arbeitsumgebung ohne starre Konzernstrukturen übernehmen Sie Verantwortung und tragen maßgeblich zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Bauvorhaben bei. Unsere Werte wie Ehrlichkeit, Integrität und Teamarbeit bilden das Fundament unseres Erfolgs und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, in der obersten Liga der Bahninfrastruktur mitzuwirken. Mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Kultur des Vertrauens fördern wir Ihre persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung, während Sie gemeinsam mit uns an innovativen Lösungen arbeiten, die den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards gerecht werden. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für exzellente Leistung und nachhaltige Entwicklung haben, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie in unserem engagierten Team willkommen zu heißen.

Aufgaben

  • Überwachung und Koordination von Bauprojekten im Schienenverkehr unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsstandards der Deutschen Bahn
  • Sicherstellung der termingerechten und wirtschaftlichen Umsetzung von Infrastrukturprojekten im Bahnbereich
  • Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen und Abnahme der ausgeführten Arbeiten
  • Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Projektbeteiligten sowie Berichterstattung an die Projektleitung
  • Identifikation von Risiken und Erarbeitung von Maßnahmen zur Minimierung von Verzögerungen und Kostenüberschreitungen

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bauingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Bauüberwachung, idealerweise im Bereich Bahnprojekte
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Normen und Richtlinien der Deutschen Bahn
  • Hohes Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Eigeninitiative
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten sowie Bereitschaft zur Reisetätigkeit

Benefits

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort: Bei uns bist du keine Nummer im starren Konzernapparat. Du triffst operative Entscheidungen direkt am Gleis, bringst Baustellenabläufe effizient voran und gestaltest Arbeitsmethoden aktiv mit. Wenn Prozesse optimiert werden müssen, setzen wir das unbürokratisch gemeinsam um.

Klare Karriere- und Führungsperspektive: Ob Entwicklung zur Team- oder Bereichsleitung für die Bauüberwachung oder Übernahme von Projektsteuerungsaufgaben – bei entsprechender Eignung und Interesse eröffnen wir dir den direkten Weg in Führungspositionen mit echter Personalverantwortung.
