jobs.title: Rice Husk Silica Project Manager
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

Lead implementation of a high-purity amorphous precipitated-silica pilot using rice husk / rice husk ash and obtain customer acceptance for the product.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Map rice-husk/RHA chemistry and feedstock variability.

· Evaluate controlled combustion/calcination, alkaline digestion and precipitation routes.

· Set targets for SiO2 purity, amorphous structure, BET/CTAB/DBP and particle properties.

· Lead RFQs, pilot tests, laboratory analysis and customer qualification.

· Develop rubber/tyre-grade and industrial-grade product strategies.

· Prepare the scale-up path to commercial capacity.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CAPABILITY

· Experience in silica, inorganic chemicals, mineral processing or specialty materials.

· Strong chemical/process-engineering understanding.

· Pilot and product-quality experience.

· Ability to assess both combustion and wet-chemistry process stages.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

· Precipitated-silica / tyre-industry experience.

· Rice-husk-ash technology knowledge.

· XRD/BET/CTAB and laboratory-analysis experience.

KEY SUCCESS MEASURES

· High-purity amorphous silica consistently achieved.

· Successful customer qualification.

· Validated cost and scale-up pathway.

**RECRUITMENT PRINCIPLE** We are looking first and foremost for hands-on implementers with a proven record of taking real industrial or infrastructure projects from planning through procurement, construction, commissioning and operation.

The roles are part of an international renewable-energy, circular-economy, biorefining and industrial side-stream utilisation investment programme with Côte dIvoire as the principal implementation country. The portfolio includes both fast-start production projects and later large-scale industrial investments.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS** A reasonable level of working English is essential. French language skills are a major advantage.

**EXPECTED WORKING STYLE**

· Practical, decisive and delivery-oriented.

· Fact-based, using measurable results and documented data.

· Prepared to challenge supplier assumptions and verify operating references.

· Able to work in a multicultural environment and build local capability.

· Understands that pilot testing, customer qualification and phased scale-up are central risk-management tools.

**EMPLOYMENT AND LOCATION**

Employment form, work location and travel requirements will be defined role by role. Some positions may begin in Finland or elsewhere in Europe, but several key roles will require significant presence in Côte dIvoire during implementation phases.

jobs.title: Socionomkonsult till Vuxenenheten i Vänersborg
jobs.description:
Är du utbildad socionom och har flerårig erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom vuxen och missbruk? Har du erfarenhet av utredningsarbete och känner dig trygg i arbetet med målgruppen och andra aktörer? Då kan detta konsultuppdrag i Vänersborg vara något för dig, varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Om uppdraget Vi söker en socionomkonsult till Vuxenenhetens utredningsteam hos vår kund i Vänersborgs kommun för ett konsultuppdrag som startar snarast möjligt efter tilldelning (senast inom 14 dagar) och pågår initialt i tre månader med möjlighet till förlängning i ytterligare tre månader. Tjänstgöringsgraden är 100 %. Du kommer att arbeta med myndighetsutövning för vuxna från 18 år och uppåt. Målgruppen är bland annat personer med skadligt bruk och beroende, våld i nära relation, avhopp från extremistgrupper samt annan social problematik. Vi söker dig som är trygg i myndighetsutövning och har god erfarenhet av arbete inom vuxen och missbruk.

Dina arbetsuppgifter I denna roll kommer du att arbeta med myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten. Arbetet omfattar bland annat att ta emot ansökningar och anmälningar, göra förhandsbedömningar och utredningar samt bedöma behov och fatta beslut om insatser. Vidare kommer du att:

    

Ta emot ansökningar och anmälningar.

    

Göra förhandsbedömningar och utredningar.

    

Bedöma behov och fatta beslut om insatser samt utforma individuella uppdrag.

    

Följa upp beviljade insatser.

    

Hålla informations- och biståndslösa samtal.

    

Bedriva uppsökande arbete vid behov.

    

Arbeta med evidensbaserade instrument som ASI, AUDIT/DUDIT, UBÅT, NODS-PERC och FREDA.

    

Arbeta enligt bland annat SoL, LVM och LVU.

Dina kvalifikationer

    

Socionomexamen – examensbevis måste bifogas.

    

Minst fem års erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom vuxenenhet, missbruksvård eller VIN (våld i nära relation), där erfarenhet av skadligt bruk/beroende och våld i nära relation ska beskrivas.

    

Möjlighet att påbörja uppdraget snarast, senast inom 14 dagar efter tilldelning.

    

God förmåga att arbeta självständigt och trygghet i rollen som myndighetsutövare.

Ansökningshandlingar För att din ansökan ska vara komplett behöver du bifoga:

    

Aktuellt CV.

    

Personligt brev.

    

Referenser från dina tre senaste uppdrag (inklusive beställare/organisation, start- och slutdatum, kontaktpersonens namn, e-post, telefon samt kort beskrivning av uppdraget).

Som konsult hos Bemannia får du: ⭐ En nära kontakt med din konsultchef ⭐ Möjlighet till fler spännande uppdrag ⭐ Erfarenhet på lärorika arbetsplatser där din kompetens gör skillnad ⭐ Trygga anställningsvillkor 🔭 Läs mer om hur det är att vara konsult hos oss här: Att jobba som konsult via Bemannia

Om ansökan Sök tjänsten genom att klicka på ansök nedan. Ladda gärna upp ditt cv i word-format och på svenska. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan! Sista dag för att lämna anbud är den 16 september 2026. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du specifika frågor kring tjänsten besvaras dessa av ansvarig rekryterare, John Öhlund, john.ohlund@bemannia.se. För generella funderingar kring din ansökan eller vår rekryteringsprocess når du oss under kontorstid på 0707287900.

Bemannia är ett publikt och svenskägt bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag som tillhandahåller kompetent och kvalificerad personal genom uthyrning, rekrytering och personalentreprenader inom Organisation & Ledarskap, PR & Information, Marknad & Sälj, Ekonomi, Juridik, HR & Personal, Fastighet & Teknik, IT & Data samt Kontor & Administration. Bemannia har ramavtal med merparten av Sveriges Myndigheter och Sveriges kommuner, dess förvaltningar och bolag. Bemannia är medlem i Kompetensföretagen och är ett auktoriserat Bemanningsföretag och Rekryteringsföretag samt har kollektivavtal med Unionen, Akademikerna, SEKO samt LO och Hotell- och Restauranganställdas förbund. Bemannia är certifierat enligt SS-EN ISO 9001:2015, Ledningssystem för kvalitet, SS-EN ISO 14001:2015, Miljöledningssystem – krav och vägledning, SS-ISO 45001:2018, Ledningssystem för arbetsmiljö och SS-ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Ledningssystem för informationssäkerhet. Ledningen för bolaget har varit verksam i branschen i 40 år.

jobs.title: Manager, Content Marketing, EMEA
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company’s growth and success.

What you’ll do

You will own and scale Airwallex’s growth and demand generation content engine globally. You will work closely with global and regional teammates across Growth, Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Lifecycle to build content that drives qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue.

This role is ideal for a hands-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion-oriented content.

You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion.

 

This role is based in London.

Responsibilities:

  • Build Growth Content Marketing as a global discipline at Airwallex, establishing best practices, scalable processes, and a high-performing team over time.

  • Own the end-to-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid-funnel conversion content, and product-led narratives.

  • Write, edit, and ship high-impact content including:

    • SEO pillar pages, cluster articles, and comparison content

    • Ebooks, whitepapers, and long-form guides

    • One-pagers, solution briefs, and product explainers

  • Partner deeply with Product Marketing and Product to translate launches, features, APIs, and workflows into content that is searchable, understandable, and sellable.

  • Use user, customer, and market insights to improve ICP targeting, segmentation, messaging, and content distribution strategies.

  • Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals.

  • Be obsessive about measurement and iteration, using performance data to continuously optimize content for traffic quality, engagement, and pipeline impact.

  • Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts.

  • Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t.

  • Balance short-term growth outcomes with longer-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand.

Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in growth content marketing, demand gen content, or SEO-led content roles, preferably at a high-growth B2B technology company.

  • A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain technical products, platforms, or workflows clearly and credibly.

  • Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including keyword intent, on-page optimization, internal linking, and content clustering.

  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze content performance and optimize based on results—not just instincts.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance, and Lifecycle teams.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, global environment and communicating progress and impact to key stakeholders.

  • Experience managing freelancers or agencies and holding them to a high bar for quality and performance.

  • Familiarity with common CMS, SEO, analytics, and experimentation tools (e.g., Webflow/WordPress, GSC, GA4, Ahrefs).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in B2B, SaaS, or fintech environments.

  • Additional language skills (e.g. French, Italian, Spanish, German, Hebrew,...).

  • Good understanding of technical products.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager - Heavy Machinery
jobs.description:
About the Role

SANY is looking for an experienced and commercially driven Regional Sales Manager – Heavy Machinery to develop and grow our heavy machinery business in the Swedish market.

The role is primarily responsible for sales development, customer acquisition, key account management and dealer cooperation. You will manage the full commercial sales process, from identifying new business opportunities and building customer relationships to quotations, negotiations, order follow-up and delivery coordination.

This position will work closely with SANY's product, service, spare parts, logistics and international teams to support the continued development of SANY's business in Sweden.

Key Responsibilities

    Drive sales of SANY heavy machinery products in Sweden and achieve assigned sales targets.
    Identify, develop and secure new customers and business opportunities.
    Develop and maintain long-term relationships with key accounts, dealers, contractors, rental companies and other commercial customers.
    Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, customer meetings, product presentations, quotations, commercial negotiations and contract follow-up.
    Develop new sales channels and support the expansion of SANY's dealer and customer network in Sweden.
    Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery and commercial solutions.
    Follow up ongoing customer projects, orders, deliveries and commercial commitments.
    Coordinate with internal teams including service, spare parts, logistics, product management and finance to ensure smooth execution of customer projects.
    Monitor market demand, competitor activities, pricing trends and major industry developments.
    Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates, customer reports and market analyses.
    Support product demonstrations, customer events, exhibitions and other sales activities.
    Provide market and customer feedback to SANY's regional and headquarters teams.
    Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and sales information in relevant internal systems.
    Travel regularly to visit customers, dealers and project sites.

Qualifications

    Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or another relevant field is preferred.
    5+ years of experience in B2B sales, key account management or business development.
    Experience from construction machinery, heavy equipment, commercial vehicles, lifting equipment, industrial machinery or a related sector is highly desirable.
    Proven ability to develop customers, manage commercial negotiations and close sales.
    Strong commercial awareness and understanding of customer needs.
    Good understanding of technical products and the ability to communicate product benefits to both commercial and technical stakeholders.
    Strong relationship-building, communication and negotiation skills.
    Self-driven, result-oriented and comfortable working independently in a geographically distributed market.
    Ability to manage multiple customer opportunities and projects simultaneously.

jobs.title: BPA søkes til kvinne i 50-årene i Lillestrøm kommune (Blaker)

Jeg trenger også hjelp med treningsøvelser (veiledning vil bli gitt), og du er velkommen til å delta på treningen om du har lyst. Du vil også være med på sosiale aktiviteter som handling, kafébesøk, og reiser. Jeg bor sammen med min familie, men de er på jobb, skole eller aktiviteter på dagtid og kveldstid.

Arbeidstidene er onsdager og torsdager kl. 15:30–22:00, samt hver 3. lørdag kl. 10:00–17:30. På grunn av vår landlige beliggenhet er førerkort og bil en forutsetning.

Kvinner oppfordres til å søke på grunn av arbeidets art.

Oppstart er 1. Oktober.


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment. Excellent communication

I Humana jobber vi ut fra visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv. Ja, alle. Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. Som miljøterapeut/miljøarbeider hos oss blir du en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for enkeltmennesker og en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige.

Ingen dager er like hos oss. Du vil spille en nøkkelrolle i det daglige, målrettede miljøarbeidet, hvor du ser muligheter der andre ser hindringer. Du vil jobbe med daglig omsorg, og tilrettelegging for å skape mestring og livskvalitet i hverdagen for våre beboere. Ditt bidrag i planlegging, evaluering og drøfting av tiltakene vil være viktig. Nødvendig dokumentasjon og rapportering blir en del av rutinene sammen med andre praktiske gjøremål for å sikre en god drift på avdelingen. Hva skal til for å lykkes hos oss?

  • Du har treårig høyskoleutdanning innen helse- og sosialfag, eksempelvis vernepleier, sosionom, barnevernspedagog eller pedagog.

  • Stillingen krever gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Du må ha gyldig førerkort klasse B.

  • Godkjent politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.

Hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø og en bærebjelke i samfunnet vårt. Vi har et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø preget av glede, med nært og stedlig lederskap. Du vil få mulighet til personlig utvikling, påvirkning av egen hverdag og interne karrieremuligheter i et av Norges største private velferdsselskaper. Vi tilbyr selvfølgelig også gode lønnsbetingelser samt pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

jobs.title: Hoiva-avustaja
jobs.description:
Haemme ikääntyvien kiireettömään ja aktivoivaan kotihoitoon hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Kokoaikainen työsuhde on mahdollista työsuhteen jatkuessa.

KotiSenior Oy on yksityinen perheyritys Kuopiossa. Kuulumme osaksi FysioSenior Oy:n yhtiötä. Työllistämme lähes 30 terveysalan ammattilaista tehden päivittäin työtä ikääntyvän väestön laadukkaan ja aktiivisen arjen puolesta. Meillä työskentelee lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia ja sairaanhoitaja. Asiakkaat saavat myös lääkäripalvelut ja muistitutkimukset kotiin osana palveluamme. Olemme erikoistuneet ikääntyvien- ja muistisairaiden aktivoivaan kotihoitoon, joka tarkoittaa meillä aikaa tehdä asioita yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa ja olemista myös seurana. Työtämme ohjaa vahvasti arvot - kiireettömyys, luotettavuus, ammattimaisuus ja positiivisuus.

Hoiva-avustajan työ on asiakkaiden kotona tapahtuvaa kiireetöntä kotipalvelua ja työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti ma-pe klo:7-18 välillä. Työnkuva on monipuolinen ruoanlaitosta leivontaan yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa, pyykkihuollossa avustaminen, ulkoilua ja seurana oloa. Asioimme kaupassa yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa, olemme tukena lääkärikäynneillä ja mahdollistamme vierailuja, kun yksin liikkuminen ei enää onnistu. Työskentelemme myös eri hoivakodeissa, joissa tarjoamme asiakkaille ulkoilua, viriketuokioita ja läsnäoloa. Voimme olla mukana asiointikäynneillä ja avustaa monipuolisesti eri asioissa asiakkaan voinnin mukaan. Asiakaskäynnit ovat yleisimmin 1-2h. Käyntialue on Kuopion kaupunkialue. Edellytämme ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttö katsotaan eduksi, jonka käytöstä maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset.

Työntekijässä arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, työhön sitoutumista sekä itsenäistä työotetta. Kehitämme palveluitamme aktiivisesti asiakkaita ja työntekijöitä kuunnellen, joten toiminnan kehittäminen on myös osa työtäsi. Hyvät yhteistyötaidot ja sujuva kommunikointi hoitohenkilökunnan kuin läheisten kanssa on tärkeää. Työ on itsenäistä ja liikkuvaista. Asiakastilanteet ovat joskus nopeastikin muuttuvia, joten joustavaa ja sopeutuvaa otetta työhön tarvitaan.

Perehdytyksestä olemme saaneet työntekijöiltämme hyvää palautetta ja sen koemme yhdeksi tärkeämmäksi tehtäväksi uuden työntekijän aloittaessa. Perehdytämme uuden työntekijän hyvin kentällä asiakkaisiin sekä työtehtäviin tutustuen. Meillä on erinomainen ja kannustava työilmapiiri työskennellä (henkilöstökysely 4,45/5), jossa työntekijän työtä ja persoonaa arvostetaan. Työntekijän työhyvinvointiin meillä halutaan panostaa monin eri tavoin ja sitä kehitämme aktiivisesti mm. tyhy-tiimin avulla. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Palkkauksessa käytämme yksityisen sosiaalialan tes:ä lähtötasona, mutta neuvottelemme palkkauksen työntekijän koulutus- ja työkokemus katsoen tehtävänkuvaan sopien. Kilometrikorvaus maksetaan käytettäessä omaa autoa.

Työn aloitus on mahdollisimman pian / neuvoteltavissa.

Työnantajana tarjoamme mm.:

\- Mielekkään työn huippu työporukassa

\- Mahdollisuus työajan joustoon

\- Työterveyspalvelut Pihlajalinnassa

\- Vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus

\- Koko henkilöstön tyhy-tapahtumat vuosittain

\- Laadukkaat työvälineet ja työvaatteet

\- E-passin käyttö

Työntekijältämme odotamme:

\- Sosiaali - ja terveysalan koulutus katsomaan eduksi

\- Työhön sitoutuneisuutta

\- Positiivista ja heittäytyvää asennetta työhön

\- Hyviä työyhteisötaitoja ja reilua työkaveruutta

\- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja yhteistyötaitoja

\- Sopeutumista muuttuvissa tilanteissa

\- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

\- Ajokorttia (oman auton käyttö on etu)

\- Tartuntalain vaatima työntekijän 48 §:n rokotussuoja

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6§:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Jos koet, että työ KotiSeniorilla herätti kiinnostusta, niin ota rohkeasti yhteyttä ja kysy tehtävästä ja työskentelystä meillä lisää. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla ja valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten laitathan hakemuksen ja Cv:n mahdollisimman mahdollisimman pian.

We are now hiring skilled and experienced kitchen staff to join our team at Hotel St. Elisabeth and our restaurant De Tre Nonner in Tromsø for the winter season 2026/27.

De Tre Nonner is a quality-focused restaurant with a Nordic-inspired kitchen, built around local products and suppliers. Our kitchen operates across two services:

  • Breakfast

  • Dinner -- à la carte

We are looking for passionate, reliable and team-oriented people who want to contribute to developing our kitchen and restaurant concept further.

POSITIONS AVAILABLE

1 Head Chef

1 Sous Chef

1 Cook

2 Kitchen Assistants

HEAD CHEF

We are looking for an experienced Head Chef who can take overall responsibility for the kitchen operation at Hotel St. Elisabeth / De Tre Nonner.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years' experience as Head Chef or Sous Chef

  • Strong à la carte experience

  • Good knowledge of Nordic and quality-focused cooking

  • Leadership and team-building skills

  • Ability to work independently and take responsibility

Key responsibilities:

  • Menu development and continuous development of the restaurant concept

  • Training and coaching kitchen staff

  • Organizing work schedules and daily kitchen operations

  • Maintaining high standards of quality and presentation

  • IK-MAT food safety routines

  • Ordering and stock control

  • Monitoring and controlling food costs

  • Building and developing a strong kitchen team

The Head Chef will have the opportunity to shape the concept and menu at De Tre Nonner and build their own team in a small, close-knit operation with short decision paths and a real opportunity to influence daily operations.

COOKS & KITCHEN ASSISTANTS

We are looking for:

Cook

  • Experience from à la carte operations

  • Passion for quality food and good ingredients

  • Ability to work efficiently in a busy kitchen

  • Reliable and team-oriented

Kitchen Assistants

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Husqvarna Group, we develop innovative solutions that shape the future of sustainable productivity. As part of our automation and product development environment in Huskvarna, you will join a team working closely with advanced test systems, industrial automation, and product verification. Our engineers collaborate across multiple product groups and projects, contributing to the development, commissioning, and continuous improvement of automated systems that support world-class products and technologies. This is an opportunity to work in a technically advanced environment where innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning are central to our success.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to strengthen our team in Huskvarna. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing automation solutions and test systems used within our engineering and product development environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Programming and developing PLC-based automation solutions, primarily in Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
    Commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimizing automated equipment and test systems
    Supporting machine safety implementation and ensuring compliance with relevant standards
    Working with system integration and communication between automation systems and connected equipment
    Collaborating with internal stakeholders across product groups, projects, and improvement initiatives
    Participating in the development of new test solutions as well as the continuous improvement of existing systems
    Providing technical expertise and contributing to long-term automation strategies

This is a hands-on role where you will drive automation initiatives independently while working closely with engineers, developers, and internal customers.

About you

Desired skills, qualifications, and experience

    Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field
    Several years of experience working with industrial automation systems
    Extensive experience programming PLC systems in Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
    Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of automated systems
    Knowledge of machine safety standards and implementation
    Understanding of industrial communication protocols and system integration
    Experience working with test systems or automated production equipment is highly beneficial
    Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    Swedish language skills are strongly meritorious

Personal attributes

To succeed in this role, you are:

    Self-driven and comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions
    Analytical and structured in your approach to problem-solving
    Collaborative and able to build strong relationships across teams
    Curious and motivated by learning new technologies and concepts
    Quality-focused with a continuous improvement mindset
    Comfortable balancing independent work with teamwork in a dynamic environment

What we offer

At Husqvarna Group, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technology in a global organization that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.

We offer:

    A technically challenging role with significant responsibility and influence
    Opportunities to work on advanced automation and test system solutions
    A collaborative and supportive work environment
    Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
    The possibility to contribute to products and technologies used worldwide
    A culture where innovation, teamwork, and individual growth are encouraged

Location

Huskvarna, Sweden.

Your application

Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, send us your application! Selection is ongoing. Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.

For questions regarding the process please contact

Recruiter: Jonathan Olsson jonathan.olsson@husqvarnagroup.com or

Hiring Manager: Hans Berntsson, hans.berntsson@husqvarnagroup.com

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

· Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.

· Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.

· Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: Ohjaaja, Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö
jobs.description:
Tule sellaisena kuin olet!

Etsimme mielenterveys, päihde- ja asunnottomuustyöstä kiinnostunutta lähihoitajaa vakinaiseen ohjaajan tehtävään Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikköön. Aloitus heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Edellytämme soveltuvaa tutkintoa sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon alalta esim. lähihoitajan tutkinto (kelpoisuusehto: laki sosiaalihuollon ammatillisen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista 272/2005) sekä tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa ja tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemusta päihde- ja mielenterveystyöstä, mutta tärkeintä on kyky kohdata asiakkaat vaihtelevissa elämäntilanteissaan ja toimia osana työyhteisöä. Olet hyvä tyyppi, joka ei kavahda vauhtia ja vaarallisia tilanteita. Sinulla on kyky sopeutua nopeastikin muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja siedät keskeneräsyyttä. Tarjoamme mahtavan työporukan lisäksi vaihtelevan ja mielenkiintoisen työn, jossa kahta samanlaista päivää ei ole. Saat työllesi kattavan perehdytyksen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen.

Ohjaajilla on yksikössämme käytössä työvuoroautonomia, joten työvuorot on mahdollista suunnitella henkilökohtaiseen elämäntilanteeseesi sopivaksi. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä ja sisältää sekä arki- että viikonlopputyötä.

Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö toimii Asunto ensin-periaatteella tarjoten tuettua asumista asunnottomuutta kokeneille. Yksikössä on 89 asukaspaikkaa ja henkilökunta paikalla ympäri vuorokauden. Yksikön perustehtävänä on turvata asukkaisen asuminen omissa vuokra-asunnoissaan. Kantavana ajatuksena on tarjota asukkaille mahdollisuus ihmisarvoiseen elämään, johon olennaisena osana kuuluu asunto, osallisuuden kokemus omaan elämään, yhteisöön ja yhteiskuntaan.

Ohjaajan tehtäviin asumispalveluyksikössä kuuluvat asukkaan ohjaaminen ja tukeminen erilaisissa arjen hallintaan ja asumiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Työ sisältää asukkaiden fyysisen ja psyykkisen terveydentilan arviointia ja tarpeen mukaan ohjaamista terveydenhuollon ja sosiaalihuollon palveluiden piiriin. Ohjaajan tukena työssä ovat ohjaajien työryhmän lisäksi yksikön sairaanhoitaja, sosiaaliohjaajat, työvalmentaja, tiiminvetäjä, esihenkilö sekä yksikön johtaja.

Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n G21 (2543,33-2871,53). Tarjoamme lisäksi työterveyshuollon ja e-passiedun.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tuetun asumisen esihenkilö Anu Ratinen puh. 045-77347362. Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset pyydetään jättämään mahdollisimman pian, paikka täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä ja haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten ole pian yhteydessä, jos ja kun kiinnostuksesi heräsi!

jobs.title: Vil du være min forlengede arm i en aktiv hverdag? (BPA til kvinne 47 år)
jobs.description:
Jeg er en kvinne på 47 år som lever et aktivt liv sammen med min familie og våre hunder. Nå leter jeg etter en pålitelig og fleksibel brukerstyrt personlig assistent (BPA) som kan gi meg den praktiske støtten jeg trenger for at hverdagen skal gå smidig.

I denne rollen er det du som er assistenten – din oppgave er å være mine hender og føtter, slik at jeg kan gjennomføre mine daglige gjøremål og holde på med min store lidenskap: hundetrening.

Hva innebærer jobben?

Arbeidsoppgavene varierer etter mine behov, men vil i hovedsak bestå av:

  • I hjemmet: Praktisk bistand til husarbeid, rengjøring og enkle dagligdagse oppgaver.

  • Aktivitet og tur: Bli med som ledsager på turer i skog og mark.

  • Hundetrening: Assistere med det praktiske under trening, slik at jeg kan bruke min energi på selve aktiviteten.

  • Bilkjøring: Fungere som sjåfør til avtaler, ærender og treninger.


Jeg søker deg som ønsker en fast arbeidsplan, men som også har mulighet til å stille opp fleksibelt ved sykdom eller ekstra behov.
At vi har god kjemi er det aller viktigste for meg.

Kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper:

  • Glad i dyr: Hunder er en stor del av livet mitt – du må trives godt rundt firbeinte.

  • Førerkort klasse B: Et absolutt krav, da du skal kjøre min bil.

  • Språk: Du behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig (minimum B1-nivå).

  • Selvstendig og initiativrik: Du ser hva som må gjøres, trår til der det trengs og har god gjennomføringsevne.

  • Pålitelig og personlig egnet: Du er trygg, tålmodig og har respekt for at arbeidsplassen din er mitt private hjem.

  • Langsiktig: Du ønsker en stabil jobb og ser for deg å være en del av mitt team over tid.

Hva tilbyr jeg?

  • En variert, aktiv og meningsfull hverdag.

  • Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med både folk og dyr.

  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende avtaleverk via BPA-leverandør.

Mangfold beriker arbeidsmiljøet, og jeg oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke!


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: New Business Account Executive - Netherlands
Personlig assistent sökes till en pojke i Nacka!
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta som personlig assistent och bidra till allas lika rätt till ett bra liv?

I rollen kommer du göra skillnad i människors vardag och tillsammans med oss arbeta efter Humanas vision – Alla har rätt till ett bra liv.

Om tjänsten

Personlig assistans är en insats enligt LSS (Lagen om stöd och Service till vissa funktionshindrade). I din roll som personlig assistent kommer du huvudsakligen att hjälpa kunden med allt som uppstår i vardagen samt med grundläggande behov. Ditt arbete innebär att värna om kundens självbestämmande och integritet, och bidrar till att vardagen fungerar smidigt. Varje assistans är unikt anpassad utifrån kundens liv och därför kan arbetsuppgifter variera beroende på arbetsplatsen.

Vår kund är en glad och kärleksfull kille på snart 4 år som behöver stöd i sin vardag. Vi önskar någon som vill vara med och skapa en lekfull vardag med trygghet. Man ger stöd i lek, aktivitet och träning. Man tränar även på att äta med munnen, samt att få mat via peg. Som assistent hjälper du även till med medicinering. Vi ser helst en person som vill arbeta under en längre period då arbetet bygger mycket på den relation man bygger upp med barnet. Personkemi och engagemang väger tyngst.

Vem är du?

Rollen som personlig assistent ställer höga krav på förmågan att skapa goda relationer. Vi söker därför dig som är lyhörd, engagerad och ansvarstagande. Det är även viktigt att du kan ta egna initiativ och se vad som behöver göras. För att trivas som personlig assistent är det viktigt att det finns bra personkemi mellan dig som assistent och kunden.

För tjänsten krävs det att du har:

    

har goda kunskaper i svenska

    

är rökfri

    

djurfri då det förekommer allergi i familjen

    

är lugn trygg lekfull lyhörd och tålmodig

För tjänsten är det meriterande om du:

    

kompetens inom TAKK och/eller bildstöd

    

erfarenhet av att jobba med barn.

    

erfarenhet av barn med speciella behov

    

erfarenhet av epilepsi

    

erfarenhet av PEG

Stor vikt kommer att läggas kring personlig lämplighet.

Arbetstid, tjänstgöringsgrad och lön

Aktuell anställningsform är ”så länge assistansuppdraget varar” med en tjänstgöringsgrad på cirka 46%. Arbetstiderna är förlagda till dag och kväll.

Fast timlön enligt överenskommelse och övriga ersättningar sker enligt kollektivavtal.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Humana är det viktigt att både du som assistent och kunden känner er trygga i samarbetet. Därför får du som ny assistent en introduktion som är anpassad både till yrkesrollen och till den kund du ska arbeta hos. Du får även tillgång till relevanta utbildningar och möjlighet att utvecklas i din roll – så att du har goda förutsättningar att trivas och känna dig trygg i ditt arbete. Humana har kollektivavtal, försäkringar och friskvårdsförmån.

Vad händer nu?

Vi ser gärna att du ansöker snarast då vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss på Humana är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent måste du vara minst 18 år.

Utifrån lagstiftning krävs att vi som arbetsgivare begär ett registerutdrag från alla anställda som ska arbeta som personlig assistent åt ett barn under 18 år. Därav behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister inför en eventuell anställning. Ytterligare information kommer om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen.

Till dig som arbetar inom rekrytering- och bemanningsföretag samt med annonsförsäljning så undanber vi oss erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster i samband med den här annonsen.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vill du veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsansvarig:

Sandra Heras Arvidsson sandra.herasarvidsson@humana.se

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Payroll specialist

At Maersk, we have a vision larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain. We count on our people to make it happen.

Besides focusing on creating value for our customers and the business, a key priority for us is to drive personal and professional development for our people to prepare for further career progression.

We value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job.



We Offer

Energizing and pioneering, this is an environment that keeps you motivated.

You’ll be joining a genuinely diverse and talented team that is truly passionate about providing first class HR partnership to the business. And thanks to our global scale, you’ll be well-placed to explore Maersk opportunities around the world.

The many other highlights include industry-leading talent develop initiatives and competitive benefits.

You will be joining a Fortune 500 company and will get the opportunity to challenge yourself in a truly aspiring, international, and fast-paced environment with our team in Gothenburg and all over the world. In cooperation with colleagues and vendors your role will be to ensure a flawless payroll service to Swedish and Norwegian employees. This will give you a unique opportunity to interact with colleagues, across the globe and from all business areas within the Maersk group, all while having a continuous focus on your professional and personal development too.

Key Responsibilities

The purpose of the role is to support the regional payroll organization, working with a matrixed group of stakeholders and vendors to ensure great employee experience and regulatory compliance from a payroll delivery perspective. Key responsibilities:

    Manage pre-payroll, on-cycle payroll, off-cycle payroll processes
    Extract the T&A data and provide the same to payroll provider
    Validate payroll results & provide approvals for final pay credits based on control reports
    Annual payroll reconciliation and new Payroll Year preparation
    Ensure timely Social Insurance Tax Payment and Reporting
    Manage advance payments
    Adjust basic time configuration of systems after initial implementation, as approved/required
    Track vendor deliverables on payroll SLAs vide defined payroll metrics
    Be risk aware and help identify, report, mitigate and track risks in the payroll delivery process
    Support the Payroll team lead in providing necessary data and clarifications to questions raised by audit – internal and external
    Manage the timely submission of RICC controls  
    Participate in Time and Attendance initiatives including system upgrades, communication of changes to People Partners, testing and documenting all changes for historical and record retention policies, project support as needed
    Interfaces with People Partner to support employee/ manager queries
    Identify improvement opportunities in regional processes and raises them to global process managers

Who we are looking for

You are data, systems and process savvy in the Payroll, HR, Time & Attendance domain and are excited about putting your deep expertise at work in the transition into new technology and processes at Maersk.

You want to propel your career further by gaining unique project experience in an international environment and would like to play a key role in building the future payroll delivery landscape and solutions.

As we progress with the transformation you are comfortable with your role changing shape and scope. You will be responsible for high quality delivery of Payroll Services and continuously driving improvements to ensure great employee experience process optimization and compliance.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in managing Payroll, Time & Attendance and HR processes, within a complex international organization

• Knowledge of compliance and legal regulations for payroll & benefits

• Broader HR Operations experience as well as exposure to an outsourced payroll model would be a benefit

• Ability to effectively engage and mobilize diverse local HR stakeholders

• A proactive, ‘let’s get it done’ attitude geared towards continuous improvement

• Flexibility and adaptability to operate in a fast-paced, developing project environment, taking ownership and setting directions with minimal guidance

• Resilience: the change process, is anything but straightforward; accepting uncertainty and bouncing back from setbacks while keeping your enthusiasm is a tall order, but we need it

• Collaborative working style, fostering cooperation and teamwork to find solutions

• Fluency in Swedish and English is essential

• If you have worked with ‘transportavtalet’, is an advantage too

• Highly analytical approach with a strong eye for detail

• Structured working style and focus on delivering results as per agreed timescales and scope

Selection is ongoing, so we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Tilkallingsvikar søkes til nattevakt
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD TROMS OG FINNMARK
jobs.description:
Tilkalling/ ekstravakt som superassistent på natt

Er du et nattmenneske som liker å være våkne når resten av verden sover. Er du god på å være stille? Liker du varierte vakter men med noe rolige perioder? Er du god på å liste deg rundt i nattens møre?  Kanskje er akkurat du nattevakten jeg leter etter? Jeg søker noen som kan være våken når jeg sover og bidra til at kveldene og morgenen mine blir supre.

Mine assistenter sier ofte at å jobbe for meg er verdens rareste, men også fineste jobb. Jeg lever et liv fjernt fra rutiner der noen dager er like mens andre dager skjer det 1000 ting.  Mine superassistenter gjør det mulig for meg å reise, jobbe og ta en doktorgrad. Jeg er engasjert i politikk og er med i flere organisasjoner. Det som derimot ikke fungerer så bra er kroppen min, jeg har en omfattende funksjonshemming bruker rullestol og pustehjelp. Det vil si at det er endel medisinske oppgaver i hverdagen. Det kan være litt blålys stemning noen ganger. Men med god opplæring og alt det medisinske utstyret er det ingen sak. Vi tuller ofte med at vi har med oss et lite lokalsykehus på tur.

Jeg ønsker superassistenter som vil være med å gjøre livet mitt mulig, du trenger ingen erfaring da alt kan læres. Det viktigste er at du ser meg som person, vil gjøre en god innsats og tar instruksjoner. Min erfaring er at de beste assistentene er de som ikke har peiling når de begynner, men har lyst å lære. Jeg trenger selvstendige og handlekraftige assistenter som er med på mitt liv på mine vilkår.

Du må tilfredsstille følgende krav

  • parfyme- og røykfri
  • Lappen klasse B
  • Plettfri vandelsattest
  • Glad i en utfordring
  • Snakke norsk, norsk tegnspråk eller Skandinavisk

Det er nå ledige stillinger som tilkallingsvikar på natt. Hos meg er det 12 timers vakter og intensive arbeidsperioder. Turnusen er godkjent av fagforbundet, og består av 5 vakter på, 7 av, 2 på, 7 av, samt at det kan være flere vakter på reise etter særlig avtale.

Arbeidsted er enten i min bolig i Tromsø eller der jeg til enhver tid befinner meg. Du må dekke egen bolig i Tromsø, men får dekt opphold og reise om vi er andre steder.

Alle kjønn er velkommen til å søke. Menn, skeive, transpersoner og ikke-binære oppfordres til å søke.

Om du tror dette er din greie, send en søknad til Ith@medvindassistanse.no

Merk søknaden med «nattevakt»

Søknader behandles fortløpende, oppstart etter avtale


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Jobba som personlig assistent hos vår kvinnliga kund i Storebro
jobs.description:
Just nu söker vi dig som vill bli en del av vårt härliga team och som vill jobba som personlig assistent hos vår kvinnliga kund i Storebro.Vad innebär den här tjänsten?

Kunden är en kvinna i 25-årsåldern som bor hemma med sin familj. Hon är en härlig person som tycker om att dansa och att tillbringa sommaren på Astrid Lindgrens Värld.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta långsiktigt och bygga en trygg relation som personlig assistent. Kvinnan behöver en lugn och försiktig inskolning vid nya kontakter, med hänsyn till sin autism och assistenten behöver lära sig att kommunicera med kvinnan då hon är icke verbal. Arbetstiderna planeras i samråd utifrån behov, och därför ser vi gärna att du är flexibel med tider, särskilt i början.

Inledningsvis kommer arbetet att omfatta ett fåtal timmar åt gången under inskolningsperioden. Målet är att kunden på sikt ska ha externa assistenter nära dagligen, under större delen av dygnets timmar. Detta kan innebära tjänst med överenskommen tjänstgöringsgrad. Kvinnan har assistans dygnets alla timmar med jour del av natten, så du behöver kunna arbeta obekväma arbetstider (kväll, natt och helg).

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är social, driven och lugn. Arbetet utformas alltid utifrån kundens behov, dagsform och önskemål.

Kunden söker en skojig och kreativ person med nära till skratt. Du ska vara noggrann och ha förmåga att arbeta självständigt, med kundens bästa i fokus. Erfarenhet av liknande arbete är meriterande. Krav på körkort och tidigare erfarenhet inom LSS.

Förutom detta ser vi gärna att du:

    

är kvinna

    

har erfarenhet av att arbeta med autism och Downs syndrom

    

inte har pälsallergi, då pälsdjur finns i hemmet

    

har tidigare erfarenhet av "tecken som stöd" och "bildstöd"

Det är viktigt att du är strukturerad, tydlig och stabil i ditt arbete med kunden. Viktigast är dina personliga egenskaper samt personkemin mellan dig och kunden.

Vi erbjuder ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete där du som medarbetare uppmuntras att fatta egna, kloka beslut. Vi har även ett stort utbud av digitala utbildningar och andra verktyg som stödjer din utveckling i yrkesrollen.  

Övrig information

Anställningsform: Anställd på en timanställning med mål till en visstid så länge assistansuppdraget varar.

Omfattning: Efter överenskommelse

Arbetstider: Efter överenskommelse men behov finns dygnets alla tider.

Tillträde: Omgående.

Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och har kollektivavtal. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Inför en eventuell anställning ska du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES alternativt ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Rekrytering sker löpande.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Project Interface Manager
jobs.description:
The opportunity

HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufacture and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. As we continue to experience strong growth, we are now looking for a Project Interface Manager (PIM) to join one of our delivery projects.

In this role, you will work with a strong focus on project interfaces, driving alignment and success through analysis, coordination, and effective communication. You will be part of an organization that values collaboration, encourages innovation, and offers exciting opportunities for professional growth and development. Are you an innovative and confident leader with a strong ability to balance and build upon our proud heritage while embracing new ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement? If so, this could be the opportunity for you.

    You enable continuous and effective flow of information and communication across the project's internal as well as external interfaces.
    You work primarily with technical interfaces support our core business of Engineering.

Your Background

    You value transparency and self motivation, and you contribute and share a broad experience of failure, success and learnings.

jobs.title: On-call Trainee
jobs.description:
Wärtsilä Finland Oy, Delivery Centre Sustainable Technology Hub, is looking for an On-call Trainee for Operative Purchasing. The position is a temporary position for about 6 months (0-25 hours/week) and the location is Vaasa, Finland. The person selected for this role needs to be a full-time student studying for a degree in Finland.


Your role and responsibilities

As an On-call Trainee, you will work in an assistive role to secure on-time material availability and to optimize the inventory levels together with operative purchasers and in collaboration with several different stakeholders with diverse expertise.


Your work will focus on assisting with these responsibilities:

* Ensure the right amount of required material to be available when needed
* Forecasting, requirement and delivery planning, ordering and order monitoring for an assigned component portfolio
* Manage and measure supplier quality level
* Manage document revisions for suppliers
* Maintain and develop material master data
* Optimize the inventory turnover
* Other tasks related to operative purchasing



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Studies and interest in Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or similar
* Good communication, teamwork, and social skills
* A systematic and proactive approach to working
* Good problem-solving skills
* Good PC skills (e.g. SAP, Power BI, advanced Excel)
* Fluency in spoken and written Finnish and English
* Interest in process development and data analytics is seen as an advantage



Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal by 13th September.

KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling

Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt elektronikteam og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, effektiv drift og motiverede medarbejdere? Så er du måske vores nye arbejdsleder til Elektronikafdelingen. Vi arbejder hovedsageligt på nybygninger og er med fra de første spæde installationer til de sidste, færdige installation ombord på topmoderne fartøjer.

Som arbejdsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af elektronikafdelingen i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen. Du bliver en central del af produktionen, hvor du sikrer effektiv planlægning, høj kvalitet i arbejdet og synlig ledelse af afdelingens medarbejdere.

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for både medarbejdere, produktion, kvalitet og opfølgning på opgaver og ressourcer.

 

Om opgaverne:

Som arbejdsleder for vores elektronik-team, vil nogle af opgaverne indebære:

  • Daglig ledelse af elektronikafdelingen – samt motivation og udvikling af afdelingens timelønnede medarbejdere gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og leveringstid.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Har erfaring med at lede og koordinere arbejdet i en medarbejdergruppe

  • Er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel og imødekommende.

  • Erfaring fra den maritime branche er en fordel.

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En fast stilling på fuldtid.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er topprioriteter.

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer.

 

Vil du med ombord?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team, hvor vi sætter kvalitet i højsædet, så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores produktionschef, René Hansen, på tlf. (+45) 26 87 44 33.

 

Ansøgning sendes til:          job@kselektro.dk

Tiltrædelse:                            Snarest muligt – eller efter aftale.

 

KS Elektro A/S er et ungt firma, der har stor erfaring og stærke kompetencer indenfor levering af el- og elektronik løsninger til den maritime industri. Vi beskæftiger ca. 150 medarbejdere i Skagen.

Med vores søsterselskab Karstensens Skibsværft, som er førende indenfor nybygning af pelagiske fartøjer og reparationer af forskellige skibstyper, beskæftiger vi tilsammen over 650 medarbejdere. Dertil har vi en ordrebog på 5-7 nybygninger og mellem 100-150 reparations – og større ombygningsopgaver om året.

jobs.title: Postdoctor in plant developmental biology
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

The long-term goal of our research is to understand the signaling mechanisms regulating plant growth and development (https://www.upsc.se/researchers/6171-robert-stephanie-regulation-of-plant-cell-shape-acquisition.html). You will be part of a team that work at building a better understanding in the signaling controlling cell fate acquisition in Arabidopsis root. The candidate will aim at dissecting the role of the cuticle layer in this process. The project is based on cell biology including live confocal microscopy, molecular biology and transcriptomics.

Your profile

Applicants require a doctoral degree in molecular, cell or developmental biology, or related disciplines. Furthermore, applicants should be proficient in English and should have the ability to work independently as well as in collaboration with others. Experience in confocal microscopy, Arabidopsis, transcriptomics is of merit.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Fixed-term employment 12 months

Scope:

100%

Start date:

As agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 18 September 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Konstruktionsingeniør / Projektleder med erfaring i bæredygtigt byggeri
jobs.description:
På vegne af Werner Sobek København søger Gi Group en erfaren konstruktionsingeniør / projektleder, som ønsker at arbejde med transformation af det byggede miljø, komplekse konstruktioner og bæredygtige løsninger i et internationalt rådgivningsmiljø. 

Werner Sobek er en international rådgivende ingeniørvirksomhed med fokus på konstruktioner, bæredygtighed og integreret design. Virksomheden arbejder med at skabe bygninger og konstruktioner, der forener teknisk ekspertise, æstetik og ansvarlig ressourceanvendelse. Projekterne spænder fra ikoniske byggerier og højhuse til komplekse transformations- og renoveringsprojekter. 

Kontoret i København blev etableret i januar 2022 og spiller en central rolle i den bæredygtige udvikling af dansk byggeri. Werner Sobek er blandt andet en del af Leralliancen, hvor erfaringer fra tyske byggestandarder har bidraget til udviklingen af nye bæredygtige byggeløsninger. Derudover arbejder virksomheden med revitalisering af eksisterende bygninger og udviklingen af fremtidens klimavenlige byggerier. 

Som konstruktionsingeniør / projektleder bliver du en vigtig del af et højt specialiseret team, hvor du får ansvar for projektering og udvikling af bærende konstruktioner i både nationale og internationale projekter. Som konstruktionsingeniør vil du samtidigt få en central rolle i samarbejdet med kunder, arkitekter og øvrige rådgivere, samtidig med at du bidrager til udviklingen af innovative og bæredygtige løsninger. 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Projektering og dimensionering af bærende konstruktioner til nybyggeri, transformation og renovering. 

  • Projektledelse og koordinering af tværfaglige projekter i samarbejde med interne og eksterne interessenter. 

  • Udvikling af konstruktionsløsninger med fokus på bæredygtighed, materialeeffektivitet og CO₂-reduktion. 

  • Teknisk sparring med kunder, arkitekter og øvrige rådgivere gennem hele projektforløbet. 

  • Udvikling af konstruktionsløsninger til eksisterende og fredede bygninger. 

  • Sikre, at projekter lever op til gældende dansk byggelovgivning og myndighedskrav. 

  • Bidrage til udvikling af innovative løsninger og implementering af nye bæredygtige byggemetoder. 

  • Deltagelse i både danske og internationale projekter i et tværfagligt rådgivningsmiljø. 

Faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du er uddannet civilingeniør med speciale inden for bærende konstruktioner. 

  • Du har flere års erfaring som konstruktionsingeniør og med projektering af bærende konstruktioner. 

  • Du har en solid konstruktionsfaglig forståelse og stærke analytiske kompetencer. 

  • Du har interesse for bæredygtighed, CO₂-reduktion, materialeeffektivitet og cirkulært byggeri. 

  • Du taler og forstår dansk og engelsk. 

  • Kendskab til tysk er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 

  • Certificeret statiker er en stor fordel, men ikke et krav. 

Personlige kvalifikationer

  • Du arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine projekter fra start til slut. 

  • Du trives med komplekse tekniske problemstillinger og motiveres af at finde innovative løsninger. 

  • Du har stærke samarbejdsevner og fungerer godt i tværfaglige og internationale projektteams. 

  • Du tager initiativ og bidrager aktivt til udviklingen af både projekter og arbejdsprocesser. 

  • Du trives med at have flere projekter i gang samtidig og motiveres af en varieret hverdag. 

  • Du er udadvendt og trives i dialogen med kunder, samarbejdspartnere og øvrige interessenter. 

  • Du motiveres af at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der gør en reel forskel for fremtidens byggeri. 

Vores tilbud

  • En central rolle i en international rådgivningsvirksomhed med fokus på bæredygtighed og innovation. 

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af Danmarks og Europas mest ambitiøse byggeprojekter. 

  • Et lille, tæt team i København, hvor du får stor indflydelse og mulighed for at arbejde på mange forskellige projekter. 

  • Stor faglig udvikling i et højt specialiseret og internationalt ingeniørmiljø. 

  • En hverdag præget af tværfagligt samarbejde, vidensdeling og høj faglighed. 

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger i Hamborg, Berlin og Stuttgart samt mulighed for faglig udvikling og ophold på de internationale kontorer. 

  • Fleksible arbejdsforhold med flextid og mulighed for hjemmearbejde i det omfang, projekterne tillader det. 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og anciennitet, samt gode udviklingsmuligheder i en virksomhed med stærke værdier og høje ambitioner.

jobs.title: Skiservicemedarbeider / Ski Service Technician
jobs.description:
For deg som er opptatt av presisjon, struktur og topp finish

Norefjell Skisenter styrker skiservice-teamet og søker en faglig sterk skiteknikker til vintersesongen.

Våre verksteder håndterer både høyvolum utleie og skiservice for gjester med høye krav til kvalitet. Vi søker deg som vil ha din base på Skistua, hvor verkstedet er utstyrt med en topp moderne Wintersteiger Discovery 2 i kombinasjon med Sigma BSI. Dette gir svært gode muligheter for presis struktur, jevn slip og effektiv produksjon – også i perioder med høyt trykk.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Strukturering, planslip og kantpreparering av alpinski og snowboard
  • Drift og vedlikehold av Wintersteiger-maskiner
  • Manuell etterbehandling og kvalitetskontroll
  • Effektiv håndtering av volum i utleie, uten å kompromisse på kvalitet
  • Kundedialog ved behov, spesielt på mer avanserte serviceoppdrag

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Erfaring fra skiserviceverksted
  • God forståelse for struktur, kantvinkler og såleoppbygging
  • Erfaring med Wintersteiger (eller tilsvarende maskiner) er en klar fordel
  • Evne til å jobbe nøyaktig og effektivt under høyt arbeidspress
  • Teknisk interesse og eierskap til eget arbeid

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et moderne verksted med maskinpark i toppklasse
  • Mulighet til å jobbe med avansert skiservice og høyt volum
  • Et faglig sterkt miljø med fokus på kvalitet og utvikling
  • Tett samarbeid med skiutleie

 

Er du detaljorientert, opptatt av presisjon – og motiveres av å levere ski med best mulig ytelse på snø?


Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For those who care about precision, structure and a flawless finish

Norefjell Ski Resort is strengthening its ski service team and is looking for a highly skilled ski technician for the winter season.

Our workshops handle both high-volume rental equipment and ski servicing for guests with high quality expectations. We are looking for someone who will be based at Skistua, where the workshop is equipped with a state-of-the-art Wintersteiger Discovery 2 combined with Sigma BSI. This provides excellent opportunities for precise structuring, consistent grinding and efficient production – even during periods of high demand.

Responsibilities:

  • Base structuring, flat grinding and edge preparation of alpine skis and snowboards
  • Operation and maintenance of Wintersteiger machinery
  • Manual finishing and quality control
  • Efficient handling of high rental volumes without compromising on quality
  • Customer interaction when required, particularly for more advanced service jobs

Qualifications:

  • Experience from a ski service workshop
  • Good understanding of base structures, edge angles and base preparation
  • Experience with Wintersteiger or similar machinery is a clear advantage
  • Ability to work accurately and efficiently under pressure
  • Technical interest and a strong sense of ownership of your work

We offer:

  • A modern workshop with top-class machinery
  • The opportunity to work with advanced ski servicing and high volumes
  • A highly skilled team focused on quality and professional development
  • Close cooperation with the ski rental department

Are you detail-oriented, passionate about precision and motivated by delivering skis with the best possible performance on snow?

Then we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: People Partner - Netlight
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR professional passionate about making a meaningful impact on both people and business? Do you excel at building relationships and serving as a trusted advisor to drive individual and organizational growth?

Netlight is seeking a People Partner for a fixed-term parental leave cover, starting in November 2026 and running until January 2028. This role is ideal for someone who focuses on operational excellence with a strategic approach and is eager to explore diverse opportunities for personal and career development.

About Netlight Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. It is a network organization of more than 2000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. The company has been awarded several times as a top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity, and equality within the IT industry. Today, Netlight is growing across Europe, currently with 11 active international offices. As a network organization, their way of working is based on leveraging competence, allowing them to benefit from collective expertise, beyond the ability of the individual. The company is built on trust and self-leadership.

The Team Netlight’s global HR organization includes 25+ colleagues across HR, Payroll, and Learning & Development. The HR Operations team in Stockholm consists of seven professionals, located atop Gallerian. As a key member of the team, the People Partner helps shape the future of HR, driving HR core deliveries, growth and success in an environment built on collaboration, trust, and development. Collaboration across the Global HR Team is central to ensure alignment and advance key initiatives.

The Role – People Partner Working in HR at Netlight requires strong business sense and exceptional relationship-building skills, as this is a fast-paced, ever-evolving, and people-focused organization. As a People Partner, the responsibilities include:

    

Managing employee relations and enhancing the employee experience throughout their journey.

    

Coaching, advising, and training leaders on key personnel topics—such as work environment, performance, well-being, and labor law—to empower them in their roles.

    

Supporting talent management initiatives to help our people reach their full potential.

    

Driving and leading projects with people and business impact

    

Ensuring HR policies and procedures align with our overall people strategy.

    

Driving efficient global HR practices while ensuring compliance with employment laws and regulations.

    

Managing and developing partnerships related to employee well-being and benefits.

    

Leading employee engagement efforts, including surveys and initiatives to assess and improve organizational well-being.

    

Handling people data across the employee lifecycle within our HRIS.

    

Utilizing People Analytics to analyze and share key insights that support informed decision-making and business strategy.

Profile

Netlight is looking for an HR professional with an open and creative mindset, eager to learn and apply their experience. The role suits someone who enjoys collaboration, takes initiative, and is committed to growth.

In addition, they value:

    

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex HR challenges.

    

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build trust and influence at all levels of the organization.

    

A proactive and solution-oriented approach to driving HR initiatives forward.

    

An understanding of HR best practices, employment laws, and compliance.

    

The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a people-first mindset.

Qualifications

    

University degree with focus on Human Resources or similar education

    

3+ years of full-time work experience within the field of HR; Employee life cycle, advising leaders, developing processes and guidelines etc.

    

You communicate fluently verbally and in written form in Swedish and have a professional level of English (as English is our organizational language).

What Netlight Offers

    

The possibility to be part of and drive a wide array of HR and business topics in an international environment.

    

Competence development and long-term career progression realized through a culture of knowledge sharing, feedback, external courses, mentorship and coaching.

    

A top modern, and centrally located office space in Stockholm (Urban Escape on top of Gallerian).

    

Social- and competency developing internal events

The compensation and benefits package includes:

    

5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)

    

Private pension savings

    

30 days of paid vacation

    

Employee Assistance Program

    

Parental Top Up

    

Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)

Interested? In this recruitment, Netlight is collaborating with Zoey. Apply easily with your CV or LinkedIn at www.zoey.se. When applying, you will be asked to answer a few brief questions and afterwards you will receive updates regarding any possible next step in the process 😊 If you have any questions about our process or this role, please contact Martina Kolga, Recruitment Consultant (073-3222502, martina.kolga@zoey.se).
