jobs.title: Lokalvårdare till storstädning - heltid 100 %
jobs.description:
Lokalvårdare till storstädning och engångsuppdrag – heltid 100 %

Optimal Trappstädning söker nu en ny medarbetare som vill arbeta heltid med storstädningar, extrastädningar och andra engångsuppdrag i Stockholmsområdet.

Det här passar dig som gillar ett praktiskt arbete, tycker om variation och vill ha en arbetsdag där du rör på dig och arbetar på olika platser.

Tjänsten är på heltid, 100 %.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som lokalvårdare hos oss kommer du främst att arbeta med uppdrag som inte ingår i den vanliga återkommande trappstädningen.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan till exempel bestå av:

    Storstädning
    Engångsstädning
    Extra beställda städinsatser
    Grundlig rengöring av trapphus och gemensamma ytor
    Städning inför eller efter särskilda händelser
    Andra tillfälliga städuppdrag hos våra kunder

Arbetet sker på olika adresser runt om i Stockholm och du kommer att köra mellan uppdragen under arbetsdagen.

Därför är B-körkort ett krav.

Automatkörkort är helt okej.

Du kommer både att arbeta tillsammans med kollegor och självständigt beroende på uppdragets storlek och typ.

Vi söker dig som

    Har B-körkort
    Är noggrann och ser detaljer
    Tar ansvar för ditt arbete
    Passar tider och är pålitlig
    Trivs med ett fysiskt arbete
    Kan arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
    Är flexibel när arbetsdagen och uppdragen varierar
    Talar svenska eller engelska
    Vill arbeta heltid

Erfarenhet från städning är meriterande, men inte ett absolut krav.

För oss är det viktigare att du har rätt inställning, arbetar ordentligt och vill lära dig våra arbetssätt.

Vad du kan förvänta dig hos oss

Hos Optimal Trappstädning får du ett arbete där ingen dag behöver se exakt likadan ut.

Vi erbjuder:

    Heltidsarbete, 100 %
    Varierande arbetsdagar
    Arbete på olika platser i Stockholm
    Introduktion till våra rutiner och arbetsmetoder
    Möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor
    Ett företag där kvalitet och ansvar är viktigt

Om Optimal Trappstädning

Optimal Trappstädning arbetar med trappstädning och fastighetsnära städtjänster åt kunder runt om i Stockholm.

Vi vill att våra kunder ska kunna lita på att arbetet blir utfört ordentligt, på rätt tid och med hög kvalitet.

Därför söker vi personer som är ansvarstagande, noggranna och stolta över sitt arbete.

Ansökan

Skicka in din ansökan och berätta kort om:

    Vem du är
    Om du har arbetat med städning tidigare
    När du kan börja
    Att du har B-körkort

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Välkommen med din ansökan till Optimal Trappstädning!

🇬🇧 Full-time Cleaner for Deep Cleaning and One-Time Assignments – 100%

Optimal Trappstädning is looking for a new full-time employee to work with deep cleaning, extra cleaning and one-time cleaning assignments throughout the Stockholm area.

This position is suitable for someone who enjoys practical work, likes variety and prefers an active working day with different locations and assignments.

This is a full-time, 100% position.

Your Responsibilities

Your main responsibility will be cleaning assignments that are outside our regular recurring stairwell cleaning.

Your work may include:

    Deep cleaning
    One-time cleaning assignments
    Extra cleaning requested by customers
    Thorough cleaning of stairwells and common areas
    Cleaning before or after special events or projects
    Other temporary cleaning assignments

You will work at different locations around Stockholm and drive between assignments during the working day.

For this reason, a Category B driver's license is required.

An automatic-only driver's license is accepted.

Depending on the assignment, you may work together with colleagues or independently.

We Are Looking for Someone Who

    Has a Category B driver's license
    Is careful and pays attention to details
    Takes responsibility for their work
    Is reliable and punctual
    Enjoys physical and active work
    Can work independently as well as in a team
    Is flexible when assignments and daily schedules change
    Speaks Swedish or English
    Wants to work full-time

Previous cleaning experience is an advantage, but it is not required.

For us, the most important things are that you have a good attitude, work carefully and are willing to learn our way of working.

What We Offer

At Optimal Trappstädning, you will have a varied job where your working days can include different types of assignments and locations.

We offer:

    Full-time employment, 100%
    Varied working days
    Work at different locations around Stockholm
    Introduction to our routines and working methods
    The opportunity to work with experienced colleagues
    A workplace where quality and responsibility matter

About Optimal Trappstädning

Optimal Trappstädning provides stairwell cleaning and property-related cleaning services to customers throughout Stockholm.

Our goal is to provide reliable service and consistently high-quality cleaning.

We are therefore looking for employees who are responsible, careful and take pride in doing a good job.

Application

Please send us your application and briefly tell us:

    About yourself
    Whether you have previous cleaning experience
    When you are available to start
    That you have a Category B driver's license

Applications are reviewed continuously.

Welcome to apply and become part of Optimal Trappstädning!

Ung mann på 21 år med godt humør trenger en ringevikar (med mulighet for fast ansettelse) til sin BPA-ordning.

Han er nysgjerrig på livet og ønsker å forstå verden på en annen måte enn folk flest. Han har barneautisme med redusert munnspråk og bruker ASK/bildestøtte. Han har en dagsplan som vi lager hver morgen og bruker gjennom dagen. Han forstår mye og kan snakke med enkle ord om konkrete ting. Følelser og abstrakt språk, er derimot vanskelig for ham å sette ord på. 

Det er viktig at du som BPA, er nysgjerrig og “leser” det han ikke sier med ord, men med sitt kroppsspråk og blikk. Han har fokal epilepsi og det ser ut til at anfallene har et emosjonelt uttrykk, det betyr at han kan få noen høye skrik som varer 2-3 sekunder. Tidvis har han epileptisk aktivitet som kan skremme ham og gjøre ham urolig. Det er da viktig å holde seg rolig og ikke forsøke å snakke ham ned, han vil vise deg når han er klar igjen. Han har krampeanfall med visse mellomrom, og går derfor fast på medisiner. Du som BPA, vil få opplæring i hvordan dette skal håndteres om han får et krampeanfall når du er sammen med ham. Krampeanfall har han heldigvis sjeldent.

jobs.title: Ohjelmapalvelutyöntekijä, TONTTU, Hullu Poro Oy, Levi
jobs.description:
Hullu Poro Oy Levi etsii iloisia ja innostuneita tonttuja osaksi upeaa tiimiämme Elämyskylä Tonttulaan Leville kaudelle 2026-2027 joulukuun ajalle tai koko kaudeksi!

Oletko asiakaspalveluhenkinen, ulkoilmasta ja elämyksistä nauttiva henkilö, joka haluaa levittää joulun taikaa ja hyvää mieltä kansainvälisille ja kotimaisille vieraillemme? Tule mukaan mahdollistamaan unohtumattomia elämyksiä ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä!

Ohjelmapalvelutyö Levi Elämyskylä Tonttula:

Tässä roolissa pääset osaksi Hullu Poro Oy:n legendaarista tiimiä. Työsi painottuu asiakaselämyksien luomiseen ja toteuttamiseen Tonttulan Elämyskylässä, joka tarjoaa monipuolisia ohjelmapalveluita ja jouluisen tunnelman ympäri vuoden. Tarjolla on sekä täysipäiväistä että osa-aikaista tonttutyötä joko joulukuuksi 2026 tai marraskuusta kevätkauden 2027 loppuun saakka. Työaika sovitaan erikseen valitun henkilön kanssa.

Monipuoliset ohjelmapalvelutontun työtehtävät Levillä:

\-Vierailijoiden vastaanottaminen, opastaminen ja viihdyttäminen Elämyskylän alueella

\-Ulkoleikkien, askartelujen ja yhteisöllisten ohjelmien vetäminen kaikenikäisille

\-Elämyspalveluiden avustavat tehtävät, kuten reittien ja välineiden valmistelu

\-Tarvittaessa tiedottaminen, somettaminen ja opastemateriaalien jakaminen

\-Tonttuna esiintyminen Tonttulan, hotellin ja kahvilan tapahtumissa

Millaisen henkilön etsimme ohjelmapalvelutiimiin Leville?

\-Rohkeutta esiintyä ja eläytyä tonttuhahmoon sekä hullutella asiakkaiden iloksi

\-Innostusta toimia sekä lasten että aikuisten kanssa

\-Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja palveluhalukkuutta

\-Joustavuutta työaikojen ja tehtävien suhteen sesonki- ja iltatyö on yleistä

\-Aiempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, ohjelmapalveluista tai esiintymisestä (toivottavaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä)

\-Perustason suomen ja englannin kielitaitoa muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

Mitä tarjoamme ohjelmapalvelutontulle?

\-Mukavan, kannustavan ja avoimen työyhteisön

\-Monipuolisen ja elämyksellisen työympäristön uniikissa elämyskylässä Levillä

\-Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ohjelmapalveluammattilaisena

\-Perehdytyksen tehtävään sekä tuen työn arjessa

\-Apua asunnon etsimisessä Levin alueella

\-Henkilökuntaedut Hullu Poro Oy:n kohteissa

Lähetä hakemus TONTTU -tiimiimme!

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian, paikat täytetään sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Tule mukaan jakamaan joulun taikaa ja rakentamaan elämyksiä

Ohjelmapalvelu TONTTU Hullu Poro Oy, Levi odottaa juuri sinua!

jobs.title: Professor of large animal surgery
jobs.description:
Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science

Department of Clinical Sciences

The Department of Clinical Sciences conducts undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the scientific areas of veterinary medicine and veterinary nursing. We contribute to the continuous development of knowledge about animal health and diseases at both individual and population levels.

The department's activities mainly concern our common Swedish domesticated animal species with a focus on anesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical pathology, medicine and animal reproduction. The University Animal Hospital is an integrated part of the Department of Clinical Sciences.

Read more about our activities and infrastructure https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/clinical-sciences/.



Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU via the following https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/.



Subject description

The subject is large animal surgery with a focus on horses but also includes ruminants and pigs.

Duties

The applicant will be expected to:

    develop and lead internationally successful research;
    develop, lead and participate in teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    develop and maintain national and international networks with academia, the relevant public authorities, industry, organisations and society at large;
    collaborate with other SLU research teams to strengthen interdisciplinary activities at the university;
    apply for external research funding from both national and international sources;
    supervise doctoral students and residents undergoing specialist training;
    actively participate in clinical work and teaching;
    contribute to the strategic development of the department, faculty and SLU;
    communicate research findings and other relevant information to society at large;
    perform administrative duties within the department, faculty and university.

The department uses Swedish and English in parallel. The professor should be able to perform the majority of their tasks in English. However, as a public authority, the university has Swedish as its main language according to the requirements of the Language Act and the professor must be able to use Swedish as their working language within four years of beginning the position. The department will provide support with language learning.

Eligibility

The applicant must

    have a Degree of Master of Science in Veterinary Medicine;
    be licensed to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden, alternatively be entitled to obtain such a licence in accordance with the relevant legislation, regulations and directives*;
    have successfully completed a doctoral degree or have the equivalent academic qualifications, as well as hold the qualifications required for appointment as a docent;
    demonstrate research expertise in the subject;
    demonstrate teaching expertise and have the ability to integrate research and a scientific approach into their teaching;
    have proven clinical experience in a subject field relevant to the position;
    have good knowledge of English.

*Act (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/lag-2009302-om-verksamhet-inom-djurens-halso-_sfs-2009-302#K3) on Activities within Animal Healthcare, Chapter 3. Eligibility regulations.

jobs.title: Produktionsleder med energi og lyst til at gøre en forskel hos Elfac A/S
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for mennesker, produktion og udvikling?

Hos Elfac handler produktion om mere end maskiner, processer og leveringstider.


Det handler om mennesker. Om samarbejde. Om faglighed. Og om hele tiden at finde nye måder at gøre tingene lidt bedre på.


Vi har korte kommandoveje, en flad organisation og arbejder tæt sammen i hverdagen. Her er der ikke langt fra idé til handling – og som vores nye Produktionsleder får du mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på både produktionen og din egen fremtid.
Vi er i udvikling og vi håber, du har lyst til at være med!

Din vigtigste opgave? At skabe godt flow.

Som Produktionsleder bliver du en central del af den daglige drift og udvikling af vores produktion.
Du skal naturligvis sikre, at kvalitet, levering og planlægning fungerer. Men mindst lige så vigtigt bliver det, at du kan samle og motivere mennesker.
Hos os arbejder mange forskellige personligheder og fagligheder sammen. Derfor leder vi efter en synlig og nærværende leder, der kan kommunikere med mennesker, skabe tillid og få teamet til at arbejde i samme retning. Du ved, at godt produktionsflow ikke kun handler om processer.

Det handler også om mennesker.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Lede og motivere medarbejderne i produktionen

  • Sikre et godt flow og en effektiv hverdag

  • Arbejde med kvalitet, levering og løbende forbedringer

  • Optimere processer og arbejdsgange

  • Skabe struktur og overblik

  • Være synlig og nærværende i produktionen

  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Elfac

Du har teknisk forståelse – og mennesker betyder noget for dig

Du kommer måske fra en stilling som produktionsleder, værkfører, teamleder eller lignende. Det vigtigste er ikke din titel.
Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring fra produktion og forstår, hvad der skal til for at skabe et velfungerende flow.
Du har teknisk forståelse og gerne flair for håndværket. Samtidig har du lyst til at arbejde med mennesker og motiveres af at få både medarbejdere og produktion til at udvikle sig.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en produktionsvirksomhed

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller et naturligt lederskab

  • Har teknisk forståelse og flair for produktion

  • Kan skabe struktur og overblik

  • Trives med mange forskellige typer mennesker

  • Har energi og lyst til at gøre tingene bedre

  • Er en leder, der går foran – og samtidig står sammen med dit team

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Vi kan tilbyde dig en spændende lederrolle i en virksomhed, hvor du får mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel.
Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med dygtige kolleger, høj faglighed og en kultur, hvor vi vil hinanden.

Hos Elfac får du:

  • Korte kommandoveje og en flad organisation

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og ledelse

  • Stor mulighed for indflydelse

  • En hverdag tæt på produktionen og menneskerne

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Frihed til at sætte dit eget præg på rollen og din fremtid

Vi søger ikke bare en leder, der kan holde produktionen i gang.
Vi søger en person med energi, ambitioner og lyst til at være med til at gøre en forskel.

Er det dig?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.
EliteRekruttering varetager rekrutteringsprocessen

Men har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Operations manager Maria Steenberg Jessen på:
Mail: msj@elfac.dk Telefon: 22 62 86 82

Elfac A/S

Elfac er Danmarks førende underleverandør af ledningskonfektion og forbindelsesteknik og har p.t. 100 medarbejdere. Hos Elfac lægges der vægt på rummelighed og et godt fysisk arbejdsmiljø,samtidig med at der fokuseres på leveringssikkerhed, kvalitet og effektivitet i alle led. Hos Elfac har vi én – og kun én – målsætning: at sikre vores kunder den helt rigtige løsning.

Derfor arbejder vi udfra metoden The Elfac Way, der ganske enkelt består af tre faser DEFINE – DESIGN – DELIVER. Elfacer beliggende i Silkeborg, ejet af den svenske koncern Lagercrantz Group AB.

jobs.title: Kitchen assistant, kitchen help - or trained chef
jobs.description:
Attention ladies & gents in Aarhus, or close by  

We are looking for a chef - kitchen assistant or kitchenhelp to our french bistro.

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly busy.  

Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have.

Klassisk Bistro 65, being the characteristic charming French bistro   https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Who we are;

We are a wonderful diverse team in nationalities and cultures, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organisation is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We are looking for the following staff;

Experienced chefs, that have years behind a stow and is used to busy and high pressure service. You are able to keep calm, move fast, make nice food & keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

Kitchen help, that have min. 6 months experience working in kitchens, helping out with prep for service as well as helping out as a waiter. You are willing to do a lot of helpful stuff when getting ready for service.

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. 

Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in following the company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company. We expect of you to be responsible and meet on time and not report sick every second day due to hangovers.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid)

·       We teach you, first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       Chance to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli

·       Maybe you join our restaurant Smukfisk at SmukFest festival in Skanderborg

·       Chance to participate in Danish Oyester Cup, when we attend this event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay untill your shift ends at night. Its a non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role & if you seek parttime or full time.

If your headder is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

**The opportunity**

We are now looking for a Technical Support Engineer at Hitachi Energy, Grid Automation business in Vaasa, Finland.

In this role you will be responsible for providing advanced global technical support, troubleshooting, and consultation for MicroSCADA customers and internal stakeholders. The role focuses on analyzing complex customer cases, identifying root causes, resolving application and configuration issues, and ensuring reliable system performance. The position requires strong technical ownership, close collaboration with R&D, Service, project teams, and customer-facing organizations, and a customer-oriented mindset to deliver high-quality support and guidance.

**How you'll make an impact**

\- Analyze complex customer cases to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.

\- Investigate application issues, system malfunctions, and configuration-related challenges to ensure reliable system performance.

\- Provide advanced technical support through our customer support portal, delivering timely and professional assistance.

\- Advise customers and internal teams on software and firmware updates, patch management, system optimization, and best practices.

\- Perform technical validations, proof-of-concept testing, and customer demonstrations to support new solutions and product enhancements.

\- Deliver technical training sessions for customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders.

\- Develop and continuously improve training materials and supporting resources to reflect evolving products, features, and customer needs.

\- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues, sharing lessons learned, and proposing enhancements.

**Your background**

\- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or a related technical field.

\- Strong experience in technical support, SCADA engineering, application engineering, commissioning, or a similar technical role.

\- Solid hands-on experience with MicroSCADA systems is required.

\- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.

\- Excellent collaboration skills, including experience working with international and cross-functional teams.

\- Strong ownership mindset, assertiveness, and accountability for assigned tasks and customer issues.

\- Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

\- Willingness to travel occasionally based on business and customer needs.

Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Product Management Director – Soft FM & Estates (UK)
jobs.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.

Role Scope

People Leadership & Team Development:

  • Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

  • Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits.

  • Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

  • Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

  • Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

Product Discovery & Strategy:

  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

  • Decide where to invest and where to hold: set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

  • Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

  • Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

Product Management Best Practices & Standards:

  • Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development.

  • Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis.

  • Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

  • Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination:

  • Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

  • Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

  • Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group.

Experience & Requirements

Must have's:

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

  • At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start.

  • Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you.

  • Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development, using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery.

  • Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps.

  • Strong commercial awareness: able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals.

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication: able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.
- Excellent communication skills in English.

Desirable:

- Experience with optimisation, simulation, econometrics, or data analysis applied to energy or market data.
- Knowledge of data centre operations, computing infrastructure, or ICT energy use (Theme B).

jobs.title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

Nous vous proposons un emploi varié qui comporte des contacts réguliers avec nos administrations clientes. Notre équipe est dynamique et ouverte à l'innovation. Le candidat pourra contribuer au développement de l'administration en ligne. Profil Compétences techniques Compétences en matier/ière d'analyse fonctionnelle et technique (rédaction de cahier des charges, spécifications fonctionnelles, maquettage, modélisation de flux, etc); Compétences gestion de projet ou assistance à la maitrise d'ouvrage; Compétences en assurance de la qualité appliquée aux logiciels; Maîtrise approfondie du français ainsi qu'une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais; Capacité rédactionnelle; Capacité de reporting: Savoir analyser et transposer la législation et la réglementation du domaine concerné à un système d'information; Capacité d'encadrement et de gestion d'une équipe. jobs.title: Développeur(eur/euse) SAP Fiori UI5 + ABAP (H/F)
jobs.description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. PROFIL De formation supérieure en informatique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans le développement SAP et souhaitez évoluer sur des projets techniques à forte valeur ajoutée. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des environnements SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance des CDS Views ; Connaissance du modèle RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model) ; Expérience avec SAP BTP ; Expérience sur des projets de migration, d'intégration ou d'évolution SAP ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques de développement SAP. Par la nature transversale de vos missions, vous ferez le lien entre les équipes techniques spécialisées, les fournisseurs de solutions IT et les nombreur/euses parties prenant/antes impliquées. jobs.title: Concepteur d'offres de formation (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)

jobs.title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
jobs.description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Intéressé(e) ? jobs.title: Cartographe (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Network Engineer to operate and develop our network infrastructure across multiple data centres.

Responsibilities
Configure, monitor, and maintain network equipment.
Troubleshoot network incidents and connectivity issues.
Perform planned maintenance and participate in emergency recovery.
Handle technical requests from customers and internal teams.
Support network expansion, new location deployments, and automation projects.
Maintain network documentation and configuration records.
Requirements
At least three years of relevant networking experience.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN technologies.
Practical understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and network redundancy.
Ability to diagnose routing, switching, latency, and packet-loss issues.
Experience configuring network equipment through CLI.
English at Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Extreme Networks, Nokia, or Brocade equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS.
Experience in telecommunications or data-centre networking.
Familiarity with Python, Ansible, APIs, or other automation tools.

Communicate with external providers and relevant Slovak authorities.

Requirements
At least two years of experience in HR administration, recruitment, or an HR generalist role.
Understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining personnel records.
Basic knowledge of Slovak employment legislation and administrative requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage several priorities and work independently.
Confident use of Excel, Google Sheets, and standard office applications.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Good command of Slovak.

Nice to have
Experience in an international or IT company.
Experience with HRIS or applicant-tracking systems.
Familiarity with immigration, relocation, and work-permit processes.
Experience working with contractors and external service providers.

jobs.title: Technici počítačových sietí a systémov
jobs.description:
In this role, you will
Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.
Implement network changes related to customer services and internal infrastructure.
Configure VLANs, physical and logical interfaces, link aggregation, and other network services.
Prepare technical tasks for on-site engineers installing, replacing, or reconnecting equipment.
Coordinate planned maintenance and infrastructure work with data-centre representatives.
Verify completed work and confirm that network services operate correctly after changes.
Handle provisioning requests from internal teams and customers.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and configuration issues related to provisioning activities.
Escalate complex incidents and technical risks to Network Engineering or Network Operations.
Communicate with carriers, data centres, and other service providers regarding technical matters.
Participate in projects involving network expansion, new data-centre locations, and equipment deployment.
Maintain network documentation, equipment records, configuration templates, and internal instructions.
Contribute to the automation and standardization of routine provisioning processes.
Follow established change-management, security, and documentation procedures.
Requirements
At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Practical knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

PRACOVNÍ NÁPLŇ:
1. Ovládá práce na strojním zařízení – myčce nádobí a skla dle typu, který je používán. Myje ručně.
2. Provádí čištění a třídění zeleniny, brambor a ovoce dle pokynů nadřízeného a tyto ukládá na místo k tomu určenému.
3. Provádí úklid kuchyňských prostor – varna, příruční sklady, umývárna nádobí ( bílá, černá), škrábárna zeleniny a brambor, spojovací chodby a schodiště do skladu dle pokynů nadřízeného.
4. Provádí mytí a dezinfekci černého nádobí. Dezinfekci bílého nádobí provádí 2x měsíčně.

6. Pravidelně vykonává sanitární úklid všech prostor kuchyně, chladicích a mrazicích zařízení a příručních skladů.
7. Zabezpečuje ukládání kuchyňských zbytků do nádob a prostor k tomu určených.
8. Provádí další manipulaci se surovinami ( dle pokynů vedoucího směny ), které předá k dalšímu zpracování do kuchyně.
9. Dodržuje hygienické (HACCAP) a požární předpisy. Dále pak předpisy BOZP.
10. Provádí úklid restaurace.
11. Provádí úklid chodby suterénu hotelu, šaten stravovacího úseku (pánská i dámská), samostatné toalety v suterénu hotelu.
