jobs.title: ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntija, yli 12kk
jobs.description:
Varmista automaation ja uusien ICT-palveluiden katkeamaton arki sote-ympäristössä!

Työelämän paras aikaa odottaa sinua Keusotessa!

Etsimme kokenutta ja palvelunhallinnan (ITIL) salat tuntevaa asiantuntijaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään palvelukokonaisuuksien suunnitteluun.

ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntijana tulet toimimaan tietohallinnon ICT-palveluiden yksikössä, jossa roolisi on kriittinen: varmistat, että Keusoten suuren 10 miljoonan euron investointiohjelman tuottamat uudet teknologiat ja automaatiot laskeutuvat jatkuvaan tuotantoon hallitusti, vikasietoisesti ja elinkaarikestävästi.

Tässä roolissa toimit tiiviinä työparina kehityspuolen Ratkaisuarkkitehdille sekä jatkuvien palveluiden ICT- asiantuntijoille, tuoden palvelumuotoilun ja operatiivisen tehokkuuden näkökulman uuden teknologian jalkauttamiseen.

ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntijana tuot "Ops"-näkökulman suoraan kehityshankkeiden ytimeen. Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, ettei uusi älykäs automaatio (kuten AI-toiminnot, edistynyt ohjelmistorobotiikka ja integraatiot) jää irralliseksi, vaan sen tuomat tuottavuushyödyt ulosmitataan sote-palvelutoiminnassa täysimääräisesti sujuvan, vakaan ja loppukäyttäjälle optimoidun palvelutuotannon kautta.

Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:

- Automaation tuotantoon vienti ja vakauttaminen: Vastaat siitä, että kehityshankkeiden automaatioratkaisut (esim. ServiceNow tai tekoäly) siirtyvät tuotantoon luotettavasti ja ilman manuaalista häiriönhallinnan tarvetta.
- Palveluarkkitehtuurin suunnittelu: Määrittelet ja varmistat yhdessä ict-palveluarkkitehtien kanssa, että uudet järjestelmät täyttävät jatkuvien palveluiden laatuvaatimukset, kuten valvonta-, tuki-, dokumentaatio- ja elinkaarimallit.
- Hankintojen palveluvaatimukset: Osallistut suurten ICT-kilpailutusten (kuten talous-, HR- ja asianhallintajärjestelmät) valmisteluun asettamalla toimittajille tiukat ylläpito-, jatkuvuus- ja palvelutasovaatimukset (SLA).
- Asiantuntijayksikön tekninen tuki: Toimit ICT-asiantuntijoiden ja järjestelmävastaavien teknisenä sparrauskumppanina monimutkaisissa ongelmanratkaisutilanteissa sekä palveluiden muutoshallinnassa (Change Management).

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietotekniikka tai tietojärjestelmätiede) sekä vahva käytännön kokemus laajojen IT-palvelukokonaisuuksien ja palveluarkkitehtuurin hallinnasta.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

Olet luonteeltasi siltoja rakentava asiantuntija, joka ymmärtää sekä modernin IT-arkkitehtuurin mahdollisuudet että arjen sujuvan palvelutuotannon ja loppukäyttäjän tarpeet.

- Substanssiosaaminen: Syvällinen IT-palvelunhallinnan (ITIL) viitekehyksen ja prosessien tuntemus. Hyvä tekninen ymmärrys pilvipalveluista, integraatioista (API) sekä automaatioratkaisujen (RPA/AI) operatiivisesta ylläpidosta.
- Järjestelmäosaaminen: Erinomainen hallinta palvelunhallinnan työkaluista (ITSM) sekä strategiamme mukaisesti Google-ekosysteemin laajamittainen osaaminen.
- Vuorovaikutustaidot: Erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot. Kyky toimia tulkkina ja koordinaattorina kehityksen, jatkuvien palveluiden asiantuntijoiden sekä ulkopuolisten toimittajien välillä.

Lisätiedot tehtävästä antaa ICT-aluepäällikkö Saku Salonen, p. 040 304 7040, saku.salonen@keusote.fi

Lisätiedot palvelussuhteesta sekä tehtävään esitettävät selvitykset

- Määräaikainen palvelussuhde ajalle 1.1.2027-31.12.2028.
- Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4930,86 e/kk. Maksamme työkokemukseen perustuvaa lisää.
- Tehtävässä noudatetaan koeaikaa.
- Alkuperäiset työ- ja opiskelutodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

Hakuaika päättyy 17.9.2026 klo 14.00.

jobs.title: Myyjä, päivittäistavaraosasto, Prisma Mylly, Raisio, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAISIO

Prisma Mylly etsii tiimiinsä MYYJIÄ päivittäistavaraosastolle!
Tehtävät ovat määräaikaisia ja osa-aikaisia 10-30 tuntia viikossa. Työt aloitetaan sopimuksen mukaan ja määräaikaisuudet sijoittuvat 31.8.2027 asti.

Myymälän arki on vauhdikasta ja täynnä erilaisia kohtaamisia, ja meille tärkeintä on, että jokainen asiakas lähtee meiltä hyvällä fiiliksellä. Päivittäistavaraosasto on suurin osasto, ja valikoimaan kuuluvat muun muassa tuoreet hedelmät ja vihannekset, liha-, kala- ja maitotuotteet, valmisruoat, säilykkeet, panimotuotteet ja kosmetiikka. Osastolla huolehditaan, että tuotteet ovat aina saatavilla, tuoreita ja siististi esillä. Päivittäistavaraosastoon kuuluu myös palvelutori, jossa käsitellään tuoreita liha- ja kalatuotteita sekä valmisruokia.

Työpäivät koostuvat monipuolisista tehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, hyllytystyöstä, verkkokaupan keräilystä, esillepanojen rakentamisesta sekä myymälän siisteydestä huolehtimisesta. Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Tehtävä edellyttää myös valmiutta työskennellä kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti kello 5.00-23.00 välillä. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Millaisia tyyppejä etsimme?

Olet etsimämme tyyppi, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta, nautit työskentelystä myymäläympäristössä ja asiakkaan tervehtiminen tulee sinulta luonnostaan. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä, sekä kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä.

Myyjän palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta-, yö- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän tiimiin, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

💚 Ihan tavallisia töitä epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %.

💚 Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa.

💚 Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin Prisma-myymälöissä sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella.

💚 Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet.

Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 13.9. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞 Lisätietoja antaa Prismajohtaja Eero Saurus. Eeron tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 9-15 numerosta 010764 4020.


Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

Ben jij iemand die makkelijk schakelt tussen klanten, partners en collega's? En krijg je energie van het verbeteren van processen, het bouwen aan sterke samenwerkingen en het verder ontwikkelen van een internationaal netwerk? Dan hebben we bij Van Duuren een mooie uitdaging voor je.
Als Groupage Manager krijg je alle ruimte om ons Europese groupagenetwerk verder uit te bouwen. Je werkt samen met klanten en partners, denkt mee over slimme oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat onze dienstverlening iedere dag een beetje beter wordt. jobs.description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

jobs.title: MSCA-DN PhD in zebrafish models for leukodystrophies (York, UK)
jobs.description:
Develop robust preclinical outcome measures in zebrafish models of leukodystrophies. Combine behavioural studies and advanced imaging to improve disease modelling and bridge the gap between experimental findings and clinically meaningful outcomes. POLARIS doctoral network POLARIS is a European Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network focused on accelerating therapy development for leukodystrophies: rare genetic disorders affecting the brain’s white matter. The network aims to strengthen the full translational pathway, from understanding disease mechanisms and developing disease models to preclinical therapy testing, clinical readiness and patient-informed treatment priorities. To achieve this, POLARIS brings together expertise in leukodystrophy biology, advanced disease models, therapeutic innovation, biomarker development, clinical translation, patient engagement, and ethical, regulatory and health-economic aspects of therapy development. The network will train a cohort of doctoral candidates in an international and interdisciplinary environment, combining academic research, industry-based preclinical development, secondments, network-wide training and transferable-skills development. PhD project For this position, the recruiting organisation is the University of York, UK. The selected candidate will be employed by the University of York and become part of the POLARIS consortium, with academic supervision and disease-specific expertise provided by Dr Noémie Hamilton at the York Biomedical Research Institute and the Department of Biology at the University of York. You will focus on developing and standardising robust preclinical outcome measures across multiple zebrafish models of leukodystrophy, including models of RNASET2 deficiency, adrenoleukodystrophy (ALD), Krabbe disease and metachromatic leukodystrophy (MLD). Zebrafish are widely used to model leukodystrophies because of their genetic tractability and the ability to study early brain development. To

strengthen their use as preclinical models, this project will develop outcome measures that are robust, reproducible and relevant to assessments used in patients and mammalian disease models. Your research will combine different approaches to: Develop and standardise behavioural assays across multiple zebrafish models of leukodystrophy. Characterise disease phenotypes using multimodal imaging and complementary experimental approaches. Apply advanced imaging techniques, including MRI, high-resolution confocal microscopy and electron microscopy. Develop and refine imaging analysis pipelines, using appropriate software, quantitative approaches and innovative analytical methods. Compare and benchmark preclinical outcomes across different disease models and against clinically relevant measures. Identify robust and reproducible readouts that can support the use of zebrafish in preclinical therapy development. Work collaboratively across different research environments, integrating findings from zebrafish models with data from mammalian models and other experimental systems. As part of the POLARIS training programme, you will undertake planned secondments that complement your research at the University of York. At Zantiks, you will gain hands-on experience with behavioural analysis equipment and software and learn how ideas emerging from academic research can be developed towards commercial application. You will also undertake a secondment at the University of Liverpool’s Centre for Preclinical Imaging, a leading preclinical imaging centre with access to advanced technologies including MRI, PET, CT, SPECT, ultrasound, photoacoustic imaging, magnetic particle imaging (MPI), optical imaging and hyperthermia. These technologies can be applied across a range of experimental models, including cells, organoids, Drosophila, zebrafish and rodents. jobs.title: PHD Position
jobs.description:
Interested in understanding how communities try to access their rights and seek justice in the city? Keen to test your qualitative research skills and try out experimental methods? Then apply for this PhD project which will explore how urban residents and civil society groups defend, shape and reinvent the rule of law from below in their interactions with municipal authorities.
Rule of Law from below- urban rights and justice mobilization
In the wake of global trends of democratic backsliding, many are concerned with the resilience of the democratic rule of law including in The Netherlands. Studies focusing on formal institutions at the national level point to weak safeguards protecting the independence of courts, declining democratic oversight, and insufficient protection of fundamental rights. Significant groups of citizens, particularly those in vulnerable situations who rely most on state support to enjoy their rights and dignity, are losing trust in government institutions to deliver on their promises. While trust in local institutions in Amsterdam is higher, this is lower among city residents with a migrant background and/or in socioeconomically weaker positions.
Cities can play an important role in defending the rule of law and protecting and realizing the rights of citizens . Research on human rights cities and urban governance has shown how actors inside local governments refer to international human rights norms, for instance to justify local policies that extend protection to vulnerable groups beyond national law or policy or to develop more participatory forms of decision-making. Cities have also been found to promote human rights and democratic values through transnational city networks. Amsterdam
Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe's electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! We are building a network of 1,000 fast-charging stations across Europe, and we are looking for a Senior Project Development Manager to help us get there.Together with 400+ colleagues from over 40 nationalities, spread across 10 countries, we drive change in the energy transition. Our stations provide fast, seamless charging experiences, allowing drivers to charge their EVs in minutes, not hours. As a leading provider of ultra-fast charging, we're focused on delivering exceptional service and innovation to accelerate the transition to electric mobility - and it all starts with securing the best locations. You will translate strategic objectives, market insights and operational learnings into clear project plans, milestones and deliverables, and coordinate their execution across relevant teams and countries. Becoming a care entrepreneur at De Drie Notenboomen
As a franchise organisation, we support care entrepreneurs in starting, taking over, and running a location. This includes guidance, training, coaching, quality assurance, real estate, and communications.
What is care entrepreneurship?
Care entrepreneurship is different from being an employee. As a care entrepreneur, you direct the daily care, your team, and your own business-for Herbergier and Thomashuis, together with your life partner. You operate within a proven care concept while also bringing your own knowledge and experience to the role. For Herbergier and Thomashuis, you and your partner also live on-site in a private apartment.
Care entrepreneurs consciously choose small-scale living, personal attention, and responsibility. They know their residents well and stay close to their team, relatives, and day-to-day operations. While they receive advice and support from DDN as franchisor, they are ultimately responsible for running their location.
Please visit the websites for Herbergier, Thomashuis, Zorgbutler, and Thomas Op Kamers to find out more. There you will find details on requirements, available locations, and upcoming webinars you can attend. HB ZOs Dussen

Weet jij hoe je als leidinggevende een team professionals verder kan ontwikkelen? En ben jij een echte verbinder? Waterschap Hollandse Delta is op zoek naar een enthousiaste Teamleider.
Wat ga je doen
Als Teamleider Veiligheid & Crisisbeheersing geef je leiding aan een vakgebied dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen, positioneren en professionaliseren van veiligheid binnen de organisatie. Daarbij gaat het om de veiligheid van mensen en objecten, de crisisorganisatie en de voorbereiding op incidenten en calamiteiten.

Daarbij werk je voor vanuit de principes van het Three Lines of Defense-model. De verantwoordelijkheid voor veiligheid ligt primair bij de lijnorganisatie: medewerkers, teamleiders en managers zijn eigenaar van de risico's binnen hun werkgebied. Het team Veiligheid & Crisisbeheersing vervult de tweede lijn door kaders te ontwikkelen, te adviseren, te ondersteunen en te monitoren. Jij helpt de organisatie om deze verantwoordelijkheden goed in te vullen, zonder deze over te nemen. Voor Crisisbeheersing ligt daarnaast de verantwoordelijkheid voor de bemensing en bekwaamheid van de crisisorganisatie bij het team.
Je doet dit onder andere door een samenhangende visie op veiligheid en crisisbeheersing te ontwikkelen en implementeren. jobs.description:
Upforce history
Founded: 1997
Employees: 10
Temporary workers: 500
SEP Peeters Oirlo
The employment agency SEP Peeters Oirlo was founded in 1997 when it started sending out Polish temporary workers, but the name SEP Peeters was already active in the poultry industry in the early 1980s. The need for additional labour was so great that in 1997 it was decided to move over as a temporary employment agency alongside services in the poultry industry. From 2000, the service provision within the poultry industry was stopped and SEP Peeters switched completely to the temping of labour.
SEP Peeters was based in Oirlo and from here around 600 temporary workers were put to work. Before 1997, only in the poultry industry, but this quickly changed to various sectors such as logistics, production, distribution and construction. SEP Peeters, besides posting temporary workers, also arranged accommodation, transport, insurance and necessary documentation.
In addition to completely unburdening its customers as well as staff, SEP Peeters' strength was communication, openness and listening to the wants and needs. This is why SEP Peeters was good at retaining both its customers and staff and many of these customers still work with Upforce.
Verbeek employment agency
Verbeek temporary employment agency was founded by Jac Verbeek in 1998. The origin of the agency was in Jac Verbeek's horticulture company, where he offered seasonal work to Eastern European employees. From his own experience in horticulture, the idea arose to offer these workers to other companies in the region.
In the early years, Eastern European workers were mainly used for seasonal work. Over time, Verbeek Temporary Employment Agency evolved and the model was expanded to fully staffing. The agency grew steadily and employed about 10 workers during that period.
Verbeek temporary employment agency played a vital role in various sectors, including logistics, food, manufacturin...

jobs.title: MSCA-DN PhD position in gene therapy for leukodystrophies (Amsterdam, NL)
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute to the development of gene therapies for rare neurological diseases? Join the POLARIS doctoral network and work on innovative gene therapy approaches for leukodystrophies in an international and interdisciplinary research environment. POLARIS doctoral network POLARIS is a European Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network focused on accelerating therapy development for leukodystrophies: rare genetic disorders affecting the brain's white matter. The network aims to strengthen the full translational pathway, from understanding disease mechanisms and developing disease models to preclinical therapy testing, clinical readiness and patient-informed treatment priorities. To achieve this, POLARIS brings together expertise in leukodystrophy biology, advanced disease models, therapeutic innovation, biomarker development, clinical translation, patient engagement, and ethical, regulatory and health-economic aspects of therapy development. The network will train a cohort of doctoral candidates in an international and interdisciplinary environment, combining academic research, industry-based preclinical development, secondments, network-wide training and transferable-skills development. PhD project For this position, the recruiting organisation is Amsterdam UMC, in the Netherlands. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC and embedded in the POLARIS consortium. Academic supervision and disease-specific expertise will be provided by Dr Niek van Til at the Amsterdam Leukodystrophy Center (ALC). This doctoral project focuses on the preclinical assessment of gene therapy approaches in leukodystrophy mouse models for vanishing white matter disease (VWM) and metachromatic leukodystrophy (MLD). You will investigate the efficacy and safety of AAV gene therapy in VWM and MLD mouse models. In addition, you will use genome-editing approaches, including bridgeRNA-guided recombinases, to investigate therapeutic efficacy. The project requires relevant experience in

molecular techniques and an interest in responsible and scientifically robust use of mouse models in translational research. Planned secondments will provide hands-on experience in the production of gene therapy vectors and with the Vereniging voor Innovatieve Geneesmiddelen (VIG), where you will contribute to evaluating access pathways for advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs). Your academic embedding will be at the Amsterdam Leukodystrophy Center, with the anticipated PhD defence at the Faculty of Medicine, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. As a doctoral candidate, you will contribute to the preclinical development of gene therapy approaches for leukodystrophies. Your work includes: testing the efficacy and safety of AAV gene therapy in VWM and MLD mouse models; applying genome-editing approaches, including bridgeRNA-guided recombinases, to investigate therapeutic efficacy; using molecular techniques and in vivo mouse models to investigate disease mechanisms and treatment responses; analysing and interpreting experimental results and considering how preclinical readouts can be aligned with clinically meaningful outcomes; collaborating with colleagues at Amsterdam UMC and POLARIS partner organisations and participating in network-wide training activities and planned secondments. You will be part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment. Throughout the PhD project, you will have opportunities to further develop your scientific and transferable skills through the POLARIS doctoral training programme. We are looking for a motivated candidate with a Master's degree in life sciences, molecular sciences or a related discipline. A background in molecular sciences is particularly relevant to this project. You have relevant research experience and an interest in translational neuroscience and rare disease research. Experience

jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is looking for a Workday Integration Specialist to own the design, build, and maintenance of integrations between Workday and our wider systems landscape (TA, Reward, Payroll, Absence, Finance, and third-party tools). You'll work alongside the People Technology and module teams to keep data flowing accurately and securely across the platform and help extend Workday's capabilities beyond its native functionality.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

  • Design, build, and support Workday integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and Workday APIs (SOAP/REST)

  • Develop and maintain custom reports via RaaS (Report-as-a-Service) to serve downstream systems and stakeholders

  • Build and extend business processes using Workday Extend to digitise offline or manual processes

  • Troubleshoot integration failures, including security/permission issues, data mapping errors, and connectivity problems

  • Manage integration security: ISU setup, OAuth scopes, domain security policies, and API client configuration

  • Partner with module teams (HCM, Absence, Compensation) and system owners (Finance, IT, Workforce Management) to gather integration requirements

  • Maintain integration documentation, including field mappings and process flows

  • Support data migration validation and spot-check processes for ongoing data loads

  • Monitor integration health and proactively flag/resolve recurring errors

Minimum Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building Workday integrations using EIB, Connectors, and Studio

  • Working knowledge of Workday RaaS and calculated fields

  • Experience with Workday Extend (building or supporting custom applications)

  • Understanding of Workday security model (domains, business processes, ISUs, OAuth)

  • API integration experience (REST/SOAP), including troubleshooting auth and permission errors

  • Comfortable working across HR, Finance, and IT stakeholder groups

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating Workday with ATS (e.g. Ashby), payroll (ADP), Microsoft Entra, benefits platforms (Thanksben)

  • Exposure to Workday Studio advanced transformations (XSLT)

  • Experience with data migration projects (e.g. legacy HRIS to Workday)

  • Workday Pro certification in Integrations or Extend

Why this Role

You'll join at a live, post-go-live stage of Workday's evolution at Neko Health, meaning your work has immediate visibility and impact, not years of legacy debt to untangle first.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

As an Engineering Manager, you are accountable for both leading the team and shipping outcomes. Your primary focus is building a team that executes well: setting clear direction, coaching engineers and tech leads, and ensuring work moves from idea to production reliably and at pace.

You stay close to the codebase. While this is not a full-time individual contributor role, you actively review meaningful changes, pair on complex problems, and step in on high-impact or time-sensitive work when needed. You understand the system deeply enough to make good technical calls, unblock the team, and raise the quality bar through example.

You run a team that owns what it builds. That means turning ambiguity into plans, plans into delivery, and delivery into real-world impact. You work tightly with Product, Design, and Operations to make tradeoffs explicit and keep the team focused on what matters most.

You continuously raise standards across developer velocity, code quality, observability, incident response, user analytics, and product engagement. When things break, you’re involved. When execution slows, you diagnose the root cause. When the bar needs to move, you move it.

You also grow the team by hiring strong engineers, giving direct and timely feedback, running a fair performance process, and helping people grow in ways that compound over time.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

  • You’re comfortable spending most of your time leading and enabling others, while still being willing, and able, to dive into the work when it matters.

  • You take full ownership of outcomes and don’t wait for permission to improve things.

  • You care deeply about the people using and operating the systems you build: couriers, retailers, operatives, teammates, and consumers.

  • You do well in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and bring structure through action, not ceremony.

  • You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, listen carefully, and collaborate deliberately.

  • You’ll take on any problem, technical or otherwise, if it unblocks the team or improves results.

Fast and Focused Hiring Process

  1. Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 min

  2. Hiring Manager Interview - 60 min

  3. Technical Interview - 2 hours

  4. Values & Impact Interview - 1 hour

  5. Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

jobs.title: Legal Engineer (Privacy & Compliance)
jobs.description:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

We're hiring a Legal Engineer to help build out privacy and compliance as a brand new product vertical for Wordsmith, from the ground up.

This role spans privacy and compliance more generally - building products for customers, supporting pre-sales, and creating the global AI tools that power them. Its centre of gravity is privacy and compliance, but with the scope to be involved in wider regulatory, governance and legal use-cases, so comfort and curiosity across these areas is a must.

Because this is a new product vertical for Wordsmith, we're seeking someone who is genuinely excited to build it out from scratch. This is a mid-to-senior role for someone who can work independently and with our Head of Privacy - scoping a problem, building the solution and standing in front of a customer without hand-holding.

What you'll do

  • Build privacy and compliance products — translate messy legal, privacy and compliance requirements into structured, workable solutions that an AI agent can execute.

  • Own the product vertical — shape privacy, compliance and beyond, as a brand new part of the Wordsmith platform, with real autonomy over how it's built.

  • Support pre-sales — sit in front of customers, understand their problems, and build or demonstrate solutions that solve them.

  • Apply the compliance landscape — bring privacy law knowledge and/or the wider regulatory, governanance and compliance landscape, (eg Financial Services compliance or AI Governance), to real customer problems.

  • Extend into general legal work — build more general legal products when the work calls for it, beyond the core privacy and compliance focus.

  • Build with AI, not code — use Wordsmith's own platform to build solutions, with no coding required, but a confident, hands-on understanding of what today's AI can and can't do.


What we're looking for

  • Deep privacy and compliance knowledge, with a strong command of privacy law and/or the wider compliance picture — AI governance, security or specific areas such as financial regulation or employment law.

  • Either a qualified lawyer or a privacy/compliance specialist with real depth in the field, comfortable working across adjacent legal areas when the work calls for it.

  • Strong AI literacy — comfortable using and reasoning about AI tools day to day, with a clear understanding of what today's AI can and can't do, and able to build with it.

  • A builder's mindset — able to take a messy legal, privacy or compliance requirement and turn it into something structured and workable.

  • Client-facing confidence — able to sit in front of customers, understand their legal and compliance problems, and build or demonstrate solutions, including in pre- and post-sales settings.

  • Several years of experience in privacy law or compliance practice, ideally at a mid-to-senior level, with the proactivity to work independently.


Desirable, but not essential

  • Experience in legal tech, RegTech or a SaaS environment.

  • Breadth across the compliance landscape, such as security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), AI governance regimes (EU AI Act) or broader GRC.

  • Awareness of, or exposure to, broader legal practice beyond privacy and compliance.

  • Some hands-on building experience — prompt design, workflow automation, low-code tools or similar.

How we work

We're an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. You'll work closely with Sales, Product and Engineering as you build this vertical, with the autonomy to scope your own problems and build your own solutions.

Why Wordsmith

You'll be the first person building out privacy, compliance and regulatory as a product vertical at Wordsmith — a ground-floor opportunity to shape it from scratch, at one of the defining companies in legal AI.

Because we're building in a new technical category, the problems are interesting and genuinely unsolved. You'll have real autonomy over how this part of the platform is built, and the opportunity to grow it as it scales.

jobs.title: Brand Designer, Creative Studio
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



This role sits on Notion’s Creative Studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. Our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side.



As a Brand Designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. You’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Concept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels.

 - Contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work.

 - A strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels.

 - A deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details.

 - Experience working with a broad range of makers. You’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life.

 - Excellent partnership skills. You can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.

 - A tinkerer’s mindset. You're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how AI can expand creative expression and drive production. You’ll actively experiment with new AI workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:

- Miejski Ośrodek Pomocy Społecznej w Katowicach Katowice, ul. Wita Stwosza 7 - Dyrektor Miejskiego Ośrodka Pomocy Społecznej w Katowicach poszukuje osoby na: stanowisko urzędnicze - referent / podinspektor ds. dochodzenia należności w Dziale Dochodzenia Należności
- Liczba lub wymiar etatu: 1 etat
ZAKRES ZADAŃ NA STANOWISKU:
1. Dochodzenie należności z tytułu świadczeń i usług udzielanych na podstawie ustawy o pomocy społecznej.
2. Przygotowywanie wszcząć oraz decyzji administracyjnych
3. Wystawianie upomnień oraz tytułów wykonawczych
4. Ewidencjonowanie wpłat oraz przypisów należności w programie księgowym
5. Rozpatrywanie wniosków o rozłożenia należności cywilno-prawnych na raty
6. Monitorowanie spłat, naliczanie odsetek od nieterminowych wpłat
INFORMACJA O WARUNKACH PRACY NA PROPONOWANYM STANOWISKU
1. Warunki pracy na proponowanym stanowisku obejmują między innymi:
- wykonywanie obowiązków pod presją czasu, wymagające odporności psychicznej i radzenia sobie ze stresem,
- praca w siedzibie MOPS przy ul. Wita Stwosza 7
2. Do budynku prowadzą trzy poszerzone wejścia o szerokości min. 90 cm bezpośrednio od ulicy Wita Stwosza. Do dwóch wejść prowadzą schody oraz w świetle wejścia/wyjścia stoją przeszkody - dwa filary konstrukcyjne. Jedno z tych wejść posiada automatycznie otwierane drzwi. Trzecim wejściem można się dostać z poziomu gruntu, jest ono przewidziane dla osób ze szczególnymi potrzebami (np. niepełnosprawnością ruchową, matki z wózkami itp.). Przy tych drzwiach znajduje się dzwonek. Drzwi otwiera automatycznie portier, po użyciu dzwonka. W budynku znajduje się portiernia.
3. W obiekcie jest jedna winda, za pomocą której można się dostać na każdą jego kondygnację.
4. Miejski Ośrodek Pomocy Społecznej nie dysponuje wydzielonymi miejscami parkingowymi wyznaczonymi dla osób niepełnosprawnych. Obecnie w obrębie budynku znajdują się 2 miejsca parkingowe dla osób niepełnospra

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.

Our hiring process:

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Salesforce Alliance Pipeline & Development
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What We Are Looking For:

Bandwidth is building a dedicated Salesforce Alliance team to win the global contact center market. As Director of Salesforce Alliance Pipeline & Development, you will own and grow Bandwidth's relationship with Salesforce — building the contacts, credibility, and pipeline motion that makes Bandwidth the undisputed carrier of choice for Salesforce's Agentforce contact center platform.

You will be Bandwidth's face to Salesforce's partner and field teams globally, coordinating inbound and outbound lead flow, aligning go-to-market strategy, and managing two field-based direct reports who work the Salesforce event circuit in Europe and North America.

This is a high-visibility, externally-facing role that requires deep knowledge of Salesforce's internal structure, the contact center ecosystem, and carrier-grade voice and messaging.

What You'll Do:

SALESFORCE RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP

  • Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships across Salesforce's partner, alliances, Agentforce, and contact center teams — from individual contributors to executive sponsors
  • Serve as Bandwidth's primary point of contact for Salesforce's ISV/partner and co-sell programs
  • Maintain a comprehensive map of Salesforce contacts relevant to contact center, Agentforce, and the carrier partner ecosystem
  • Facilitate executive engagement between Bandwidth and Salesforce leadership on a regular cadence

PIPELINE GENERATION & LEAD FLOW

  • Drive mutual pipeline between Bandwidth and Salesforce — both generating leads from Salesforce and routing Bandwidth-sourced leads into Salesforce deals
  • Build and manage a structured lead-exchange process with Salesforce's alliance and field teams
  • Track and report Salesforce-influenced and co-sell pipeline, maintaining accurate data in CRM
  • Set pipeline generation targets for the team and hold direct reports accountable

AGENTFORCE CONTACT CENTER STRATEGY

  • Develop and maintain Bandwidth's value proposition for Salesforce's Agentforce contact center — articulating why Bandwidth is the right carrier partner
  • Understand the competitive landscape in contact center carriers (Twilio, Vonage, NICE, Genesys, Five9, etc.) and keep Salesforce informed of Bandwidth's differentiation
  • Work with Bandwidth product and marketing teams to ensure Salesforce-relevant content, case studies, and technical documentation are current
  • Support Salesforce field teams in positioning Bandwidth on active contact center pursuits

TEAM LEADERSHIP

  • Manage and develop two Field Alliance Executives (Europe and North America)
  • Coach direct reports on Salesforce's internal contacts, deal mechanics, and co-sell motion
  • Set quarterly OKRs for the team aligned to Bandwidth's Salesforce partnership goals
  • Represent the team's results to Bandwidth leadership

EVENTS & EXECUTIVE PRESENCE

  • Plan and execute Bandwidth's presence at Salesforce events: World Tour London, Dreamforce (San Francisco), World Tour New York, and other regional events
  • Represent Bandwidth at Salesforce partner summits, QBRs, and advisory boards

What You Need:

  • 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel sales — ideally in SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or carrier/telecom
  • Direct experience working within or alongside the Salesforce ecosystem (ISV partner, Salesforce employee, or Salesforce-focused sales role)
  • Demonstrable contact network within Salesforce's partner, ISV, or field organization
  • Deep understanding of the contact center market — platforms, carriers, competitive dynamics
  • Experience managing and developing a team
  • Exceptional executive presence and relationship-building skills
  • Based in London or willing to relocate

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with Salesforce's AppExchange ISV program or Salesforce Partner Program
  • Familiarity with carrier-grade voice, SIP, or CPaaS
  • Experience at a global communications provider (Twilio, NICE, Genesys, Vonage, 8x8, or similar)
  • Network within the Salesforce Agentforce / Einstein for Service team

What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months

  • Deep, active relationships established across Salesforce's partner, Agentforce, and field organization
  • Structured lead-exchange process in place and generating measurable pipeline
  • Both direct reports ramped, active at Salesforce events, and running co-sell motions
  • Bandwidth positioned as the go-to carrier reference for Salesforce contact center deals
  • Active pipeline attributable to the Salesforce alliance visible in CRM

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

As a Senior Product Designer at DeepL, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the translation experience at the heart of DeepL Translate, the AI-first translation platform millions of people reach for every day to localize their content. You'll join a cross-functional team that is central to delivering a fast, trustworthy, and scalable product, collaborating closely with product managers and engineering leaders to define and drive the product vision.

Beyond your immediate team, you will actively contribute to DeepL's broader design community—helping evolve our craft, influence best practices, and raise the bar for design across the company.

This is a high-impact role for a designer who is comfortable navigating complexity, cares deeply about user experience, and thrives in collaborative, strategic environments.

Your responsibilities

You will be responsible for solving a critical problem: making translation feel effortless and trustworthy for anyone who needs to communicate across languages — whether they're translating a sentence, a document, or their daily work. We expect you to:

  • Become an expert on who our users are and what each user group needs, from casual translators to professionals who rely on DeepL every day

  • Conduct generative and evaluative user research to define problems and validate solutions

  • Gather and evaluate requirements with cross-functional team members

  • Communicate design concepts early and often, backed by qualitative insights and quantitative data

  • Deliver vibe coded prototypes, final design specifications in Figma and make small code changes in production

  • Share the responsibility to maintain and expand the design system

Qualities we look for

  • You have 4+ years of experience in product teams providing design solutions for web applications

  • You have a strong understanding of user-centered design processes

  • You have experience designing for B2B audiences but have a great eye for design. Experience in B2C design is a bonus point

  • You can drive design throughout the whole lifecycle of an idea — discovering problems, defining success, evaluating solutions, and measuring impact

  • You understand the power of storytelling and are comfortable in driving stakeholders buy-in

  • You can consistently use qualitative and quantitative insights to guide your design process

  • You are confident owning and co-owning design artefacts in Figma

  • You are as confident in using AI to support your work, especially to create design assets and prototypes, we mostly use Claude Code

  • You have experience working on a product at scale with a global presence

  • You have strong communication and presentation skills

  • You are fluent in English. Any other languages, e.g. German, are an advantage

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous.

You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains.

Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you'll have impact

You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:

  • Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience).

  • Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after.

  • Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

  • Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

  • Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

  • Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

What you'll bring

  • You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review.

  • You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do.

Qualifications & Expectations

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1.

  • Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues.

  • Technical acumen: the ability to translate highly technical engineering constraints (machine learning models, streaming architectures, latency) into clear business trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Deep domain fluency in identity and access management, subscription management, billing and monetization, and data processing - with the ability to debate architectural and technical trade-offs.

  • A proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including narrative strategy writing for senior audiences.

  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Experience with AI tools, and AI prototyping

  • A deep alignment with MUBI's culture and values: craftsmanship, product excellence, a bias toward high-impact work, and genuine respect for the user.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. That means it's our responsibility to ensure that all candidates are not discriminated against in our hiring processes and our employment decisions based on their race, color, religion, nationality or ethnic origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, family or parental status, or any other applicable characteristic.

jobs.title: Wir suchen Dich als GTA-Leitung (m/w/d) – Minijob im Raum Delitzsch (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen Dich als GTA-Leitung (m/w/d) – Minijob im Raum Delitzsch
Du hast ein Hobby, eine besondere Fähigkeit oder einfach Freude daran, mit Kindern und Jugendlichen zu arbeiten? Dann mach daraus ein Ganztagsangebot!

Für die Durchführung und Gestaltung von Ganztagsangeboten (GTA) an Schulen im Raum Delitzsch suchen wir engagierte und kreative GTA-Leitungen (m/w/d) auf Minijob-Basis.
Dabei sind Deinen Ideen kaum Grenzen gesetzt: Ob Sport, Kreativität, Musik, Technik, Natur, Kochen, Handwerk, Medien oder Spiele – wir möchten Menschen gewinnen, die ihre persönlichen Interessen und Fähigkeiten gerne an Kinder und Jugendliche weitergeben.

Deine möglichen Angebote
Du kannst beispielsweise ein eigenes GTA anbieten im Bereich:
Sport & Bewegung
Fußball, Basketball, Tanzen, Fitness, Yoga, Selbstverteidigung, Leichtathletik oder andere Sportarten
Kunst & Kreativität
Malen, Zeichnen, Basteln, Fotografie, Design, Schmuckgestaltung oder kreative Projekte
Musik & Kultur
Musikinstrumente, Gesang, Rhythmus oder kulturelle Projekte
Handwerk & Technik
Holzarbeiten, Werken, Technik, Robotik etc.
Digital & Medien
Gaming, Programmieren, Film oder digitale Projekte
Natur & Umwelt
Garten, Tiere, Naturerlebnisse, Nachhaltigkeit oder Outdoor-Aktivitäten
Kochen & Alltag
Kochen, Backen, gesunde Ernährung oder praktische Alltagsprojekte
Du hast eine andere Idee? Sehr gerne!
Wir sind offen für neue und ungewöhnliche Angebote.

Deine Aufgaben

- Planung und Durchführung eines eigenen Ganztagsangebotes
- Betreuung und Begleitung einer Kinder- bzw. Jugendgruppe
- Gestaltung abwechslungsreicher und altersgerechter Angebote
- Vermittlung eigener Fähigkeiten, Kenntnisse und Interessen
- Förderung von Kreativität, Teamgeist, Selbstständigkeit und sozialen Kompetenzen
- zuverlässige Kommunikation mit Schule und Ansprechpartnern
- Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung der GTA-Stunden

Das bringst Du mit
Du solltest:

- Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern und Jugendlichen haben
- zuverlässig, verantwortungsbewusst und geduldig sein
- Spaß daran haben, Wissen und Fähigkeiten weiterzugeben
- eigene Ideen und Begeisterung mitbringen
- gut mit Kindern und Jugendlichen kommunizieren können
- selbstständig und gleichzeitig teamorientiert arbeiten

Eine pädagogische Ausbildung oder ein pädagogisches Studium ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.
Besonders interessant sind Menschen, die eine besondere Fähigkeit, ein Hobby oder berufliche Erfahrung mitbringen und diese gerne mit Kindern und Jugendlichen teilen möchten.
Du musst kein klassischer Pädagoge sein – entscheidend sind Deine Persönlichkeit, Deine Begeisterung und das, was Du anderen vermitteln kannst.

Wir bieten Dir

- Beschäftigung auf Minijob-Basis
- planbare Einsatzzeiten im Rahmen des Schulbetriebs
- überwiegend Nachmittagsangebote
- einen abwechslungsreichen und kreativen Aufgabenbereich
- die Möglichkeit, Deine eigenen Interessen und Fähigkeiten einzubringen
- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung Deines Angebotes
- wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit mit Schule und Team
- eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit Kindern und Jugendlichen
- die Möglichkeit, mit Deinem Hobby und Deinen Fähigkeiten einen Beitrag zur Bildung und Entwicklung junger Menschen zu leisten

Einsatzgebiet
Raum Delitzsch und Umgebung
Die konkreten Schulen und Einsatzzeiten werden individuell abgestimmt.

Du hast eine Idee? Dann melde Dich bei uns!
Du bist Sportler, Künstler, Musiker, Handwerker, Programmierer, Koch, Naturfreund, Gamer oder einfach jemand, der für eine Sache brennt und diese Begeisterung gerne an Kinder und Jugendliche weitergibt?
Dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen!
Bewirb Dich mit einem kurzen Lebenslauf und einer kurzen Beschreibung Deiner Idee für ein GTA.
Schreib uns, welches Angebot Du gerne durchführen möchtest und was Du dafür mitbringst.
Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Family Care Lemke UG (haftungsbeschränkt)

Goldbornstr. 2

04741 Roßwein

jobs.title: Küchenhilfe (m/w/d) in Teilzeit für Kunst- Kita (Helfer/in - Küche)
jobs.description:
Lorenzini Kunst-Kita – Kreativ von Anfang an!

Seit 2008 schaffen wir in Hamburg mit unseren mittlerweile fünf Kitas im Krippen- und Elementarbereich Räume, in denen Kinder selbst bestimmt lernen, ihren Forscherdrang nachgehen und ihre Neugier stillen können. Unser Raum-in-Raum-Konzept bildet verschiedene Funktionsbereiche mit Spiel- und Arbeitsmaterialien, die allen Kindern klare Spielanreize bieten und deren Phantasie anregen. Wir orientieren uns an der Reggio-Pädagogik und integrieren ausgewählte Elemente der Montessori-Pädagogik. Bei uns steht die Kunst- und Kreativitätsförderung im Mittelpunkt, denn wir sind überzeugt, dass dies der Schlüssel zu einer erfolgreichen frühkindlichen Bildung und Betreuung ist.

Unsere Baki im Bahrenfelder Kirchenweg 5 ist die familiäre Krippe in Ottensen und  bietet 30 Krippenplätze in besonders schöner familiärer Atmosphäre. In den beiden großzügigen Betreuungsräumen haben wir unser Raum-in-Raum-Konzept mit den Funktionsbereichen Atelier, Bauecke, Wechselflächen, Wohnung und Hochebene umgesetzt. Hinter dem Haus befindet sich im ruhigen Innenhof ein schönes Außengelände mit einem schönen Spielhaus, Sand- und Rasenflächen.

Wir arbeiten angelehnt an die Reggiopädagogik offen. Das heißt, in unserer Küche ist immer was los. Für unsere Verpflegung und unsere offene Küche suchen wir eine Unterstützung als

Küchenhilfe (m/w/d) in Teilzeit

(25 Stunden/Woche)

Deine Aufgaben:

- Bestellung des Mittagessens und Übersicht über den Bedarf weiterer Lebensmittel.
- Vorbereiten der Mittagstische und Verteilung des gelieferten Mittagessens.
- Vorausschauendes Planen und Einkaufen der Lebensmittel für Frühstück und Brotzeit sowie sonstiger Verbrauchsgüter.
- Reinigung der Küche, insbesondere Abwaschen und Aufräumen der Küche nach den Mahlzeiten.
- Obst und Gemüse schneiden.

Was wir uns von dir wünschen:

- Spaß an der Arbeit mit Kindern.
- Eine Liebe für Sauberkeit und Hygiene.
- Spaß an der Arbeit in einem großen Team.
- Eine strukturiertes und selbständige Arbeitsweise.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine  Bewerbung per Mail an: lorenz@kunst-kita.de

oder über unsere Website www.kunst-kita.de
