* Sul on esimese astme kõrgharidus (sotsiaalteaduste õppesuunal, majandusteaduste, psühholoogia, kasvatusteaduse, sotsiaaltöö või nõustamise õppekavarühmades); * Sul on vähemalt kolmeaastane inimeste juhtimise kogemus tööturu- või sotsiaalvaldkonnas või teenuste sihtrühmadega; * Sul on eesti keele oskus C1 ja inglise või vene keele oskus B2 tasemel ametialase sõnavara valdamisega; * Sul on MS Windows töökeskkonna ja teiste tööks vajalike arvutiprogrammide ning andmebaaside kasutamise oskus; * oled tulemustele orienteeritud ja lahenduskeskne; * Sul on oskus ennast ja oma meeskonda juhtida, planeerida tööd ja määratleda prioriteete; * Sul on algatus-, organiseerimis- ja otsustusvõime, iseseisvus, õppimisvõime ja täpsus.

jobs.description:
Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d'une centaine de disciplines, de l'optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l'intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c'est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C'est donc être au cœur d'une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l'équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C'est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d'accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C'est aussi la possibilité d'évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d'activité, voire de pays.

    Lieu : Carquefou, France

    Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

    Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.  

    Nos engagements, vos avantages

     * Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
     * Un package de rémunération attractif
     * Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
     * Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs
     * Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

    En nous rejoignant à Carquefou, à proximité de Nantes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d'opérer les systèmes d'informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.

    De formation Bac +5 en informatique ou développement logiciel (école d'ingénieur, Master ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans le domaine du DevOps.

    Vous maîtrisez les outils de Build & Release (Git, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube) et êtes à l'aise avec les principaux cloud providers (Google Cloud, AWS et Azure), aussi bien sur les instances que sur les services managés.

    Vous êtes également capable de justifier vos choix de solutions cloud sur les volets opérationnels et financiers.

    Des connaissances en Ansible et Kubernetes seraient un plus.

    Pour réussir dans cette fonction, vous êtes rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un bon relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe.

    Vous avez le sens de l'engagement ?
    Vous êtes force de proposition ?
    

    Le poste d'Ingénieur DevOps Cloud (H/F) est fait pour vous !

    CE QUE NOUS POUVONS ACCOMPLIR ENSEMBLE

    Au sein du centre de compétences de Nantes, vous intervenez sur des projets innovants et concevez les automatismes du système d'information : intégration, tests automatisés et déploiement continu.

    Vous êtes l'interface privilégiée entre les équipes de développement et les équipes d'exploitation pour les sujets liés à l'installation, la supervision, la sauvegarde et l'administration technique.

    Vous participez également aux projets de Move to Cloud, en accompagnant la migration d'applications existantes vers le cloud.

jobs.title: Team Support
jobs.description:
Help shape the everyday experience of Supercell’s growing London office. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves making things happen, supporting great teams, and taking real ownership in an environment where no two days look quite the same.

Supercell is looking for a Team Support professional to join our London office. As Team Support, you’ll take ownership of the day-to-day support of the office, from travel and team events to the countless practical details that keep things running smoothly.

You’ll be the only Team Support based in London, so this is a role with plenty of independence and responsibility. But you won’t be doing it alone. You’ll be part of an experienced, caring Team Support team across Supercell, with colleagues to learn from and collaborate with. You’ll have the freedom to shape how support works locally, while staying closely connected with your colleagues in Helsinki and collaborating also with other people working with London operations.

At Supercell, independent teams and trust are at the heart of how we work. The same applies to Team Support: you’ll have real ownership of your area and the freedom to decide how best to support the people around you. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible difference to the experience of everyone working in our London office.

If you enjoy helping people and figuring things out without needing a playbook for everything, you’ll probably feel at home here. Send your CV as well as your application / motivational letter before the application deadline (Thursday, September 17th 2026 9:00 pm BST).

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the day-to-day administrative support for our London office.

  • Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, and the details in between.

  • Plan and organise team days, offsites, internal events, and other moments that bring people together.

  • Help colleagues navigate everyday practical questions, from benefits to general team support.

  • Work closely with Team Support colleagues in Helsinki and with teams operating across London and Helsinki, including our live game teams Clash of Clans and Hay Day.

  • Be a trusted local point of contact for colleagues, leads, and other stakeholders in London.

  • Spot opportunities to improve how things work and take ownership of putting better solutions in place.

What You Have

  • Strong experience (minimum of 5 years) in team support, workplace or office coordination, travel arrangements, and/or event production.

  • A service-minded approach and genuine enjoyment of helping others succeed.

  • Excellent organisational skills and close attention to detail. When you take something on, people can trust that it will get done.

  • The ability to manage several priorities at once and make good calls about what needs attention first.

  • Confidence working independently and taking responsibility, including in situations where there isn’t an existing process or obvious answer.

  • Strong communication skills in English and the ability to build trusted relationships with people across teams, disciplines, and locations.

  • A collaborative and humble way of working, with a willingness to ask for input, share context, and step in where you can help.

  • Enthusiasm and preferably also previous experience for working in an international environment with colleagues across multiple countries or offices.

  • You're actively using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and excited about experimenting with new ways AI can improve how we work.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Experience supporting a growing office or building support practices in an environment that is still evolving.

  • Experience coordinating complex international travel.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London studio and is a full-time, permanent position.

Because this role is all about supporting the people and everyday life in the office, we expect you to spend most of your working time onsite in our London office. You’ll also work closely with our Helsinki-based Team Support colleagues and teams whose members are split across London and Helsinki, so expect some travel also between our offices.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Success Manager - Financial Services

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.


About the team

The Customer Success Team helps merchants get the most value out of Trustly, driving adoption of our products among their end users. We take a proactive, consultative approach, understanding each merchant's technology and strategy in order to drive mutual success.


About the role
The Senior Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of Trustly's most strategic financial services merchants, with a strong focus on continuously optimising how these merchants use Trustly's products to maximize performance and value.

Financial services merchants operate in a demanding environment: high transaction volumes, tight margins, complex regulatory requirements, and end users who expect seamless, reliable payment experiences. This role is about going beyond maintaining the relationship, proactively identifying where performance can be improved, benchmarking merchants against peers and potential, and driving the changes needed to unlock that value.

The role demands a strong combination of technical and commercial skills, and close collaboration with Sales, Account Management, and Product.

This role is based in either our London or Stockholm office.


What you’ll do

  • Owning end-to-end optimization of a portfolio of strategic financial services merchants, continuously identifying opportunities to improve their performance on Trustly

  • Conducting rigorous, ongoing data analysis to benchmark merchant performance against peers, historical trends, and potential, and pinpointing where value is being left on the table

  • Translating analysis into clear, prioritised recommendations — and owning implementation through to measurable improvement, not just reporting the findings

  • Engaging with new and existing merchants to fully understand their needs and constraints, and designing tailored solutions that reflect the regulatory and operational realities of financial services

  • Leading technical onboarding for new merchants end to end, including complex, high-value implementations and ramping beyond go-live

  • Acting as a point of escalation and technical/commercial authority for complex merchant issues within the financial services vertical

  • Partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, and Product to feed merchant and performance insights back into the roadmap

 

Who you are

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the online payments industry, with strong preference for direct experience in financial services, or at a PSP

  • Demonstrated track record of driving measurable performance improvements for merchants or clients through data-led optimisation

  • Strong understanding of the commercial and regulatory dynamics specific to remittance, FX, and banking payment flows

  • Ability to articulate complex technical information and present confidently to senior merchant and partner stakeholders

  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to independently interrogate data to identify and prioritize opportunities

  • Strong ability to navigate internally across functions — Commercial, Product, Finance, Legal/Compliance

  • Can-do attitude with the ability to find solutions to the most difficult problems

  • Proactive, diligent, and able to work autonomously with limited oversight

  • SQL, JIRA and Confluence experience preferred

  • Comfortable with regular travel within Europe

  • Based in London or Stockholm

jobs.title: Assurance Manager EU/UK
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

 

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

 

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are establishing a dedicated Compliance Assurance function in the Second Line of Defence, and we are seeking an experienced Entity Assurance Manager to own a single, defensible view of the second-line control environment across Trustly's EU and UK licensed entities.

This role will be part of a community of assurance managers, some of them focussed on specific compliance domains (such as Financial Crimes Prevention, Safeguarding, Consumer Protection, and ICT and Resilience) and some focussed on other Trustly regulated entities. As the Entity Assurance Manager, you own managing the assurance function at an entity level including understanding local requirements, what local regulators expect to see, how findings reach the entity Board and local management team, and what the entity Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) can credibly attest to.

You will confirm the local applicability of domain testing scope and technique, agree the reports that reach the entity Board, and serve as a primary point of contact for assurance matters toward the relevant EU and UK regulators/supervisors. You will work alongside domain assurance managers, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), and Internal Audit, ensuring that assurance over Trustly's compliance controls is evidenced consistently.

This role is suited to a seasoned assurance, compliance, or second-line risk professional with experience in regulated financial institutions and a firm grasp of the independence boundaries that keep assurance credible.

What you'll do

  • Own a single, defensible view of the second-line control environment across Trustly's EU and UK licensed entities, ensuring that assurance results are comparable, aggregated consistently, and mapped to the ERM risk taxonomy.

  • Confirm the local regulatory applicability of domain testing scope and methodology, agreeing which requirements bite in each EU and UK entity and how findings are rated and reported locally.

  • Own the entity assurance opinion and the reporting of findings to the entity Board and local management team, and support what the entity CCO attests to.

  • Contribute to the annual assurance plan and the single master testing plan through the assurance forum, jointly reviewing and signing off scope with the relevant domain assurance managers before testing commences, to prevent duplicate or gapped coverage.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact toward the relevant EU and UK regulators/supervisors on assurance matters, representing the function credibly and building productive relationships with regulatory authorities.

  • Maintain a disciplined independence boundary by providing independent oversight only.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - MENA focus
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is a core region for ExTrac's intelligence coverage, spanning the political and security dynamics, actors, movements, and online ecosystems that shape risk across the region and beyond it. We are the analytical backbone for decision-making when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Working in Arabic every day, across standard and dialectal material, you will turn what you find into timely reporting that feeds ExTrac's intelligence products and data platform.

What the job involves

Intelligence collection and analysis

  • Monitor and assess political, security, and socio-economic developments across MENA, including regional diplomacy, state and non-state actors, and geopolitical risk, with the ability to contribute to wider global coverage when required.

  • Conduct daily monitoring of Arabic- and English-language media, including news outlets, social media platforms, official statements, and other open-source information environments.

  • Track VEO and non-state armed group activity, including organisational developments, propaganda and communications activity, governance dynamics, operational activity, and regional linkages.

  • Identify new narratives, actors, platforms, and threats appearing across online ecosystems.

  • Apply structured analytical techniques to assess complex information and identify patterns and relationships.

Intelligence production

  • Lead and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, flash, and deep-dive analytical reporting, with a particular focus on MENA and VEOs.

  • Translate and assess Arabic-language documents and other source material.

  • Contribute to client-facing discussions, briefings, and ad hoc research requests as required.

  • Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise across designated countries, actors, organisations, and thematic areas.

Data curation

  • Lead and contribute to source coverage for the region, identifying and proposing new actors, entities, channels, and outlets for inclusion in ExTrac's research ecosystem.

  • Verify and assess sources in the original language prior to inclusion.

  • Maintain coverage against intelligence requirements, identifying where it should expand or deepen.

  • Contribute to the taxonomy and tagging decisions that structure MENA and violent extremism data.

  • Work with the wider research and data teams to translate analytical judgement into structured data that others can rely on without further verification.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Support the Team Lead with the reviewing, and quality assurance of analytical outputs.

  • Mentor junior analysts on research methodology, analytical standards, and source validation.

  • Support other teams across ExTrac on projects and deliverables when required.

Innovation and capability development

  • Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality.

  • Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements.

You should apply if

  • MENA is the region you already follow closely, across its politics, security dynamics, and the violent extremist movements and online ecosystems operating within it. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else.

  • You work in Arabic, not just alongside it. You read Modern Standard Arabic and dialect comfortably, you notice when slang is doing something new, and you can tell the difference between a shift in language and a shift in intent.

  • Writing is one of your strengths. You can turn a fast-moving, ambiguous picture into a concise, evidence-based assessment under deadline, and you take pride in doing it well.

  • You care about the quality of the underlying data as much as the quality of the analysis built on it, and you hold both to the same standard.

  • You want to keep producing analysis at volume and take on more alongside it. Reviewing others' work, helping set priorities for a small team, and mentoring junior analysts appeal to you as additions to the writing, not a step away from it.

  • You thrive on operational tempo. Daily and flash reporting alongside longer deep dives suits how you like to work, and the pace energises rather than drains you.

  • You are already using AI in your workflow and are interested in what it changes about analytical craft.

Where this role can take you

  • Build recognised subject-matter expertise across your assigned countries, actors, and thematic areas, and take on broader analytical scope as it deepens.

  • Build leadership experience through mentoring junior analysts, quality-assuring their work, and supporting prioritisation across a small team.

  • Support the development of the monitoring frameworks and analytical methodologies used across the team.

  • Shape how AI changes intelligence work itself, championing new tools and methodologies across the Research & Analysis team and influencing how the whole function operates.

Requirements

  • At least five years of professional experience in intelligence analysis, geopolitical risk, disinformation analysis, strategic communications, international security, international relations, or a related field.

  • Strong subject-matter knowledge of the MENA region, including its key political and security actors and regional dynamics.

  • A working understanding of VEOs, their online ecosystems, communications strategies, narratives, and operational activity, built through direct analytical experience.

  • Fluency in written Arabic, across both Modern Standard Arabic and local dialects, including knowledge of slang, with the ability to monitor, analyse, and translate Arabic-language content from a range of sources.

  • Demonstrable experience applying structured analytical methodologies to complex information environments and online ecosystems, including OSINT, network analysis, narrative analysis, sentiment analysis, or other quantitative and qualitative approaches.

  • Strong written communication skills, with a track record of producing concise, high-quality, policy-relevant intelligence and analytical outputs under tight deadlines.

  • Hands-on experience curating source coverage: identifying and verifying online sources, assessing their affiliation, and maintaining structured datasets to a defined standard.

  • Experience proofreading, editing, and quality-assuring analytical products.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to distinguish meaningful developments from high-volume information flows.

  • Able to communicate complex political, security, and extremist-related developments clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.

  • Comfortable integrating AI systems into your workflow to improve outputs and efficiency.

  • A strong understanding of the legal and ethical considerations surrounding intelligence collection, open-source research, and data handling, including responsible use of publicly available information.

Desirable

  • Experience leading analysis on international security, violent extremism, terrorism, or state- and non-state-aligned influence and disinformation ecosystems.

  • Demonstrable experience researching VEOs and extremist online activity, including monitoring affiliated media operations, narratives, actors, and various platforms, such as Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, RocketChat, TikTok, and others.

  • Experience with data science, AI-enabled research tools, or advanced OSINT platforms.

  • Proficiency in one or more additional relevant languages, such as French, Farsi, Turkish, Kurdish, or Russian.

  • Familiarity with the PHIA Yardstick.

  • Experience developing analytical methodologies, research frameworks, monitoring requirements, or data schemas and taxonomies.

  • Experience mentoring junior analysts, reviewing analytical outputs, or leading small analytical projects.

Interview Process

We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Initial interview with the hiring manager – 30 minutes

  • Competency-based interview – 45 minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • A role that combines mission-driven purpose with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing company.

About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. This is not a hand-off role — you take a problem from requirement to production and own it there. You'll work across both stacks, make technical decisions, and be accountable for what you ship.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. What we care about is judgment: understanding what you ship, making the right decisions, and knowing when to push back on AI output.

This description applies across experience levels (L1–L4). Interview depth and expectations are calibrated to your level.

Tasks

What You'll Own:

  • Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them
  • Technical decisions within your scope, with clear trade-off reasoning
  • Quality of your code and the areas you touch
  • Responding to incidents and dev-escalations in your domain
  • Building the new TypeScript system that will replace the legacy PHP platform
  • Maintaining and supporting the existing PHP system throughout the transition

What Your Work Will Entail:

1. Feature Development

  • Take feature requests, break them into tasks, estimate, and deliver independently
  • Build the new TypeScript-based system designed to replace our existing PHP platform
  • Maintain and support the current PHP system in parallel, until the new system is fully migrated
  • Write clean, tested, production-ready code that meets team standards
  • Make technical decisions for features and explain trade-offs clearly
  • Monitor your features in production — logs, metrics, alerts
  • Leave the codebase better than you found it (refactor, document, reduce debt)

2. Production Ownership & Incident Response

  • Respond to dev-escalations with urgency — investigate issues, communicate findings, contribute to resolution
  • Participate in incident response: at all levels, you are expected to show up, help investigate, and support resolution
  • L4+: Drive incident response for your domain — coordinate investigation, delegate tasks, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure post-mortems happen
  • Write runbooks and keep documentation current as you build
  • Share on-call rotation after ramp-up period

3. Code Quality & Testing

  • Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought
  • Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive
  • Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

4. AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI coding tools daily: code generation, debugging, test writing, exploring unfamiliar parts of the codebase, code review acceleration
  • Your output should be measurably faster because of AI tools
  • You understand everything you ship — AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for judgment
  • L3+: Help teammates develop effective AI workflows; contribute to team standards for AI tool use
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate what delivers real value, ensure quality isn't sacrificed for speed

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers
  • Contribute meaningfully to sprint planning and technical discussions
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 engineers through code reviews, pairing, and sharing knowledge

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.
  • Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

This role requires active, hands-on TypeScript experience and past professional experience with PHP. Hands-on experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe and PayPal is required.

Expectations by Level:

  • L1: Works on well-scoped tickets with guidance. Learning the codebase and practices. Uses AI tools to learn faster and ship more.
  • L2: Independently owns features. Minimal guidance needed on implementation. Noticeably faster because of AI tool usage.
  • L3: Leads small projects. Mentors L1/L2. Improves the codebase proactively. Teaches effective AI workflows.
  • L4: Technical authority for a domain. Drives cross-team projects. Sets team AI standards. Drives incident response.

Success Metrics:

Early on, you'll ship your first feature to production, understand the core architecture, and get your local development environment set up. From there, you'll be independently shipping features end-to-end and contributing to code reviews. As you grow further, you'll contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and handle dev-escalations in your area.

Shared rotation (~1 week/month after ramp-up). Critical: 15 min. High: 1 hour.

jobs.description:
Join the Villa Valentina Team!

About Villa Valentina

Inspired by the warmth of a Spanish farmhouse, Villa Valentina brings people together through Mediterranean flavours, heartfelt hospitality and dishes made for sharing. Relaxed, vibrant and full of character, it is a place where guests feel like old friends — and our team brings that feeling to life every day.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Supervisor at Villa Valentina you will support the management team in running smooth, energetic and guest-focused services. You will be hands-on on the floor, helping the team stay organised, supporting guests, and making sure our standards are delivered with warmth and consistency as part of UIG standards.

What you'll be doing

    

Supporting the daily restaurant service and helping the floor run smoothly.

    

Leading by example and supporting the team during busy shifts.

    

Creating a warm, confident and memorable guest experience.

    

Helping with table flow, guest communication and service standards.

    

Supporting training, feedback and daily team motivation.

    

Working closely with managers and the kitchen to keep service connected and organised.

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

Experienced in a busy restaurant or hospitality environment.

    

Confident on the floor and comfortable supporting a team.

    

Warm, positive and guest-focused.

    

Organised, reliable and calm under pressure.

    

A strong communicator who enjoys working with people.

    

Ready to learn, grow and take ownership.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for hospitality to Villa Valentina.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

Entreprise

AARH Recrutement Hôtellerie est un cabinet de recrutement basé à Paris.

Dans le cadre d'une recherche pour l'un de mes partenaires hôteliers, je recrute son/sa futur(e) Directeur(trice).

L'établissement compte 40 chambres et appartements, plusieurs espaces de restauration, un espace bien-être et une équipe d'environ 40 collaborateurs.

Véritable chef d'orchestre de l'établissement, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble de l'exploitation et de son développement :

  * Accompagnement de la montée en gamme de l'établissement

  * Développement de la destination montagne 4 saisons.

Environ 70 000 € brut/an selon profil  
Appartement de fonction 2 chambres

Un poste de direction à fort potentiel, dans un environnement exceptionnel, pour un(e) professionnel(le) qui souhaite véritablement s'investir dans un projet hôtelier et entrepreneurial.

Je recherche avant tout un(e) dirigeant(e) de terrain, doté(e) d'une solide expérience en direction d'hôtel haut de gamme avec une forte activité restauration.

jobs.title: Claims Validation Handler
jobs.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Claims Validation Team
The Claims Validation Team exists to help to defend Marshmallow against fraudulent activity, and to protect the company loss ratio. Fraudulent claims can result in us losing money, which can then result in driving up the premium prices for our honest customers. We’re here to stop that, by making sure that the right claims are reviewed for any policyholder or indemnity related concerns.


What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing indemnity referrals flagged by our wider claims team, where it has been identified at the point of claim that customers have misrepresented their policy details, and deciding upon the appropriate course of action for the policy and claim

  • Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations

  • Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage

  • Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service

  • Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams

  • Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers

Who you are

  • You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business

  • You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities

  • You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership

  • You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers

  • You are tenacious and persistent; knowing when further investigation can lead to positive commercial outcomes for the business

What we're looking for from you

  • A background in fraud or claims/policy validation

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate with our customers

  • You are really passionate about the customer, and will go the extra mile to offer them the best service

  • Working in a fast-paced scale up means that you have to be adaptable and excited by the prospect of moving fast

  • You enjoy finding solutions to problems you come across rather than waiting on others to do this for you

  • You enjoy taking ownership of your own workload, and proactively highlight any blockers that you or your team may be facing

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

We break it up into a few stages:

  • Initial call with someone in our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • A skill-based interview where you will discuss your previous experience also with a focus on our values, our culture and your motivations with our Claims Validation Team Lead plus one other team member (1 hour)

We’ll let you know if you’re invited to an interview or not. But, as a small team with a lot of applications to consider, we can’t give personal feedback on each application.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, Sierra, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised over $50m from top-tier investors. Most recently, Google Ventures led our series B. We’re growing 5x YoY, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

We operate with one core principle: velocity. In practice, this means we:

  • Optimize everything we do around accelerating rate of learning.

  • Do truly great work

  • Communicate openly and directly, and with full context.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

The role:

We're hiring our first Implementation Specialist to own how our customers first experience the product. You'll take new customers from signature to steady state: handle the configuration, run the training, and get every user live and productive across the Metaview agents that they’ve chosen to get started with.

A great implementation sets the whole relationship up for success. Done well, every end user sees value fast and the customer sees clear ROI against their own success criteria.

This is a brand new role, and there's a ton of room to define what great looks like as we build out the function. It's also one of the most hands-on seats in the company for learning how AI actually gets adopted inside a business. You'll see it happen across dozens of companies a year, up close, at a company defining the category.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Run the implementations for our most strategic customers: work through the plan for each new account, drive the setup, keep it on track, and make sure the customer always knows what happens next.

  • Build each customer’s version of Metaview: a lot of this is prompt engineering. You’ll write the instructions that tell Metaview's agents what a great candidate looks like for each role, give the agents context on the company and how it hires, build note templates around the customer's real interview process, and connect Metaview to their ATS and the rest of their stack. You’ll move customers onto the more advanced features once the basics are working.

  • Run the trainings: end user sessions, hiring manager onboarding, custom loom videos. Success is sustained and increasing usage from all users across all parts of the platform.

  • Watch adoption: spot the teams and users who haven't landed and go back in with targeted training or config changes. You're the customer's first call during the onboarding period, and you know when to pull in the rest of the team.

  • Leave things reusable: turn what you build into assets the next implementation can use, and share what you're learning about what makes onboarding land.

You might be:

  • A couple of years into implementation, onboarding or professional services at a B2B SaaS company with a complex, multi-module product.

  • Already working in the ops side of recruitment - you know the tools and the workflows as well as the hiring.

  • A Metaview power user who's already pushing the product further than most of our team.

  • None of these exactly, but you recognise yourself in the next section.

What you bring:

  • Project management. Not necessarily a previous job title, but one of your real strengths. Comfortable running several implementations simultaneously, each at a different stage with its own milestones, dependencies and stakeholders.

  • Product fluency. You like understanding how things work and you're happy in the detail. You'll learn to write a strong ideal candidate profile, work out why a sourcing search is returning the wrong candidates, and teach a hiring manager to get more from an agent. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on one of Goodlord's core propositions.

You'll work with senior stakeholders across the business, influence strategic decisions, shape the future of our referencing proposition and help define what great looks like for our customers over the coming years.

If you enjoy bringing people together, solving complex problems and building propositions that create real customer and commercial value, we'd love to hear from you.

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.
Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.
Tes missions :
- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)

- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques

- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré

- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateforme

Profil recherché
À l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- System architecture : vision système, capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

- AI-native mindset : pratique avancée des outils d'IA pour le développement, esprit critique sur leurs sorties, et envie de contribuer à élever la pratique de toute l'équipe

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement web avec python (Django, Flask, Sanic, FastAPI.) et avec un framework javascript (React, Vue, Angular.)

- Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d'un environnement de travail mettant l'expérience utilisateur au coeur des préoccupations

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métie

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Orchestration de taches: Celery

- Cache : Redis

Frontend Web
- Language : TypeScript / JavaScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Styling : Design System Hello Watt + Tailwind CSS

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

- Partage de code : Réutilisation du code web en natif

Base de Données
- SQL : MySQL pour les données relationnelles

- NoSQL : MongoDB pour la gestion de données semi-structurées / documents

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

- Documentation : Slite

- Contrôle de version : GitLab

Tu as envie de travailler sur de multiples projets où les mises en production de tes travaux sont rapides ?
Tu veux intégrer une Greentech travaillant sur des produits à la pointe en Europe ?
Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services permettant de réduire l'empreinte carbone et les factures d'énergie ?
Ne cherche plus, viens chez Hello Watt !
Nos valeurs :
- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.

- User focused : à l'écoute de nos clients, nous cherchons à les étonner par la qualité de nos services et de nos produits.

- One caring team : nous veillons au bien être et au développement de chacun en fondant nos relations sur l'humilité et l'honnêteté.

Vores team er sunde mennesker, så har du et alkohol problem eller tager du stoffer, så behøver du ikke søge hos os. Du skal kunne passe dine vagter, møde til tiden og ikke melde dig syg i tide og utide pga tømmermænd og lign. 

Vi tilbyder;

En dejlig livfuld arbejdsplads!

Alle hos os er timelønnet ansat. Det vil sige, at vagtplanen er lavet til at ramme cirka 160 timer pr. lønperiode for fuldtidsansatte og typisk vil du ramme mellem 150-170 timer

jobs.title: Lagermedarbejder hos MOBILCOVERS.DK og TABLETCOVERS.DK - Aftenhold
jobs.description:
MAULUND A/S – MOBILCOVERS.DK og TABLETCOVERS.DK søger lagermedarbejder til tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt


Det perfekte job til dit sabbatår
Stillingen er en timelønnet stilling på 8-24 timer ugentligt. Arbejdstiderne vil primært være på hverdage i tidsrummet kl. 15.00-22.30 og i weekender hvor arbejdstiden både kan være morgen og aften. Dette tilpasses i samarbejde med dig.


Maulund som står bag virksomhederne MOBILCOVERS.DK og TABLETCOVERS.DK, søger en dygtig, hurtig, struktureret lagermedarbejder til vores unge team i Risskov. 
Opgaverne omfatter plukning og pakning af varer, varemodtagelse og opfyldning.
Vi skal nok sørge for oplæringen, men det er vigtigt at du kan arbejde effektivt med et godt overblik, da vi har et stort sortiment.

Vi har vores kontor i samme bygning som vores lager, hvilket gør lagerarbejdet spændende, da vi altid har de nyeste varer samt en direkte adgang til de andre kontormedarbejdere.


Vi tilbyder: 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Løntillæg efter kl. 18 og i weekender

  • Frokostaftale

  • Sundt arbejdsmiljø med kolleger som altid står klar til at hjælpe

  • Personalerabatter

Jobindholdet omfatter bl.a.:

  • Plukning og pakning af varer

  • Varemodtagelse

  • Opfyldning på varelokationer

  • Ad - hoc opgaver efter aftale med nærmeste leder

Kvalifikationer:

  • Du arbejder kvalitetsbevidst, effektivt og struktureret, samtidigt med, at der er en række rutiner som skal huskes gennem processerne

  • Du er fysisk robust

  • Du skal kunne arbejde både selvstændigt og effektivt i et team med kolleger

  • Du har grundlæggende IT-kompetencer da processen med pakning er omfattet af flere systemer

  • Du taler og forstår dansk

  • Du behersker engelsk på brugerniveau i skrift og tale

  • Du kan fremvise straffeattest


Praktiske oplysninger: 
Vi holder til på Sindalsvej 3 i Risskov, hvorfra vi driver MOBILCOVERS.DK og TABLETCOVERS.DK, som er netbutikker i kraftig vækst.

Vores vækst gør at vi har brug for flere medarbejdere, der sikrer at vores kunder får det rigtige indtryk af vores varer og den bedste købsoplevelse. Du kommer til at indgå i et sundt og godt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer, som du altid kan få hjælp hos.   

Busforbindelse: Linie: 1A Kolt – Vejlby – Stoppested: Viengevej/Nordlandsvej   Letbane: Linie: L1 – Stoppested: Torsøvej

Kontakt:

Du kan også læse mere om os på:www.mobilcovers.dk og www.tabletcovers.dk

lagerjob@maulund.dk

jobs.title: Product Lead - SeaQ Communications
jobs.description:
Join our team as Product Lead, SeaQ® Communications.
At VARD Electro, we are passionate about developing innovative solutions that enhance communication and operational efficiency at sea.
 
Our SeaQ® Communications portfolio plays a vital role in connecting systems, vessels, crews, and onshore operations through reliable, integrated solutions that keep the maritime industry moving forward.
 
As we continue to strengthen our position in the global maritime market, we are looking for a skilled and motivated Product Lead to join our SeaQ® Communications team. In this role, you will be a key contributor within our product development team, helping shape the future of our communication solutions. You will play a central role in developing products that respond to evolving customer needs, regulatory requirements, and market trends in an increasingly connected maritime landscape. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across product development, delivery and projects, retrofit and service, sales, and customers worldwide. Your ability to combine technical understanding with customer insight and strategic thinking will be essential in driving innovation, performance, and growth.
 
At VARD, we believe in empowering people and embracing diverse strengths. We offer an environment where you can grow, take ownership, and make a real impact. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future of shipbuilding and maritime technology.

So – what are your skills?

jobs.title: Electrical Installation Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an ELECTRICAL INSTALLATION MANAGER to work on an industrial project in Northern Sweden. The work will start as soon as a suitable candidate is found, and the estimated duration is approximately 6 months.

Responsibilities:

- Managing and coordinating electrical installation activities on site

- Supervising electrical contractors and monitoring the progress of installation works

- Monitoring HV/MV installation works and ensuring compliance with project requirements, drawings and quality standards

- Coordinating interfaces between electrical installation works and other disciplines

- Monitoring quality, schedule and electrical safety within the area of responsibility

- Participating in site meetings, inspections and coordination activities

- Reporting progress, deviations and agreed actions to project management


Requirements:

- Suitable electrical education

- Previous experience in electrical installation management or similar site-based electrical roles

- Experience with HV/MV electrical systems and installations

- Valid EBR ESA certificate (ESA Skilled / EBR ESA Elektriskt arbete)

- Fluent English language skills

- Swedish language skills and Swedish electrical authorization A are considered strong advantages.

- Good IT and reporting skills


CMS arranges accommodation and travel arrangements when agreed.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Riihimäelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Riihimäelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: MRO Buyer
jobs.description:
The MRO Buyer manages procurement activities across various departments, ensuring optimal cost-effectiveness, timely delivery, and compliance with quality standards and procurement policies. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional teams, internal stakeholders, customers, and external suppliers, as well as a proactive approach to continuous improvement and cost savings.

Primary Responsibilities:

Procurement Planning

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering and Logistics, to understand procurement requirements, specifications, inventory needs, and priorities. Ensure planning covers MRO materials and office supplies needs.

Order Management

  • Place purchase orders and ensure timely delivery of materials and services, coordinating with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve any issues, delays, or supply risks.

Supplier Management

  • Monitor and manage supplier performance, including delivery performance, quality and responsiveness, and compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular supplier reviews and evaluations.
  • Seek opportunities for supplier development, improved commercial terms, and long-term supplier relationships.

Record-Keeping

  • Maintain accurate procurement records, including purchase orders, contracts, trackers, and supplier information, according to company policies and procedures.

Inventory Management

  • Collaborate with the planning and relevant internal teams to support adequate inventory levels, considering lead times, operational requirements, and production needs.

Cost Optimization

  • Identify and implement cost-saving measures, sourcing opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Explore opportunities for supplier consolidation, improved commercial terms, and long-term agreements.

Reporting

  • Generate reports and analyses on procurement activities, supplier performance, purchasing performance, and cost-saving initiatives.

Continuous Improvement & Collaboration

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve procurement processes, lead times, supplier performance, and overall efficiency.
  • Support and participate in Continuous Improvement projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Support other procurement categories and team members when needed.

Requirements:

Skills And Competencies

  • Min. 5 years of proven experience as an MRO buyer.
  • In-depth knowledge of procurement processes, best practices, sourcing, negotiation, and supplier management.
  • Proven team player with a collaborative approach and willingness to support others.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in using procurement software, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and effectively prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify issues, raise risks early, and drive improvements.
  • High-level proficiency in English, including communication with international suppliers and stakeholders.

Experience & Qualification:

  • Bachelorâs degree in mechanical engineering and/or Supply Chain Management.
  • Practical experience in MRO procurement.
  • Proven experience in procurement or supply chain management.
  • Experience in a global or multinational organization is an advantage.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, automotive, engineering, manufacturing, or import/export industries is an advantage.

Här på EY får du chansen att skapa en exceptionell upplevelse. Vi erbjuder dig den senaste teknologin, omger dig med kompetenta team och tillhandahåller den globala räckvidd samt den mångsidiga och inkluderande kultur som krävs för att du ska kunna upptäcka din fulla potential. Genom våra coachnings- och utbildningsprogram kommer du att utveckla de färdigheter som behövs för att förbli relevant både idag och i framtiden.





Möjligheten: ditt nästa äventyr väntar på dig



Vill du starta din karriär inom revision och arbeta med några av Sveriges mest spännande företag? Som junior revisionskonsult hos EY får du möjlighet att utvecklas i nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och bygga en stark grund för en framtida karriär som revisor. Du kommer att arbeta i team där du bidrar till hög kvalitet, skapar förtroende och får en bred förståelse för olika verksamheter och branscher. Möjlig start i januari 2027 eller i augusti 2027 beroende på din examen och tillgänglighet. Placering antingen på kontoret i Helsingborg eller Ängelholm. Specificera detta i din ansökan.





Kvalifikationer



    Universitets-/högskoleexamen inom ekonomi eller motsvarande
    Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift





Meriterande



    Goda akademiska meriter
    Relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
    Utlandsstudier
    Engagemang utanför studierna





Som person är du



    Intresserad av finansiell revision och vill utvecklas i en roll som revisor
    Nyfiken och motiverad att lära dig nya saker
    Samarbetsinriktad och trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra





Vad vi erbjuder dig



    Utveckla dina tekniska färdigheter och samarbets- och ledarskapsförmågor genom framtidsinriktade kurser och utvecklingsprogram
    Bredda dina perspektiv genom att arbeta tillsammans med kollegor med olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder
    Investera i din personliga utveckling och ditt välbefinnande
    Vara med och bidra till att skapa långsiktigt värde för kunder, medarbetare och samhälle

jobs.title: Chauffør - STARK Regionale Distributionscenter
jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Trives du med frihed, ansvar og kundekontakt, og har du erfaring med krankørsel? Så er du måske vores nye chauffør på STARKs regionale distributionscenter i Aarhus.

Du bliver en del af et team på 80 kolleger, der hver dag sørger for levering af byggematerialer til professionelle håndværkere, byggepladser og private kunder.

Dine opgaver

  • Levering af byggematerialer med lastbil og kran

  • Læsning og aflæsning med kran og truck

  • God og professionel kundeservice

  • Sikker og ansvarlig håndtering af varer

Vi forestiller os at du:

  • Har kørekort C

  • Har kran D-certifikat

  • Har truckcertifikat

  • Har EU-kvalifikationsbevis

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og serviceminded

Det får du hos os:

  • Moderne MAN- og Volvo-lastbiler

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Fri weekender og helligdage

  • En hverdag med variation og selvstændighed

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt fra 06:00 - 14:15

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK RDC via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK RDC som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftschef Bjarne Søndergaard på telefon +45 28 94 82 76

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________
 

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.
