jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, engine emission aftertreatment modelling, simulation, experiments and control (Energy Technology)
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The position is offered initially for two (2) years starting on January 2027 or at an earliest possible date mutually agreed between both parties. The position is located in the School of Technology and Innovation and under energy technology discipline.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will be part of the Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) Research group working on several challenging projects, at the forefront of research and development of novel combustion engine technologies. With over 40 researchers and 3 MEUR of annual research turnover, we are the biggest focused powertrain-oriented research group in Finland. Our focus is on model-based development of advanced engine solutions supporting our industry partners in conforming to tightening emissions and noise regulation in marine and off-road sectors.

Hydrogen represents a promising zero-carbon alternative fuel for large oceangoing vessels, where internal combustion engines are expected to remain a prime mover. Hydrogen-biogas combustion is a green solution in marine application, where the methane slip in exhaust gases is challenging to remove by catalytic and thermal management methods, which require further development. Methane is counted parallel to CO2 as a greenhouse gas, which emissions are regulated. In addition, significant challenges have restrained its large-scale onboard integration, catalyst durability, amid concerns related to safety, fuel availability, and cost. This research is related to green shift in off-road applications (marine, machinery), where conventional fossil fuels like diesel oil will be replaced with low-/zero-carbon fuels with flexible mixtures.

The new EU-funded [H4PERION](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/projects/h4perion-hydrogen-performance-enhancement-and-reliable-ice-operation) project directly addresses these barriers by developing a new ultra-efficient hydrogen-capable internal combustion engine (TRL 7, while meeting 55% thermal efficiency target), followed by concept integration at ship level through a pilot demonstration.

In this context as a part of the EPS team, you will contribute to:

- Developing novel catalytic methane removal solutions securing low pollutant emissions and flexible operation with hydrogen and other gaseous fuels.
- 1D modelling and simulations of catalytic aftertreatment systems based on engine-out emissions and experimental catalyst performance results.
- Experimental catalyst testing campaign in corresponding off-road application.
- Integrating the exhaust aftertreatment systems together with appropriate thermal and energy management strategies to ensure compliance with the projects emission and efficiency targets.

Achieving the targeted efficiency within the project timeline requires deep integration of catalyst simulation and testing environments with autonomous calibration routines. To this end we are seeking talented and motivated researchers in simulation-driven catalytic aftertreatment development and optimization.

All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field. For example chemical/mechanical/process engineering, with a specialization in emission catalyst reaction reactions/modelling or combustion engines.
- You have documented experience in 1D aftertreatment/combustion model calibration and validation with experimental data. Experience in 3D simulation environments is a benefit.
- You are able to efficiently plan and conduct engine laboratory experiments and postprocess emission data. Laboratory experience such as test-rig development, instrumentation, and data-acquisition is considered a strong advantage.
- Engine emission aftertreatment involves chemical reactions, as a result good knowledge on catalysts as well as chemical reaction mechanisms and kinetics is a benefit.
- Excellent analytical skills in addition to good academic writing skills are highly advantageous for your candidature.
- Proven track record in high-quality journals/conferences/projects on the topics related to the position, is an additional advantage.
- You enjoy developing innovative solutions to technically challenging problems and have the right mix of intellectual curiosity and practical pragmatism.
- You have good communication and language (English is required) skills and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are open to sharing your knowledge with colleagues and ambitious to develop yourself as a researcher.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Inspirational work environment

In the University of Vaasa, we conduct combustion engine research focused on advanced energy concepts and alternative fuels. We have a special focus on large bore-marine and stationary engines, for which we have a unique, state of the art, research facilities at EnergyLab. With close collaboration with industry, we are transforming the energy sector by bringing the cutting-edge technology to real-world application. We welcome you to join one of the most fascinating energy innovation centers in the Nordic region in combustion modelling and control. For more information about the facilities see: [EnergyLab](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/research-platforms/vebic/laboratories)https://www.uwasa.fi/en/newshub/news/university-vaasa-university-oulu-vtt-and-wartsila-are-building-energy-laboratoryhttps://w

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille nuorille/teineille
jobs.description:
Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia nuoria tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on mahdollisuus ottaa sijoitukseen teini-ikäisiä lapsia ja kykyä vastata heidän vaativiinkin tarpeisiinsa.

Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.

-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa
-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa
-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa
-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroa

Ennen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Osa valmennustapaamisista on perhekohtaisia ja osa toteutuu ryhmässä muiden valmennettavien perheiden kanssa (etäyhteydellä). Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.

Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:
-Ikä noin 25-60 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää lapsen iästä riippuen, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.

-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.

-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.

-Sopiva asumismuoto. Teinille pitää pystyä järjestämään omaa huonetta.

Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Ota siis rohkeasti yhteyttä, vaikkei jokainen kohta täyttyisi.
-Ei omia alle kouluikäisiä lapsia
-Kahden vanhemman perhe
-Mahdollisuutta auttaa kahta tai useampaa lasta (esim. sisarukset)
-Kokemusta erityisyydestä, esim. nepsyoireista, traumatyöskentelystä, oppimishäiriöistä
-Kokemusta kiintymyssuhteen rakentamisesta
-Kokemusta kasvatustyöstä
-Kokemusta lastensuojelusta

Työtä tukevia ammattikoulutuksia ovat esim. sosiaali- ja terveysalan- sekä kasvatustieteen koulutukset. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.

Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:
-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja
-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja
-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti
-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogi
Tai muu vastaava työkokemus.

Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.

Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja aidosti lapsen asioista huolehtiva joukko. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.

Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

jobs.title: Asistent preventisty pro práci s dětmi a mládeží mimoškolních aktivit [m/ž], Ostatní pracovníci péče o děti v mimoškolských zařízeních
jobs.description:
[] Místo výkonu práce: Staré Křečany č.p. 39
407 61  Staré Křečany

Asistent preventisty jpodporuje praventistu při každodenní práci s dětmi a mládeží. Jeho role je zaměřena zejména na dostupnost pracovníků cílovou skupinu, navazování kontaktů, přitomnost v terénu a pomoc při realizaci aktivit. Důležitá schopnost vytvářet vztah, pracovat s neformální autoritou a budovat důvěru.

Základní předpoklady
• bezúhonnost;
• nejméně středoškolské vzdělání ukončené výučním listem;
• schopnost navazovat přirozený kontakt s dětmi a mladými lidmi;
• sspolehlivost, respektující komunikace a schopnost týmové práce;
• výhodou je znalost místního prostředí a místní komunity.

Hlavní činnosti
1. Podpora ternní práce
2. Podpora kroužků a komunitních aktivit
3. Motivace cílové skupiny
4. Práce s rodinami
5. Monitoring situace ve veřejném prostoru
6. Administrativní pomoc

Požadavky na uchazeče
• aktivní a vstřícný přístup k dětem a mladým lidem;
• schopnost pracovat s různorodou cílovou skupinou včetně dětí a mládeže ze sociálně vyloučeného prostředí;
• odolnost vůčui zátěži, schopnost zachovat klid v konfliktní nebo nepřehledné situaci;
• ochota pracovat také v odpoledních hodinách, případně při komunitních akcích podle harmonogramu projektu;
• schopnost vést požadovanou dokumentaci a předávat informace v rámci pracovního týmu;
• respektování pravidel bezpečnosti, ochrany dětí, mlšenlivoati a ochrany osobních údajů.

Výhody
• zkušenost s prací s dětmi, mládeží, komunitou nebo ve volnočasových aktivitách;
• zkušenost s preventivními programy, sportovními nebo kreativními aktivitami;
• zkušenost s prací v terénu nebo s osobami ohroženými sociálním vyloučením;
• kurzy nebo vzdělání v pedagogické, sociální, volnočasové, preventivní nebo odborné oblasti;
• řidičské oprávnění sk. B a aktivní řidič.

Zaměstnavatel nabízí
• pracovní poměr na plný úvazek v projektu zaměřeném na podporu dětí a mládže;
• smysluplnou práci s přímým dopadem na život místní komunity;
• apolupráci s preventistou, asistentem preventisty, sociálnm pracovníkem, školou, obcí a dalšími partnery;
• metodickou podporou a možnost dalšího vzdělání.
• platový tarif: 6. platová třída

Přihláška do výběrového řízení musí obsahovat
- jméno a příjmení, případně akademický titut
- datum narození,
- adresu bydliště,
- kontaktní telefon a e-mail,
- označení pracovní pozice nebo pozic o které se uchazeč uchází,
- datum a podpis uchazeče

K přihlášce uchazeč přiloží
• strukturovaný profesní životopis;
• motivační dopis se stručným uvedením zkušeností s prací s dětmi, mládeží nebo komunitou;
• kopii dokladu o nejvyšším dosaženém vzdělání;
• výpis z evidence Rejstříku trestů ne starší než 3 měsíce, případně čestné prohlášení o
bezúhonnosti s tím, že doklad bude vyžádán před uzavřením pracovního poměru;
• případně kopie osvědčení, kurzů nebo jiných dokladů prokazujících relevantní zkušenosti.

jobs.description:
Pracovník/ce údržby zeleně
Do našeho týmu ve společnosti Benpra servis s.r.o. hledáme zodpovědného a manuálně zručného kolegu na pozici Pracovník údržby zeleně. Baví Vás práce venku, máte vztah k přírodě a technice? Pak hledáme právě Vás!

Místo výkonu práce / startovací bod: Elektrárna Hodonín (U Elektrárny 3030/1, 695 01 Hodonín)

Pracovní poměr: HPP (plný úvazek, 40 hodin týdně)

Typ provozu: Jednosměnný provoz (flexibilní pracovní doba)

Mzdové rozpětí: 36 200 Kč až 41 200 Kč hrubého / měsíc (v závislosti na zkušenostech) + osobní ohodnocení

Co bude Vaší náplní práce?
Stanete se součástí stabilní tříčlenné pracovní skupiny. Vaším úkolem bude:

Provádění kompletních prací při údržbě zeleně (sečení, kácení, ořezy stromů ze země i z plošiny).

Obsluha a běžná údržba strojů (křovinořez, motorová pila, štěpkovač, plošina, traktor s lesní frézou).

Realizace zakázek především v regionu Jižní Moravy, výjimečně ve Středních Čechách. Výjezdy i návraty jsou vždy z našeho zázemí v Elektrárně Hodonín.

Co od Vás požadujeme?
Řidičský průkaz: Skupina B podmínkou (skupina T nebo E velkou výhodou).

Praxi v oboru: Minimálně 2 roky (5 let výhodou).

Dobrou technickou znalost pracovních strojů a jejich ovládání.

Základní přehled a poznávání dřevin, orientaci v terénu.

Platné profesní průkazy (pila, křovinořez, plošiny) výhodou – případně Vás rádi doškolíme.

Čistý trestní rejstřík (nutný pro vystavení vstupní karty do střeženého areálu EHO).

Aktivní přístup k úkolům, samostatnost, spolehlivost a dobrou fyzickou kondici.

Co Vám za to nabízíme?
Motivující finanční ohodnocení: Základní mzda 36 200 – 41 200 Kč hrubého + osobní ohodnocení navázané na hospodářský výsledek společnosti.

Finanční benefity: Stravenkový paušál a pravidelné příspěvky na dojíždění.

Odměnu za doporučení: Finanční prémii za získání nového kolegy do týmu (náborový příspěvek).

Zázemí a vybavení: Firemní vozidlo pro pracovní účely, mobilní telefon s výhodným tarifem a špičkové pracovní oděvy/ochranné pomůcky.

Skvělý tým: Příjemný a kvalifikovaný kolektiv, společné akce a teambuildingy.

Odborné vzdělávání, profesní rozvoj a slevy u našich dodavatelů.

Máte zájem o tuto pozici?
Pokud Vás naše nabídka zaujala, pošlete nám svůj životopis.

jobs.description:
About This Role

  • Enjoy a variety of field work and office-based work
  • Ongoing, Full Time Opportunity in Bendigo
  • Salary Range $72,189 - $79,753 plus superannuation

Do you have great communication skills and want to be a role model to people hoping for a second chance? If you want to make time to help people get their lives back on track, read on.

Who are we?

Community Work and Partnerships We are responsible for the development of mutually beneficial partnerships with government agencies and non-government organisations so that individuals can undertake unpaid work as part of their community-based sentence imposed by the Courts of Victoria. Community work serves as a valuable way for individuals to pay back the community while also reconnecting and reintegrating into the community. We ensure individuals make genuine efforts to undergo rehabilitation, and we keep low risk individuals out of prison and help them contribute to the community.

What does a Field Officer do?

Your primary responsibility as a Field Officer will be to supervise a team of clients at community work sites and other community work programs. A field officer carries out many duties and functions, mainly the supervision of individuals completing community work tasks. Other responsibilities include performing site inspections, assess hazards, providing informed workplace health and safety advice, guidance and instruction; maintaining tools and equipment resister and ensuring repairs are undertaken.

A day in the life of a Field Officer. . .

Your shift starts at a Justice Service Centre location where you collect a bus/ trailer with equipment. You then drive to a site to collect a group of clients, where you will induct, instruct and transport them to a partner not-for-profit organisation in the community. Tasks for the day may involve graffiti removal, painting, litter collection, mowing and weeding. Your responsibility is to instruct the individuals to safely perform each task and monitor the work performed for the partner site before returning them to the drop off point and returning to your depot.

We are looking for individuals with various backgrounds and experience. Some desirable skills include:

  • You'll need to be able to communicate and demonstrate a range of tasks and ensure a safe environment for work teams.
  • Have a strong understanding of Occupational Health and Safety practices and their practical application.
  • Quickly build rapport in order to understand the motivations of others, identify issues and suggest courses of action appropriate to their needs.
  • Have demonstrated ability to manage conflict and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Model appropriate behaviours and attitudes to assist individuals to develop new skills and work practices.
  • Carpentry or handyman skills
  • Gardening landscaping or painting skills

Field Officers carry out a mixture of field work and office-based work, so it's important that you are able to demonstrate computer skills and written communication skills.

Transporting individuals is also a key part of the role and Field Officers will be required to drive a 12-seater bus with trailer. A full and current drivers' licence is essential for this position.

Community Work operates seven days per week and this role will be required to work on weekends. Weekend availability is required.

For More Information About The Role Please Contact

Sarah Thompson â Manager, Community Work & Partnerships on 0407 427 396 or Sarah.Thompson@justice.vic.gov.au

How To Apply

Please click the Apply button at the bottom of this advertisement. Applications should include a resume uploaded in .doc, .docx, .pdf, .txt or .rtf formats.

The Assessment Process Will Entail The Following

  • Several questions in the application form upon submitting your resume
  • A phone screen
  • An interview
  • Reference checks
  • Security checks
  • Health assessment â medical history and physical fitness components

The successful candidate will be required to undergo pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, nationally coordinated criminal history checks (NCCHC), and misconduct screening. Dependant on the role, other checks may include VicRoads checks, drivers licence checks, medical checks, Working with Children Checks, and Declaration of Private Interests (for executive and responsible officer roles).

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application material, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people are strongly encouraged to apply.

Child Safe Statement Of Commitment

The Department of Justice and Community Safety is committed to the safety and wellbeing of children and young people. We seek to prevent harm of any kind impacting children and young people and have zero tolerance for racism, child abuse and inequality. Children and young people's rights, relationships, identity, and culture must be recognised and respected, their voices heard, and their concerns acted upon. We aim to foster a culturally safe, child safe and child friendly environment for all children and young people we have contact with, deliver services to, or are impacted by our work.

About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

When Legends Come To Life

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens.

On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

Responsible for the proper maintenance and repair of kitchen equipment throughout the property.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

  • Keeps all equipment in good repair with a minimum of downtime by providing day to day maintenance of the hotel under the direction of Engineering Management. Ensures a complete understanding of and adheres to the companyâs fire and safety procedures.

  • Responsible for the proper and timely completion of preventative maintenance systems.
  • Updates Manager regularly on assignments.
  • Performs all reasonable duties requested by management.

This is an exciting time to join The Ocean Club, a Four Seasons Resort.

Applicants that are interested in applying, please note that the position is based on The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort Property located in The Bahamas and is available to those individuals who possess a legal ability to work in The Bahamas without sponsorship.

Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. jobs.title: Manager, Enablement Programs
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

As Manager, Enablement Programs, you will own the programs and operating system that help sellers ramp fast and execute with confidence — from global onboarding to role-readiness, Field OS, and AI-enabled enablement workflows. This role exists because we’re evolving our Enablement and GTM motion, and we need a leader to drive that change: set the standard for what “great” looks like in the era of AI, build an AI-native enablement model, and own the agentic workflows that help the field execute.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By day 90: Build the first version of the Field OS as a seller-ramp unlock (priority workflows, trusted resources, and AI-enabled execution moments by role).

 - By day 90: Map and prototype the core custom agents that help sellers ramp faster and apply the right support at each stage of the sales process.

 - By day 90: Refresh onboarding around continuous iteration (A/B testing, measurement, and role-specific alignment to the sales process) and implement onboarding engagement + impact metrics.

 - By day 90: Stand up a dedicated manager onboarding track to help managers ramp faster and reinforce new-hire success consistently.

 - By end of year 1: Make onboarding and role readiness a repeatable system that measurably improves ramp and raises the bar on enablement quality through tight feedback loops and durable workflows.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven ability to design and run global enablement programs end-to-end (especially onboarding), including live + async modalities across regions and time zones.

 - Strong program leadership and operating cadence: clear roadmaps, decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and measurement that drives iteration (not just reporting).

 - Experience building scalable enablement systems (resource governance, intake processes, comms rhythms) that sellers actually use.

 - AI-fluent approach to enablement: using AI and automation to improve quality, speed, and consistency of seller execution (and instrumenting adoption/impact).

 - People leadership experience managing and developing a small team; sets high standards and builds a calm, high-ownership operating rhythm.

jobs.title: Regional Controller (m/f)
jobs.description:
Regional Controller

Location(s) Luxembourg, Luxembourg
Career Field Accounting & Finance
Job Number 192657

Your Job

Guardian is looking for motivated Regional Controller with a passion for transformation and eager to advance into their career. This position is responsible for the financial oversight of multiple manufacturing facilities within Europe by partnering with different teams to ensure delivery of controlling activities to expected level.

Our Team

This role has the opportunity cross-functionally work with diverse and experienced capabilities within Guardian and Koch in a mutually beneficial way to drive results for the company.

The role is based in Luxembourg.

What You Will Do

• Work cross functionally with multiple departments (operations, accounting etc.)  to ensure the core monthly financial statements - B/S, P&L, CFS - are produced timely and materially correct.
• Track, analyze, and report budget and profitability variance to leadership. Partner with different teams to obtain a reliable understanding over monthly business activity and events, provide support to accounting team to accurately capture the activity into financials. Drive/support successful execution of complex corporate transactions and business changes (mergers, liquidations, loan repayments, dividends etc.).
• Partner with local compliance team to ensure an accurate local result is reported in the statutory financial statements (e.g., support during audit/review of FS mapping). Accountability on accurate and timely submissions status of local filings (FS/VAT/CIT).
• Continuously seek and drive transformative improvements to organization, accounting processes and system utilization for controlling activities (e.g., overall process improvement and application of internal financial controls), ensure appropriate governance and follow-up on long-term open transactions.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

• Master's degree in accounting or finance.
• Experience in accounting and/or analytical finance roles.
• Experience working with multiple legal entities under different legal umbrellas.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable interacting regularly with the leadership team.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken).
• Strong Excel skills.
• Self-motivated with strong initiative and the ability to act independently.

What Will Put You Ahead

• Previous experience in a controller role
• Experience with US GAAP

jobs.description:
Solar Engineer, In-Orbit WPT Demo Mission (m/f/d)
Luxembourg (Onsite) • Full-time

Focus: You know that every ambitious space mission eventually comes down to "how much power do we really have?" and you're the person who enjoys making sure the answer is both accurate and impressive. As Solar Engineer, you'll own the solar cell and array side of TerraSpark's first space-to-Earth wireless power beaming demo. You'll be the in-house solar expert, responsible for the lightweight power generation system, how it bolts into the WPT payload and host spacecraft, and how it scales into future SBSP concepts.

What you'll do:

• Own the solar power generation concept for the in-orbit demo payload: pick the cells, size the array, and keep the power budget honest when everyone else is getting optimistic.
• Design and analyse lightweight, high-specific-power panels or array modules, and define how they mount, conduct heat, and plug into an integrated WPT payload and its slightly alarmed host spacecraft.
• Prototype and iterate solar modules and panel concepts for integration with the WPT payload, working hands-on with hardware to see which ideas survive contact with reality.
• Run technology development on advanced solar cells and module concepts with external partners, and help decide which shiny PV ideas deserve budget and which belong in slides.
• Plan and support environmental and performance tests for panels/modules, then use the results and degradation models to refine designs and gently remind people that radiation is not a suggestion.
• Provide clear solar/array inputs to system-level documents and reviews, including specs and interfaces, and act as the go-to person for "anything solar" with internal teams and suppliers.
• Support analysis of in-orbit array performance for the demo mission and channel the lessons into the next generation of SBSP designs, so each set of panels is slightly less surprised than the last.

What you bring:

• MSc or BSc in a relevant engineering or physics discipline, with several years of experience inspace solar cell and array design and development.
• A proven track record on advanced lightweight solar arrays or high-specific-power panelconcepts, ideally including at least one project that actually flew rather than just looked heroicin CAD.
• Strong understanding of space solar cell and array technologies, with experience in siliconand/or perovskite as a clear asset, plus familiarity with radiation and degradation effects andhow they ruin optimistic plots.
• Experience on solar array projects where low-cost and low-mass were the main designdrivers, and at least a passing respect for manufacturability and supply-chain reality.
• Extensive hands-on experience with panel/module hardware, and a genuine enjoyment ofbuild-test-iterate workflows and rapid prototyping in a hardware-rich environment.
• Experience with the mechanical and thermal realities of solar panels and the ability to workconstructively with structures and thermal engineers rather than just sending them harderrequirements.
• Comfort with the electrical side of arrays (stringing, limits, interfaces to power conditioning),plus a basic grasp of SBSP concepts and how your array choices affect the grand plan, andthe ability to work smoothly with systems, WPT, RF electronics, thermal, and structurescolleagues.

jobs.title: Telecom Lead (m/f)
jobs.description:
Telecom Lead

Role Summary

The Telecom Lead is responsible for leading and growing OQ Technology's telecom engineering team and for the technical direction of the end-to-end telecommunication system that underpins the Company's 3GPP-based 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN). The role brings together the Core Network, physical-layer/DSP, and protocol-stack disciplines into a single, coherent engineering roadmap, and holds ultimate accountability for the architecture, quality, and delivery of the telecommunication stack from research and prototyping through to operational deployment on the Company's satellite missions.

The Telecom Lead manages the Senior Core Network Engineer, Core Network Engineer, DSP Algorithm Engineer, Telecom Engineer, and any other engineers assigned to the telecom function, setting priorities, allocating work, developing technical talent, and acting as the primary point of technical and people- management accountability for the team. The Company may assign the Employee to any other job or tasks if it believes it is in its best interests to do so.

Key Responsibilities

The list below is representative and not exhaustive of the tasks and responsibilities of the role.

• Lead, manage, and grow the telecom engineering team, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance management.
• Plan resourcing and recruitment for the team, define roles and career paths, and build the technical bench
strength required to deliver the Company's telecommunication roadmap.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture across the core network, DSP/physical layer, and protocol-stack disciplines, and ensure effective knowledge-sharing between them.
• Own the technical onboarding of new engineers and ensure consistent engineering standards, coding practices, and design-review discipline across the team.

Technical Ownership and Architecture

• Hold overall technical authority for the architecture and evolution of OQ Technology's telecommunication
system, spanning the Core Network, the physical layer/DSP chain, and the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack adapted for NTN.
• Define the technical roadmap and research strategy for new functions, algorithms, and system architectures for 4G/5G communication over Non-Terrestrial Networks, and align it with the Company's product and mission timelines.
• Review and approve system-level designs, ensuring consistency and interoperability across core network, baseband/DSP, and protocol-stack workstreams, and across the space, ground, and user segments.
• Set and enforce engineering standards, design-review practices, and quality gates for networking architectures and control algorithms against latency, high-availability, and Quality of Experience requirements, from prototype through operational deployment.
• Own system performance models and lead cross-functional systems-engineering activities related to end-to end system performance optimisation.
• Guide the design and implementation of microservices-based, real-time and near real-time applications, and of DSP algorithms and baseband processing for the telecommunication payload and user terminals.
• Oversee the development, optimisation, and continuous upgrade of the protocol stack(s) supporting current and future missions, ensuring features are delivered against space and product team requirements.
• Approve subsystem budgets and specifications, and confirm regulatory and mission compliance in coordination with the systems engineering team.

Delivery, Testing, and Operations

• Direct the full development lifecycle across the team, from concept, prototyping, and proof-of-concept experimentation through implementation, verification, integration, and deployment.
• Ensure rigorous validation of telecommunication software and hardware features through simulation, lab testing, and end-to-end testing in simulated NTN environments.
• Oversee the maintenance, upgrade, and improvement of the internal telecommunications and RF lab, and ensure appropriate configuration control and version management of all deliverables.
• Support the space team with authoritative technical inputs for the design, optimisation, and maintenance of Operational and Demo Missions, including mission needs, expected performance, dependability, and safety goals.
• Own the resolution of escalations and cross-team technical blockers, and ensure timely, transparent reporting of progress and risks to senior management.

Stakeholder, Partner, and Standards Engagement

• Lead technical discussions and negotiations with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, contractors, and research institutes, including evaluation of designs and acceptance of deliverables.
• Represent the Company in standardisation bodies and lead the Company's technical contributions to relevant standardisation activities.
• Own or contribute to technical documentation for project reviews, including ESA-related deliverables, and defend designs at formal project and customer reviews.
• Work with and support teams across OQ Subsidiaries and manage technical interfaces with external partners and contracting organisations.

Planning and Reporting

• Participate in project management and planning activities, including proposals, roadmaps, budgets, and resourcing for the telecom engineering function.
• Provide regular reporting on team progress, technical risks, and delivery status to the Head of Engineering / CTO and other stakeholders.
• Ensure proper documentation of all technology development undertaken by the team and maintain traceability for audits and project reviews.

Requirements

Education

• Master's degree (or higher) in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. A PhD is a plus.

Experience

• Significant professional experience (typically 8+ years) in telecommunications engineering, spanning at least two of the following domains: core network (EPC/5GC), physical layer/DSP, or protocol stack development.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, including performance management, technical coaching, and resource planning.
• Hands-on experience with 3GPP-based 4G/5G systems; experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) or satellite communications is highly desirable.
• Experience engaging with standardisation bodies (3GPP, GSMA, ITU) and managing relationships with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, or research institutes.
• Track record of taking systems from research/prototype through to operational deployment, including verification and validation in lab and field environments.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of Core Network architecture and functions (MME, SPGW, HSS, OAM, IREG, IPX, BCE) and of NFV/microservices-based network applications.
• Solid understanding of physical-layer and DSP concepts (modem design, baseband processing, transceiver architecture) and of the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack.
• Proficiency with relevant development and simulation tools (e.g. C/C++, MATLAB, VHDL) and with CI/CD and version-control tools (e.g. Git).
• Familiarity with systems-engineering practices, including requirements derivation, performance modelling,and subsystem budgeting (e.g. RF link and power budgets).

Leadership and Personal Skills

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and people-management skills, with the ability to develop technical talent and build a high-performing team.
• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, able to engage effectively with senior management, external partners, and standardisation bodies.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, able to balance strategic technical direction with hands-on problem-solving when required.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for partner, supplier, or standardisation meetings

jobs.title: Vehicle Detailer

Why youâll love it at Clutch

jobs.title: TEHNIČAR/KA ZA PRIPREMU SMJENE
jobs.description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI d.d. dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedna od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka za pripremu smjene Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:
  • Zaduženje za održavanje strojeva linije obrade duhana i otklanjanje pronađenih nedostataka najranije moguće.
  • Dnevno kontrolira čišćenje, podmazivanje, kontrole curenja ulja na svim strojevima.
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.
  • Dnevna kontrola i otklanjanje kvarova na sustavu linija otprašivanja.
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.
  • Radi na smanjenju potrošnje energije.
  • Izrada dijelova u skladu sa dostavljenim specifikacijama.
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.
  • Sudjeluje u instalaciji proizvodne opreme i strojeva.
  • Nadzire rad opreme i strojeva, brine o hidraulučnim platformama i pometačima podova u pogonu.
  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.
  • Po potrebi radi u drugim sektorima, sva područja obrade duhana (pakiranje, sušenje, biranje, ulaz, itd.), na sjetvi plitica, otkupu duhana.
  • Ostali zadaci u skladu s naravi i vrstom rada po nalogu neposredno nadređenog.
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema.
  • Zahtijevana struka: tehnička struke (elektro, strojarska).
  • Osnovno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Osnovno znanje rada na računalu: Ms Office.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.
  • Financijske pogodnosti: Božićnica, regres za godišnji odmor, naknada za podmirivanje troškova prehrane, potpora za rođenje djeteta, naknada za troškove prijevoza, itd.
  • Priznanja i nagrade: godišnji bonus, godišnja korekcija plaće, razna nefinacijska nagrađivanja putem nominacija za prepoznavanje truda i postignuća.
  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. Raspon bruto I plaće: 1.080,00 – 1.350,00 € Životopis i molbu dostaviti na e-mail adresu: posao_hd@bat.com uz obaveznu naznaku u naslovu mail-a za koji točno natječaj se prijavljujete.   • Rad iz ureda: Posao se obavlja isključivo iz našeg ureda u Splitu (nije remote), što nam omogućuje bržu internu komunikaciju i bolju timsku sinergiju.

Uvjeti:

  • Iskustvo u korisničkoj podršci, account managementu ili telefonskoj prodaji (računamo i studentski rad)
  • Empatija i sposobnost slušanja: razumiješ potrebe klijenata i pretvaraš ih u konkretne korake

Što nudimo:

Zašto se pridružiti:

  • Napredovanje svakih 12 mjeseci
  • Vikendi i večeri su slobodni – rad-život balans nam je važan – radimo samo do 16 h radnim danom
  • Moderna oprema, besplatna kava i tim koji dijeli znanje i iskustvo

Osiguravamo ti između 20 i 30 dana odmora, ovisno o tvojoj dobi i stažu unutar naše firme. Posebno cijenimo tvoje slobodno vrijeme, stoga potičemo korištenje dužeg godišnjeg odmora tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi u potpunosti napunilo baterije.

  • organizacija i planiranje ruta
  • svakodnevna komunikacija s vozačima

  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • dobro snalaženje s digitalnim alatima, programima i tehnologijom
  • organiziranost, odgovornost i komunikativnost
  • sposobnost brzog reagiranja i rješavanja problema

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join our Commercial Counsel team. This senior role will help build and support Notion’s rapidly evolving Enterprise customer sales motions, bringing deep expertise in negotiating complex AI SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, as well as acting as an advisor and coach to our account teams and cross functional partners. Notion is scaling rapidly, and we need people who work well as a tight-knit team with a passion for driving revenue deals to conclusion. If you enjoy using your deep industry and technology transaction expertise to support revenue generating functions, this role is for you.


Our Commercial Legal team sits at the center of Notion’s growth. We simplify how customers contract with us, take clear and unambiguous positions on AI, privacy, and security, and drive revenue deals to a fast, predictable close. That means exercising real judgment and finding creative, pragmatic paths forward through complex customer requests and requirements.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Have broad responsibility for negotiating SaaS AI agreements and providing practical day-to-day commercial legal support - primarily in the Americas region - for the sales, marketing, channels, and customer success teams with a focus on supporting the Enterprise segment

 - Collaborate with Product Legal team on product and operational items that impact customer agreements and go-to-market initiatives

 - Draft and negotiate complex agreements regarding privacy, security, and AI regulatory matters

 - Identify and independently pursue process improvements for buy-side supporting motions

 - Develop and revise contract templates and playbooks as necessary, based on changes in our product offerings, organization, and law




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Admitted to the California State Bar, New York State Bar, or Registered In-House Counsel in good standing

 - 10+ years of combined experience practicing as a commercial attorney within a law firm or software technology company

 - 2+ years in-house experience at a SaaS and/or AI technology company

 - Privacy and artificial intelligence subject matter expertise, including privacy regulations (GDPR, e-Privacy Directive, CCPA, etc.) and AI regulations (EU AI Act) with the ability to incorporate evolving requirements into the customer facing agreements

 - Experience driving commercial transactions, SaaS, and enterprise B2B transactions

 - Strong negotiation skills, including ability to explain nuanced legal concepts to internal and external parties and tailor approach to the audience

 - Excellent drafting, written and verbal communication skills and ability to adapt legal requirements in balanced, creative and pragmatic ways to facilitate communication at all levels of the organization

 - Ability to directly interact and build meaningful relationships and trust with internal and external clients and leaders

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role

 - Resilience, resourcefulness, and the ability to make recommendations and decisions with imperfect facts

 - Independent and strategic thought combined with excellent team player qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Certified Information Privacy Professional or equivalent

 - Prior experience with a fast growing technology company

 - Experience supporting channel and reseller partnerships

 - Experience supporting customers in the financial services industry

 - Familiarity using Notion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $280,000-340,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)

At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Jeg hedder Cathrine, og jeg arbejder hos JobHuntWorldwide. Jeg kender følelsen af at stå med lysten til at tage af sted, men ikke helt vide, hvordan man gør det. Det er præcis derfor, jeg er her, til at gøre processen nem og tryg for dig.

Drømmer du om at bruge dit sabbatår på noget helt andet end hverdagen i Danmark? Jeg hjælper unge danskere med at finde arbejde i udlandet – både hvis du vil udvikle dig fagligt, møde nye mennesker eller bare prøve noget helt nyt for en periode.

Vi samarbejder med virksomheder i bl.a. Spanien, Grækenland, Portugal, Malta, Cypern, Vietnam og Filippinerne, og mange stillinger kræver ingen tidligere erfaring.

Hvad kan du forvente?

✔ Gratis og uforpligtende karrieresamtale

Vi starter altid med en personlig snak om dine ønsker for dit sabbatår. Vil du opkvalificeres? Vil du have et socialt fællesskab? Eller vil du bare prøve noget helt nyt? Jeg hjælper dig med at finde den løsning, der passer til dig.

✔ Hjælp til at finde det rette job

Dine muligheder afhænger af, hvornår du vil afsted, og hvor længe du kan være væk. Mange virksomheder ansætter uden erfaring, mens andre har specifikke krav – det gennemgår vi sammen.

Du skal som udgangspunkt kunne sige ja til 4–6 måneder, og du får naturligvis betalt ferie, så du kan rejse hjem undervejs.

✔ Professionel forberedelse til jobinterview

Når vi har fundet et match, præsenterer jeg dig for virksomheden og klæder dig på til interviewet. Du får:

  • Feedback på dit CV

  • Råd om spørgsmål du bør stille

  • Forventningsafstemning om bolig, løn, kontrakt og praktiske forhold

Jeg følger dig hele vejen frem til din første arbejdsdag.

Hvilke typer job kan du få?

Der er mange muligheder – alt efter dine ønsker og kompetencer. Eksempler:

  • Kundeservice og teknisk support

  • Rejsebranchen og booking

  • Telemarketing og mødebooking

  • Reception og administration

  • Fundraising

  • Online kundekommunikation

  • Online gaming Presenter

  • Specialiserede roller (fx gaming support, ansvarlig spilrådgivning, medicinsk assistance)

Nogle stillinger inkluderer betalt fly, hotel eller firmabolig, afhængigt af landet og virksomheden.

Vigtige råd, før du siger ja.

Jeg hjælper dig med at træffe den rigtige beslutning ved at gennemgå bl.a.:

  • Arbejdsforhold og kontrakt

  • Boligmuligheder og økonomi

  • Løn, udbetaling og ferie

  • Oplæring og forventninger

  • Stabilitet i projektet

  • Hvad du ønsker at få ud af dit ophold

Det er vigtigt, at du vælger et job, der passer til dine mål – ikke bare det første og bedste.

Sådan kommer du i gang.

Du kan booke en gratis og uforpligtende karrieresnak med mig, hvor vi gennemgår dine muligheder og hjælper dig med at finde det rette match.

Kontakt os på Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Eller du kan også allerede nu booke en snak med mig via dette link: Book et kald

jobs.title: H&M Visual Merchandiser Plaza del Sol
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

As a Visual Merchandiser, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.



A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*



Customer Sales & Profit

  • Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
  • Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
  • Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
  • Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
  • Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
  • Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
  • Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
  • Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

  • Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, products, brands, competitors, and relevant influencers etc.
  • Plan time for fashion & trend awareness to understand trend theory and mood boards for styling techniques and product presentation to anticipate our customerâs needs and enhance our shopping experience in store

Team & Development

  • Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
  • Coach and develop the Store teamÂ´s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
  • Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
  • Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues
  • Organize, provide, and carry out the visual & commercial upskilling for you and your colleagues
  • Complete Visual Competencies & Commercial 4 All trainings based on Regional & Sales Market learning and development goals
  • Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

  • Execute the visual & commercial curation & styling for the store based on commercial calendar, allocation, store activation plan and fashion trends according to mood boards and direction from the visual & commercial guidelines
  • Carry out sample picking best practice routines including stockroom garment quantities, accessories, and shoes to ensure you create clear trends and stories according to inspiration from the visual & commercial guidelines
  • Secure window & styling execution according to visual & commercial guidelines to create inspirational and commercial customer experience
  • Provide good customer flow by maintaining commercial layout, fixtures, to secure the best trend story placement
  • Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in windows and throughout the store following guidelines according to Global strategy and Sales Market requirements
  • In collaboration with Facilities Management ensure all lighting is working correctly, aimed to highlight our products and display forms in windows and throughout the store
  • Maintain and care for all display forms and interior material (fixtures & fittings) with sustainability in mind
  • In collaboration with Area Visual Manager ensure your store navigation is maintained and kept up to date according to latest guidelines and store layout
  • Ensure your store has enough quantities of sale and other activity including POS material according to local routines
  • Keep sales floor and back of house clean, organized, and safe according to local security guidelines

Qualifications

Who You Are

  • For you to be a successful Visual Merchandiser, you must be curious and creative; always looking for inspiration, proactive, solution focused, flexible, with effective communication skills to achieve results cross functionally.
  • We look for individuals with fashion interests and leadership skills who can apply their visual and commercial experience working in a dynamic environment to the role.
  • Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
  • Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
  • Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports

Why Youâll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • Youâll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where youâre encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
  • Youâll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Additional Information

Compensation: expected base salary range is $16.50 - $18.98 hourly**

EEOC Code: SLS

Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the companyâs discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program â HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage â Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay â 401K â Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, weâre determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

jobs.title: Produktion av reklamställ, mässmonterbyggnation samt slutbehandling av tryck och förpackning
jobs.description:
Produktionsmedarbetare till TETRIX – för dig som gillar att kunna lite av allt

På TETRIX bygger vi mässmontrar, displaysystem, ljuslådor, reklamställningar och speciallösningar för företag. En del produkter tillverkar vi om och om igen. Andra har vi aldrig byggt tidigare.

Därför söker vi inte nödvändigtvis någon som redan kan allt. Vi söker dig som **gillar att lära dig nya saker, lösa problem och få saker färdiga.**

Vad gör man då hos oss?

Aluminiumkonstruktionerna till våra produkter tillverkar vi i vår egen aluminiumverkstad. Där kapas lätta aluminiumprofiler, lås och beslag monteras och det förekommer borrning, gängning och enklare maskinarbete.

Du behöver inte kunna det från början. **Vi lär dig.**

Eftersom vi gör mycket kundanpassat dyker det regelbundet upp saker som inte riktigt finns i någon manual. Då behöver man kunna fundera:

_Hur löser vi det här på ett enkelt och smart sätt?_

Ibland finns svaret redan hos någon av oss. Ibland får man mäta, prova, fundera och prova igen.

Vi producerar också storbildsgrafik till våra mässmontrar och reklamställningar. Våra storbildsplottrar skriver ut bilderna, varefter grafiken ska renskäras, efterbehandlas och anpassas till systemen.

När alla delar är klara testbygger vi ofta produkten. Den ska passa ihop, fungera och se ut som den ska innan kunden får den.

Sedan packas den för transport – eller så åker vi ut och bygger upp hela lösningen hos kunden.

Ena dagen aluminium – nästa dag något helt annat

Det här är alltså inte jobbet för dig som helst vill göra exakt samma arbetsmoment varje dag.

En dag kan du kapa aluminium och montera beslag.

Nästa dag kanske du skär storbildsgrafik, packar en mässmonter som ska till Sverige, letar fram delar från lagret eller försöker lista ut hur vi ska bygga en specialkonstruktion som någon har ritat.

Och ibland står en mässa runt hörnet, transporten går snart och **allt ska bli klart.**

Då behöver vi arbetsmyran i dig.

Den som inte ger upp när det blir bråttom utan istället börjar fundera på vad som måste göras först, vad som kan göras samtidigt och hur vi tillsammans får allt över mållinjen.

Bråttom betyder däremot inte att det får bli dåligt. Kunden ska fortfarande få rätt delar, snygg grafik och en produkt som fungerar.

Vi tror att du passar hos oss om...

Du är lite av en **tusenkonstnär**.

Du behöver inte vara aluminiumexpert, grafiker, montör, lagerarbetare och uppfinnare redan när du kommer genom dörren. Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken nog att lära dig.

Du behöver inte heller vara någon maskinexpert. Men det är ett stort plus om du inte blir nervös av tanken:

_"Den där maskinen har jag aldrig använt. Visa mig."_

Vi visar. Du provar. Snart kan du den.

Du bör också ha ett naturligt öga för detaljer. Ser du att något sitter snett, ligger på fel plats eller borde städas undan är tanken att du fixar det – inte väntar på att någon ska skriva en arbetsorder.

Hos oss hör ordning faktiskt till produktionen. Delarna ska gå att hitta, lagret ska hållas i skick och arbetsplatserna ska vara sådana att nästa jobb går snabbt att starta.

Det viktigaste är hur du fungerar

Nästan alla enskilda arbetsmoment hos oss är ganska enkla när man väl har lärt sig dem.

Utmaningen ligger istället i **variationen och helheten**.

Du behöver kunna växla mellan olika uppgifter, tänka själv, fråga när du inte vet och efter hand lära dig att se vad som behöver göras utan att någon hela tiden pekar ut nästa arbetsmoment.

Vissa dagar behövs uppfinnaren.

Andra dagar behövs problemlösaren.

Och ibland behövs helt enkelt arbetsmyran som bestämmer sig för att:

**Det här ska bli klart.**

Vi uppskattar människor som vågar prova. Gör man många speciallösningar kommer inte första idén alltid att vara den bästa. Det viktiga är att kunna tänka om och hitta en bättre lösning.

Praktiskt

Du behöver **B-körkort**, eftersom arbetet ibland innebär transporter eller montering hos kund.

Vi arbetar med kunder på flera språk. Kan du svenska och finska är det utmärkt. Engelska är också mycket användbart eftersom både kunder, leverantörer och instruktioner kan vara internationella.

Erfarenhet från produktion, aluminium, snickeri, reklamproduktion, montering, lager, byggande, maskiner eller liknande är naturligtvis ett plus.

Men rätt inställning väger tungt.

**Kan du inte – lär vi dig. Förstår du inte – frågar du. Finns ingen färdig lösning – försöker vi hitta en.**

Det är ungefär så vi jobbar på TETRIX.

Så om du gillar praktiskt arbete, teknik, problemlösning och variation – och helst vill ha ett jobb där du fortfarande kan lära dig något nytt nästa år – då kan det här vara rätt plats för dig.

jobs.title: Redovisningskonsult – föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder
jobs.description:
Rantalainen är Finlands ledande och snabbväxande expertorganisation inom ekonomi- och löneadministrativa tjänster. Vi finns på över 100 kontor i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Vi erbjuder företag i alla storlekar ett brett utbud av tjänster inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, HR samt företagsbeskattning för att stötta deras affärsverksamhet och framgång. Våra närmare 45 000 kundföretag har tillgång till kompetensen hos över 2 700 experter. Läs mer om oss på vår webbplats här [https://www.rantalainen.fi/sv/].



Vi söker nu en redovisningskonsult för ett föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder i Västra Nyland!



I denna roll arbetar du med ett konsultativt arbetssätt med våra kundföretags bokföring, bokslut och andra uppgifter inom ekonomiförvaltning. Du har regelbunden kontakt med dina kunder och använder din expertis för att omvandla ekonomiska siffror till beslutsunderlag samt bidra till utvecklingen av våra kunders verksamhet ur ett ekonomiskt perspektiv.

Du får planera och genomföra ditt arbete självständigt, men har alltid stöd av ditt eget team och hela vår breda expertorganisation. Som stöd i arbetet har du ett glatt och hjälpsamt team samt din närmaste chef.



Ditt teams bas finns på det Rantalainen-kontor som ligger närmast dig, till exempel i Västra Nyland eller huvudstadsregionen. Vi hoppas att du vid behov har möjlighet att arbeta på något av våra kontor tillsammans med de övriga teammedlemmarna. Enligt överenskommelse kan du också delvis arbeta på distans. Tjänsten är ett tidsbegränsat föräldraledighetsvikariat med en beräknad anställningstid från 1.10.2026 – 31.10.2027.



Vad erbjuder Rantalainen dig?

På Rantalainen erbjuder vi dig en intressant och ansvarsfull roll på Finlands ledande redovisningsbyrå inom en spännande bransch. Hos oss får du stöd av en kunnig organisation, goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och moderna arbetsverktyg. Som en flexibel arbetsgivare ger vi dig friheten att planera ditt eget arbete, flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete, så att det blir enklare att kombinera arbetet med övriga delar av livet.

Vår ambition är att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, både idag och i framtiden. På Rantalainen värdesätts varje medarbetare för den hen är, och hos oss får du en trivsam arbetsmiljö och en rättvis värdegrund. Vi satsar på ett kvalitativt ledarskap och goda karriärmöjligheter inom företaget.



Läs mer om våra omfattande personalförmåner och om Rantalainen som arbetsgivare på vår webbplats. Du kan också kolla Markus medarbetarberättelse och läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss som redovisningskonsult.



Det här hoppas vi att du har med dig?

Vi hoppas att du har en utbildning inom ekonomiförvaltning och erfarenhet av arbete inom området. Att upprätta bokslut är välbekant för dig, och du behärskar helheten inom ekonomiförvaltning samt arbetar självständigt. Du arbetar smidigt med kunder, och därför förutsätter vi att du kan arbeta på både svenska och finska. Kunskaper i engelska räknas till fördel.



Vi värdesätter erfarenhet av olika programvaror inom ekonomiförvaltning samt en vilja att lära dig nya system. Till dessa erbjuder vi naturligtvis en grundlig introduktion. Hos oss får du möjlighet att upprätthålla och utveckla din kompetens genom mångsidiga och kontinuerliga utbildningar.



Vänligen ansök så snart som möjligt, dock senast 6.9.2026. Vi behandlar ansökningar redan under ansökningstiden och fattar beslut så snart en lämplig person hittas. Vänta alltså inte till sista ansökningsdagen. Vi kontrollerar kreditupplysningar för den person som väljs i slutet av rekryteringsprocessen. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar per e-post.
