Prijavi na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (presliku važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice, domovnice ili vojne iskaznice),
  • presliku diplome kojom se potvrđuje ispunjavanje uvjeta razine obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem
  • elektronički zapis (u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od trideset dana, računajući od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama),
  • običnu presliku dokaza o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima za cijeli period koji je kao uvjet naveden u javnom natječaju (rješenje o rasporedu, ugovor o radu ili uvjerenje poslodavca o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima koje mora sadržavati: vrstu poslova koju je obavljao, koja struka i stupanj stručne spreme je zahtijevan za njih i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove), za radna mjesta pod rednim brojem 1, 2 i 3,
  • ako je u elektroničkom zapisu ili potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (stvarna/potrebna stručna sprema / vrsta i razina obrazovanja) evidentiran radni staž, potrebno je priložiti dokaz da je osoba bez radnog iskustva ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od 12 mjeseci na odgovarajućim poslovima u traženom zvanju i struci, koji mora sadržavati podatke o vrsti poslova koje je osoba obavljala, s kojim zvanjem i strukom te u kojem razdoblju (rješenje, ugovor o radu, potvrda poslodavca ili druga isprava kojom to dokazuje), za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 4,
  • presliku dokaza o položenom državnom ispitu propisane razine (ako kandidat ima položen državni ispit propisane razine),
  • presliku stručnog ovlaštenja ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru (za radno mjesto unutarnji revizor),
  • presliku dokaza o poznavanju rada na računalu (certifikat o poznavanju rada na računalu koji se priznaje u zemljama Europske unije ili uvjerenje o osposobljenosti za Računalnog operatera poslovne primjene računala ili svjedodžbu odgovarajućeg razreda srednje škole ili iskaz ocjena sveučilišnog ili stručnog studija (visokoškolske ustanove) iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno položen predmet informatike ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu ovlaštenog organizatora tečaja informatike iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno završen tečaj informatike u čijem su nastavnom sadržaju obuhvaćene osnove rada na računalu i operacijski sustav Windows, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook-elektronička pošta i rad na internetu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu kandidata da kod njega ne postoje zapreke za prijam u službu iz članka 15. i članka 16. ZSN-a (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeravati).
Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži isprave u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (vjenčani list, rodni list i sl.). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti mail-adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Kandidati koji se istovremeno prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako pojedino radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu sa svim traženim prilozima. Dopunu prijavi moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka. Za ocjenu ispunjavaju li podnositelji prijave uvjete naznačene u natječaju, mjerodavan je posljednji dan roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj (osim za prijam vježbenika, obzirom da kandidati ne smiju imati 12 ili više mjeseci radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, stoga taj uvjet ispunjava podnositelj prijave koji potrebno radno iskustvo nije imao barem prvog dana roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj za prijam u službu vježbenika). Prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu izabrani kandidat pozvat će se da u primjerenom roku dostavi uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv njega ne vodi kazneni postupak i uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se prima te dostavi na uvid izvornike dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čije su preslike priložene uz prijavu na javni natječaj. Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatrat će se odustankom od prijma u službu. Troškove izdavanja uvjerenja o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Grad (osim u slučaju odustanka kandidata od prijma u službu). Nakon izbora kandidata, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu, provjerit će po službenoj dužnosti postoji li zapreka za prijam u službu zbog pravomoćne osuđivanosti izabranog kandidata za kazneno djelo iz članka 15. ZSN-a te zapreke iz članka 16. ZSNa. Uredna prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njena prijava neće biti razmatrana, te će joj o tome biti dostavljena pisana obavijest. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti. Osoba koja je podnijela nepotpunu prijavu, neće biti pozvana na dopunu prijave. Za kandidate prijavljene na javni natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će provedena prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Prijave se mogu neposredno predati i u pisarnicu Grada Umaga – Umago, Trg slobode 7 (prizemlje). Pravila provjere znanja i sposobnosti Po dolasku na provjeru znanja, od kandidata će biti zatraženo predočenje odgovarajuće identifikacijske isprave radi utvrđivanja identiteta. Po utvrđivanju identiteta i svojstva kandidata, kandidatima će biti podijeljena pitanja. Za svaki dio provjere znanja kandidatima se dodjeljuju bodovi od 1 do 10. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% bodova na pisanom testiranju. Smatra se da je kandidat zadovoljio ako je na intervjuu ostvario najmanje 5 bodova. Ukoliko pojedini kandidat prekrši naprijed navedena pravila bit će udaljen s provjere znanja, a njegov rezultat Povjerenstvo neće priznati niti ocjenjivati. Requisiti richiesti: - laurea magistrale, laurea a ciclo unico o diploma specialistico di secondo livello in giurisprudenza; - almeno quattro anni di esperienza lavorativa in mansioni corrispondenti; - superamento dell’esame di Stato di II livello. Per tutti i suddetti posti di lavoro costituisce requisito specifico per l’assunzione in servizio il possesso delle competenze informatiche. I candidati devono altresì soddisfare i criteri generali per l'assunzione in servizio previsti dall'art. 12 della LIPT (maggiore età, cittadinanza croata e idoneità sanitaria per svolgere le mansioni del posto di lavoro per il quale il candidato viene assunto). La documentazione redatta in lingua straniera deve essere prodotta in traduzione giurata. Ai fini del presente Bando, per esperienza lavorativa in mansioni appropriate si intende l’esperienza maturata nell’ambito di attività lavorative — ivi comprese quelle svolte presso enti amministrativi delle unità di autogoverno locale o territoriale /regionale/, servizio pubblico, servizio statale, presso datori di lavoro privati, nell’ambito dell’esercizio autonomo di attività professionali conformemente a disposizioni normative speciali, ovvero presso organizzazioni internazionali – purché riferite a mansioni coerenti con il livello di istruzione richiesto e con il profilo professionale oggetto della selezione, ai sensi dell’articolo 13 della LIPT. Possono presentare candidatura anche i candidati che non abbiano ancora superato l’esame di Stato del livello prescritto, a condizione che lo sostengano con esito positivo entro un anno dalla data di inizio del servizio, come previsto dalla decisione relativa all’assegnazione del posto, e subordinatamente al superamento del periodo di prova. I candidati che si avvalgono del diritto di precedenza sono tenuti a indicarlo presentando l'apposita documentazione probatoria e altri documenti previsti dalla rispettiva legge specifica, con diritto di precedenza rispetto agli altri candidati a parità di condizioni. I candidati che si avvalgono del diritto di precedenza di assunzione in ottemperanza all'art. 101 della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patria e sui membri delle rispettive famiglie (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 e 156/23), all’art. 47 della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patria (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 84/21 e 13/26), all'art. 48f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 e 98/19), all'art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e assunzione in servizio delle persone con disabilità (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 e 32/20) e all’art. 22 della Legge costituzionale sui diritti delle minoranze nazionali (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 155/02, 47/10, 80/10 e 93/11) sono tenuti a specificare tale diritto nella domanda di assunzione, con diritto di precedenza rispetto agli altri candidati che concorrono alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che desiderano fare appello al diritto di precedenza previsto dalla legge specifica devono presentare la copia fotostatica del documento comprovante le modalità di cessazione del precedente rapporto di lavoro (es.: cessazione dovuta non per colpa del dipendente o tramite risoluzione consensuale) nei casi in cui la prelazione dipenda dal tipo di cessazione del precedente rapporto di lavoro. Oltre alla documentazione prevista dal presente Bando, i candidati che fanno appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione in osservanza all'art. 101 della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patria e sui membri delle rispettive famiglie, altresì all’art. 47 della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patria sono tenuti a corredare la domanda di assunzione con la documentazione probatoria disciplinata dal Ministero dei difensori croati e indicata sul sito all'indirizzo: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf ovvero https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Oltre alla documentazione probatoria attestante il possesso dei requisiti richiesti, i candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi dell'articolo 48f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra devono allegare l’apposito provvedimento o certificato comprovante il riconoscimento della condizione a cui fa appello. Oltre alla documentazione prevista dal presente Bando, i candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione in osservanza all'art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e assunzione in servizio delle persone con disabilità sono tenuti a corredare la domanda di assunzione con la documentazione probatoria atta a comprovare la condizione di persona diversamente abile. I candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione contemplato dall'art. 22 della Legge costituzionale sui diritti delle minoranze nazionali non sono tenuti a comprovare la propria appartenenza alla minoranza nazionale. Alla domanda di partecipazione al concorso devono essere allegati:
  • curriculum vitae,
  • copia fotostatica del documento attestante il possesso della cittadinanza croata o altro documento analogo (carta d’identità, passaporto, certificato di cittadinanza o libretto militare);
  • copia fotostatica del diploma attestante il possesso del titolo di studio richiesto, a seconda del criterio relativo alla qualifica professionale del posto di lavoro per il quale viene presentata la domanda, (i candidati che hanno compiuto gli studi all’estero devono presentare il certificato di equipollenza nella Repubblica di Croazia);
  • documento ottenuto per via telematica attestante i dati registrati nella matricola dell’Istituto croato di assicurazione pensionistica (qualora il candidato presenti la domanda di assunzione in formato digitale attraverso il sito dell’Istituto croato di assicurazione pensionistica), ovvero certificato riportante i dati del registro tenuto presso l’Istituto croato di assicurazione pensionistica e ottenibile direttamente presso gli sportelli di quest’ultimo, ovvero presso i rispettivi servizi circondariali (non antecedente a 30 giorni dalla data di pubblicazione del Bando nella Gazzetta Ufficiale);
  • copia fotostatica della documentazione comprovante l’esperienza lavorativa in mansioni corrispondenti per l'intero periodo indicato come requisito (provvedimento attestante l’assegnazione del posto di lavoro, contratto di lavoro o attestato rilasciato dal datore di lavoro riportante i seguenti dati: tipo di lavoro svolto dal candidato, profilo e livello del titolo di studio, periodo di servizio), per i posti di lavoro indicati ai numeri 1, 2 e 3;
  • Qualora nel documento in formato elettronico o nella conferma dei dati registrati nella banca dati dell’Istituto croato di assicurazione pensionistica (reale/necessaria qualifica professionale / tipo e livello di istruzione) risulti annotata l’anzianità di servizio, è necessario allegare la prova che la persona è priva di esperienza lavorativa oppure che possiede un’esperienza lavorativa inferiore a 12 mesi in mansioni corrispondenti al profilo professionale e alla qualifica richiesti; tale prova deve contenere i dati sulla tipologia delle mansioni svolte, sulla qualifica e sulla specializzazione con cui la persona ha lavorato, nonché sul periodo in cui le ha svolte (provvedimento, contratto di lavoro, attestazione del datore di lavoro o altro documento idoneo a comprovarlo), per il posto di lavoro indicato al n. 4;
  • copia fotostatica del certificato attestante il superamento del livello prescritto dell’esame di Stato (qualora in possesso);
  • copia fotostatica del certificato di abilitazione professionale del ministro delle finanze per lo svolgimento delle attività di revisione interna nel settore pubblico (per il posto di revisore interno);
  • documento comprovante l’abilità nell’utilizzo del computer (certificato probatorio comprovante l’abilità nell’utilizzo del computer valevole nelle nazioni dell’UE, certificato probatorio comprovante l’abilitazione di Operatore informatico in applicazioni operative, corrispettiva pagella di scuola media superiore, indicazione dei voti a livello universitario o specialistico (università o scuola superiore) comprovante il superamento dell’esame di informatica o rispettivo attestato (certificato) rilasciato da enti autorizzati e comprovante il superamento del corso di informatica il cui piano di studi comprende le basi di informatica e lo studio del sistema operativo Windows, nella fattispecie Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook (posta elettronica) e applicazioni Internet,
  • dichiarazione sostitutiva sottoscritta di proprio pugno attestante la non sussistenza degli impedimenti previsti dagli artt. 15 e 16 della LIPT (autenticazione notarile non necessaria).
I candidati che allegano documenti in cui i dati personali non combaciano con quelli riportati nella domanda sono tenuti a fornire anche la prova della loro modifica (certificato di matrimonio, certificato di nascita, ecc). Nella domanda di assunzione è necessario indicare le generalità del candidato (nome, cognome, residenza, n. telefono/cellulare, preferibile indirizzo di posta elettronica) e indicazione in merito al posto di lavoro per il quale concorre. La domanda di assunzione deve essere firmata di proprio pugno. I candidati che si candidano contemporaneamente per più posti di lavoro sono tenuti a presentare, per ciascuna posizione, una domanda separata con tutti gli allegati richiesti. Le domande di assunzione possono essere integrate entro la scadenza indicata nel Bando. Ai fini della valutazione del possesso dei requisiti previsti dal bando, farà fede la situazione in essere alla data di scadenza del termine per la presentazione delle domande (fatta eccezione per l'assunzione dei tirocinanti, considerato che i candidati non devono aver maturato 12 o più mesi di esperienza lavorativa nelle mansioni corrispondenti; tale requisito è pertanto soddisfatto dal candidato che non disponeva della necessaria esperienza lavorativa almeno al primo giorno del termine per la presentazione delle domande al concorso pubblico per l'assunzione in servizio di tirocinante). Prima dell’adozione del provvedimento di assunzione in servizio, il candidato selezionato sarà invitato a presentare, entro un termine congruo, il certificato rilasciato dal tribunale competente attestante l’assenza di procedimenti penali in corso a proprio carico; il certificato medico di idoneità allo svolgimento delle mansioni inerenti alla posizione per la quale è stata disposta l’ammissione; gli originali, ai fini della consultazione, dei documenti comprovanti il possesso dei requisiti previsti per la partecipazione al concorso pubblico, già allegati alla domanda. La mancata presentazione della documentazione sopra indicata sarà considerata quale rinuncia all’assunzione in servizio. Le spese relative al rilascio del certificato di idoneità medica saranno a carico della Città, salvo in caso di rinuncia all’ammissione da parte del candidato. Successivamente alla selezione e prima dell’emissione del provvedimento di assunzione in servizio, la Città provvederà d’ufficio alla verifica dell’eventuale sussistenza di cause ostative all’assunzione derivanti da condanne penali passate in giudicato ai sensi dell’articolo 15 della LIPT, nonché degli impedimenti previsti dall’articolo 16 della medesima legge. Saranno prese in considerazione esclusivamente le domande di assunzione corredate dei dati e degli allegati richiesti dal presente Bando, conformemente alle modalità e ai contenuti specificati. Le persone che non hanno presentato domanda nei termini o in forma regolare, ovvero che non soddisfano i requisiti formali previsti dal bando, non sono considerate candidate al concorso e la loro domanda non sarà esaminata; le stesse verranno informate per iscritto in merito. Avverso tale comunicazione non è ammesso alcun rimedio giuridico. I candidati che hanno presentato domanda incompleta non saranno invitati a integrarla. I candidati che risulteranno in possesso dei requisiti concorsuali saranno convocati a sostenere una prova scritta, seguita da un colloquio di lavoro. Se il candidato non si presenta alla verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità, si considera che abbia ritirato la domanda di partecipazione al concorso. Le domande di assunzione vanno inviate in busta chiusa alla Città di Umag – Umago, Commissione per l’attuazione del concorso, Piazza Libertà 7, 52470 Umago, entro il termine perentorio di 15 giorni a contare dalla data di pubblicazione del presente Bando nella Gazzetta Ufficiale. Le domande devono essere sigillate in busta chiusa recante la dicitura “BANDO PER ASSUNZIONE (specificare posto di lavoro) - NON APRIRE”. È possibile altresì presentare le domande di assunzione direttamente di persona all'Ufficio protocollo-archivio, all'indirizzo Piazza Libertà 7 (Umago). Il provvedimento di assunzione in servizio del candidato selezionato sarà pubblicato mediante avviso sul sito web ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago (www.umag.hr), entro e non oltre 60 giorni dalla data di scadenza per la presentazione delle domande di partecipazione al concorso pubblico. La pubblicazione si considera notificata decorsi otto giorni dalla data dell’avviso pubblico del suddetto provvedimento. La descrizione delle mansioni inerenti alla posizione lavorativa oggetto del Bando, le informazioni relative alla retribuzione mensile, le modalità di svolgimento della verifica preliminare delle competenze e delle capacità, le competenze richieste per il superamento della stessa, nonché le fonti giuridiche e altre fonti utili alla preparazione, sono disponibili sul sito ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, www.umag.hr (sezione “Offerte di lavoro”). La data e l'orario dell'esame verranno pubblicati all'albo pretorio della Città di Umag – Umago e sul sito ufficiale all’indirizzo www.umag.hr (sezione “Offerte di lavoro”), almeno cinque giorni prima della convocazione per la verifica. CLASSE: 112-01/26-02/04 IL SINDACO N. PROT.: 2163-9-03/02-26-1 f.to, Vili Bassanese Umago, 24 agosto 2026 L’ASSESSORA f.to, Barbara Krištofić Brenčić, dipl. oec. L’ASSESSORA f.to, Maja Galović, dipl. iur.
I. COMPITI E MANSIONI La descrizione dei lavori è riportata nel Regolamento sull'ordinamento interno dell'amministrazione cittadina (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, nn. 9/23, 13/23, 22/23, 5/24, 7/24, 11/24, 16/24, 17/24, 1/25, 7/25 e 7/26), sistematizzazione dei posti di lavoro, disponibile sul sito della Città di Umag – Umago www.umag.hr, link: https://umag.hr/informacije/sluzbene-novine-grada-umaga-umago-90 II. RETRIBUZIONE MENSILE Visto il Regolamento di lavoro (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 3/23, 9/23, 22/23, 20/24 e 14/25), vista la Delibera sui coefficienti per il computo degli stipendi per gli impiegati e il personale tecnico (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, nn. 2/25, 11/25 e 11/26), vista la Decisione sulla definizione della base lorda per il computo degli stipendi per gli impiegati e il personale tecnico dell’amministrazione civica della Città di Umag – Umago (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 13/25), lo stipendio base è pari al prodotto tra il coefficiente di complessità dei lavori e la base retributiva (800 euro lordi), con maggiorazione dello 0,5% per ogni anno di anzianità maturato. I coefficienti retributivi per i posti di lavoro di cui al presente Bando sono come segue: revisore interno (3,50); collaboratore professionale pagamenti – saldaconti (2,60); consulente superiore agli affari giuridico-patrimoniali (3,50); collaboratore professionale superiore agli affari giuridico-patrimoniali (2,70 - con la precisazione che, per la durata del tirocinio, il tirocinante ha diritto all'85% dello stipendio previsto per le mansioni del posto di lavoro per il quale si sta formando). III. VERIFICA DELLE CONOSCENZE E DELLE CAPACITÀ DEI CANDIDATI In conformità con l'articolo 22 della LIPT, i candidati che intendono partecipare al presente Bando e che soddisfano i requisiti formali stabiliti dallo stesso saranno sottoposti a una verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità dei candidati, la quale consisterà nella prova scritta e nel colloquio di lavoro. Il candidato che non si presenti alla verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità sarà considerato aver ritirato la domanda di partecipazione al concorso pubblico. Regole per lo svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità I candidati devono presentarsi alla verifica muniti di un documento di identità valido. Accertata la loro identità, si procederà alla distribuzione delle domande. Per ciascuna parte della verifica delle conoscenze ai candidati vengono assegnati da 1 a 10 punti. Il colloquio si svolge esclusivamente con i candidati che abbiano ottenuto almeno il 50% dei punti nella prova scritta. Si considera che il candidato abbia superato il colloquio qualora ottenga un punteggio minimo di 5 punti. Durante la verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità non è concesso: - consultare testi od annotazioni; - usare il telefono cellulare/smartphone o altri mezzi di telecomunicazione; - abbandonare il luogo d'esame; - comunicare con gli altri candidati o disturbarli in altro modo. I candidati che trasgrediscono a quanto stabilito saranno allontanati dalla verifica in corso; pertanto, la Commissione non procederà alla correzione ed alla valutazione delle rispettive prove scritte. Luogo e orario di svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità Il luogo e l’orario di svolgimento della verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità, nonché l’elenco dei candidati che soddisfano i requisiti formali del Bando, saranno pubblicati sul sito web della Città di Umag – Umago o all’indirizzo www.umag.hr (pagina “Offerte di lavoro”) ed affissi all'albo pretorio in Piazza Libertà 7, piano terra, almeno 5 giorni prima della data della verifica. Oltre al giorno e all'ora della prova, nella lista dei candidati saranno riportate rispettivamente le iniziali del candidato, l'anno di nascita e il luogo di residenza. Ulteriori estremi potranno essere inclusi qualora due o più candidati riportino dati identici. IV. jobs.title: KONOBAR M/Ž
jobs.description:
Café Allegri - ZADAR - Hey park

Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099/ 3224342 ili posao@celka.hr. Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik (m/ž) Što ćete raditi? - posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima - održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme - osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu - predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama Što nudimo? - stimulativne uvjete - rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki - dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu - izvrsne kolege i međuljudske odnose

jobs.title: KOMERCIJALIST / ADMINISTRATOR U MEĐUNARODNOM TRANSPORTU M/Ž
jobs.description:
Tražimo komercijalista za rad u prijevozničkoj tvrtki koja se bavi međunarodnim cestovnim prijevozom robe. Radno mjesto je u uredu i nije predviđena mogućnost rada od kuće / remote rada. Osoba na ovom radnom mjestu bit će uključena u svakodnevne komercijalne i administrativne poslove povezane s transportom, vozačima, vozilima, klijentima i poslovnom dokumentacijom. Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti
  • izdavanje i praćenje računa u programu Minimax
  • praćenje uplata i naplata potraživanja
  • priprema naloga za plaćanje i praćenje obveza prema dobavljačima
  • zaprimanje, kontrola i evidencija transportne dokumentacije
  • vođenje i praćenje dokumentacije vezane uz vozila i vozače – dozvole, potvrde, registracije i ostala potrebna dokumentacija
  • komunikacija s klijentima, dobavljačima i poslovnim partnerima telefonskim i elektroničkim putem
  • komunikacija i koordinacija s bankama, Poreznom upravom i drugim državnim institucijama
Uvjeti koje tražimo
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i snalaženje u poslovnim programima i digitalnim alatima
  • dobre organizacijske sposobnosti i pozornost na detalje
  • odgovornost, samostalnost i pouzdanost u radu
  • dobre komunikacijske vještine
  • spremnost na učenje i rad s različitim vrstama poslovne dokumentacije
Prethodno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima, posebno u transportu, logistici, administraciji, računovodstvu ili komercijali, predstavlja prednost. Što nudimo?
  • mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja
  • stjecanje praktičnog iskustva u poslovanju međunarodne prijevozničke tvrtke
  • upoznavanje s procesima vezanim uz transport, fakturiranje, naplatu, dokumentaciju vozila i vozača te komunikaciju s klijentima i institucijama
  • mogućnost stjecanja širokog praktičnog znanja iz različitih područja poslovanja
Tražimo osobu koja je organizirana, odgovorna i dobro se snalazi s dokumentacijom, ljudima i računalom te želi naučiti kako funkcionira svakodnevno poslovanje međunarodne prijevozničke tvrtke. Ako se prepoznajete u navedenom, veselimo se vašoj prijavi.

jobs.title: Kellner (m/w/d), Romantik Hotel Turm (Chef de rang)
jobs.description: Service mit Herz & Stil Du liebst es, Gastgeber:in aus Leidenschaft zu sein, arbeitest gerne selbstständig und schätzt ein stilvolles Ambiente? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! jobs.title: Assistant Store Manager Puerto Rico Premium Outlets
jobs.description:
Overview

As an Assistant Store Manager, you will support the Store Manager to build a team that delivers results through providing an amazing customer experience. You also share the responsibility to execute all store operations and maintain a visually appealing store. You create a positive environment that develops and engages your managers, associates, and customers every day. You love being part of a winning team and you bring your energy to work every day.

The Assistant Store Manager reports to the Store Manager.

Who You Are

  • Inspirational leader who guides their team and partners with the store manager to achieve great results.
  • Engaging personality who attracts great talent.
  • Demonstrates a competitive spirit and desire to win.
  • Team player with an entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Operates with a sense of urgency and effectively manage competing priorities.
  • Able to adapt to change and takes on more responsibilities.
  • Self-motivated; seeks personal growth and development.

Responsibilities

As the Assistant Store Manager you will:

  • Partner with the Store Manager to create action plans to achieve results and grow the business.
  • Understand and demonstrate product knowledge, selling and operational skills to maximize sales.
  • Engage with customers to build relationships and brand loyalty by using company tools.
  • Partner with the Store Manager to develop team members who are committed to creating a great experience for our customers.
  • Oversee assigned division of responsibility and be accountable for results.
  • Support the Store Manager to ensure store standards for merchandising and operations are met consistently.
  • Learn about all aspects of the business and share ideas to drive the business.
  • Remain composed in the face of challenges and unforeseen circumstances.
  • Perform POS transactions on designated shifts and execute management functions in the absence of Store Manager.
  • Model our values of respect, integrity, teamwork, compassion, accountability, and inclusivity.

Qualifications

You will also have:

  • 2+ years as a Co/Assistant Manager in similar volume, apparel business (preferred).

  • Flexible availability to meet the needs of the business (including evenings and weekends).

Other Requirements

  • Bend, lift, open and move product and fixtures up to 50 lbs., as needed.

The Company is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to enable qualified employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs as required by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

jobs.description:

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

Replit is experiencing extraordinary growth across our customer base and seeking a Mid-Market Account Manager with strong communication skills to drive retention, expansion, and customer success. Candidates with Sales or Account Management experience in SaaS, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.

 

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for customer success and AI. You'll leverage your skills to help customers maximize value from Replit's platform while driving sustainable revenue growth.

 

In this role you will:

 - Execute renewal processes with a focus on expansion and long-term partnership development

 - Serve as the primary relationship owner for your assigned customer portfolio, ensuring high satisfaction and retention

 - Champion customer success by helping businesses realize the transformative potential of AI-powered software creation

 - Lead onboarding programs that accelerate customer time-to-value and platform adoption

 - Guide customers through Replit's rapidly evolving feature set, including Agent 3's autonomous capabilities, Plan Mode, and automation tools

 - Maintain accurate customer health scores and renewal forecasting data in Replit's CRM (Hubspot)

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing training, support, and strategic guidance

 

Required skills and experience:

 - 3-5+ years in a quota-carrying Sales or Account Management role managing a mid-market book in SaaS or developer tools

 - Proven ability to expand product usage while growing your book of business and triaging renewal risk

 - Track record of consistently hitting renewal and expansion targets across a multi-account portfolio

 - Experience blending product-led signals (usage/adoption data) with direct selling

 - Comfort owning a number: forecasting accurately, managing pipeline across dozens of accounts, and closing deals ranging from quick renewals to larger negotiated expansions

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to sell technical value to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and customer success tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies to diverse customer segments

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to uncovering expansion opportunities

 - Passion for AI/automation and staying current with industry trends

 - Comfort with data analysis, especially product usage data, to identify growth signals and prioritize outreach

 

Nice to have:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience with rapid prototyping, product development workflows, or business process automation

 - Background in customer success at companies serving technical or semi-technical user bases

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

 

Tools + Tech Stack for this role:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - Customer success and analytics platforms

 - ZoomInfo

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex

 - Various customer communication and project management tools

 

This role may not be a fit if:

 - You're not passionate about helping customers succeed and driving long-term relationships

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle or have little interest in learning about technical workflows

 - You're not excited about AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate

 - You don't enjoy being in client-facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to customers

 - You prefer transactional interactions over building deep, strategic relationship

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: GTM Compensation Lead, Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As our GTM Compensation Lead on Commercial Operations, you’ll own commissions strategy, design, and execution for GTM. This is an opportunity to evolve how GTM Comp supports a growing GTM org through Notion’s AI-era selling motion and Enterprise growth. You’ll set the incentive systems that shape how our sellers focus, partner, and grow with customers. On a typical week, you’ll work with senior GTM leaders — including the Head of Sales and geo leaders — to translate business priorities into clear, accurate, scalable comp programs.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, map the current GTM Comp operating model and publish a roadmap for evolving the function as GTM grows.

 - Introduce AI quick wins that improve the quality of work: triage inbound questions, help reps estimate payouts, flag discrepancies across systems, and automate reminders tied to the comp calendar.

 - Build a planning-cycle framework that makes design inputs, trade-offs, decision rights, and timelines clear across GTM, Finance, and Commercial Operations.

 - Provide board-level updates, including clear reporting on plan health, payout accuracy, systems quality, and key design decisions.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated judgment balancing Finance discipline with GTM effectiveness — you can protect accuracy and controls while designing plans that support the selling motion.

 - Strong financial modeling and data fluency, with the ability to translate complex plan mechanics into clear analysis, recommendations, and executive-ready narratives.

 - Experience leading transformative operational projects from design through rollout, especially where cross-functional alignment and change management matter.

 - Track record of building and maintaining sustainable quarterly operating cadences, including clear calendars, communications frameworks, and repeatable review moments. Ideally you have managed this process at a public company.

 - AI-fluent operating style: you use AI to improve decision quality, automate manual checks, identify data discrepancies, and build tools or workflows that make teams more self-serve.

 - Familiarity with Everstage a plus!

Through clear expectations and thoughtful coaching, you'll help team members unlock their potential and foster a culture of excellence in customer interactions. Your leadership will both ensure exceptional customer support and drive the company's long-term growth.

jobs.title: Vinduespudser søges
jobs.description:
Bliv vinduespudser hos os – og få et job, der faktisk er fedt at møde op til

Er du træt af kedelige jobs, hvor dagene bare flyder sammen?
Vil du hellere have frihed, ansvar, god løn og et team, du faktisk gider hænge ud med?

Så læs lige videre…..

 

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en del af vores team som vinduespudser, hvor du:

  • Arbejder ude hver dag (ingen kontorstol her:) ❌

  • Får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og kunder

  • Kører rundt i din egen firmabil med topmoderne udstyr

  • Leverer kvalitet og god service – og kan se resultatet med det samme

 

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi søger to typer:

Erfaren vinduespudser

  • Du har min. 3 års erfaring

  • Du ved, hvad du laver – og går op i kvalitet

  • Du vil være en del af et stærkt team og bidrage med din erfaring

Ny i faget (vi lærer dig op)

  • Du har den rette energi og vil lære

  • Vi giver dig en grundig oplæring + bred erfaring

  • Du bliver en del af et team, der faktisk gider hjælpe dig

 

Hvem er du som person?

  • Du er mødestabil og tager ansvar

  • Du har god energi og en positiv attitude

  • Du bidrager til en fed stemning og stærkt fællesskab

  • Du vil ikke bare have et job – du vil være en del af noget

 

Derfor er det her ikke bare et job

Hos os handler det ikke kun om arbejde – det handler om kulturen:

  • Et ungt team med plads til humor og god stemning

  • Sociale aktiviteter, som du selv kan være med til at planlægge

  • Ordnede forhold og respekt for hinanden

  • Et sted hvor man både kan arbejde seriøst – og have det sjovt imens

 

 Hvad får du?

  • Din egen firmabil + det nyeste udstyr på markedet

  • Mulighed for at tjene ekstra:

  • Bonus for at skaffe nye kunder

  • Ekstra indtjening hvis du vil arbejde mere

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Ferie og fridage fra day one

  • Et job hvor du kan udvikle dig og få ansvar

 

Kort sagt:

Hvis du vil have et job med:

  • Frihed

  • God løn

  • Et stærkt fællesskab

  • Og en hverdag du faktisk glæder dig til

…så er det her dit næste job!

 

Klar på at blive en del af holdet?

Send en ansøgning + CV til os i vores link. 

Du skal kunne læse og forstå Dansk eller Engelsk.

Vi ansætter løbende  –  så vent ikke for længe:)

jobs.title: Construction Estimator
jobs.description:
Estimator

We are seeking a detail-orientated and analytical Estimator with a passion for construction to join our team.

Overview


Working alongside the Senior Estimator, the ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing detailed and accurate cost estimates for a wide variety of commercial construction projects.
Candidates must have a building background with extensive knowledge of all aspects of refurbishment and commercial construction across numerous sectors.

This role requires a strong understanding of cost control and the ability to communicate effectively with various stakeholders. The Estimator will work closely with project managers, engineers and other sub-contractors, and play a crucial role in ensuring our bids are technically accurate, timely and competitive.

Min 3 years experience in an estimating role. Full driving licence and the ability to travel when required is essential.

Duties

  • Prepare detailed cost estimates for projects, including materials, subcontractors, labour and pre - lims from tenders, drawings and client briefs.
  • Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications
  • Liaise with clients, suppliers, and internal design/production teams
  • Ensure our tenders are cost-effective and meet budget targets
  • Assess site constraints (levels, drainage, access, services, etc)
  • Conduct thorough analysis of project specifications and drawings to identify all necessary components for accurate estimation.
  • Conduct site surveys as required, to assess project conditions and support the tendering process.
  • Maintain up-to-date estimating tools, pricing databases and cost records to ensure accuracy and efficiency in future tenders.
  • Assist in the preparation of tender submissions and proposals as required.
  • Source, evaluate and manage quotations from suppliers and subcontractors to ensure competitiveness and compliance.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • 3 years+ proven experience in estimating
  • Strong understanding of cost estimating principles and practices.
  • Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in all estimates.
  • Proficient in using estimating software and tools, alongside advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, enabling clear interaction with team members and clients.
  • Estimating construction projects up to Â£5m in value.
  • HND or equivalent in a surveying or construction related discipline

The Garden Retail Shop Assistant is an integral part of the Garden Team, supporting the retail experience and development of Festina Lente’s tranquil gardens to their full potential in terms of the green areas being a resourceful support and medium for wellbeing and social inclusion. As a member of the Retail Shop Team these are the key duties and responsibilities:: Retail Shop Management To take responsibility for the opening and closing of the garden shop and ensuring the security of the premises and stock. To operate the till and to ensure that all payments are made in compliance with the company policy, To ensure that stock is maintained in line with procedure, including to carry-out regular stock checks and ensuring physical stock on hand agrees with the computer records, Ensure the cleanliness of the shop and centre follows company policy and maintain a cleaning schedule (hoovering, disinfecting, cleaning of coffee machine etc), Ensure perishable items are stored in line with HSE requirements. Ensuring that garden seating / tables are washed down each morning, are cleaned during the day as vacated by customers and arranged in a welcoming manner, Support in the induction and training of volunteers, Reporting discrepancies and problems to the Head of Horticulture & Garden Retail, To be vigilant regarding security and report any security-related incidents immediately to the Head of Horticulture & Garden Retail. Customer Experience To ensure that a high standard of service to customers is always delivered, including answering questions, giving advice and guidance on product selection where required, Stock Care and Marketing To ensure the appropriate care and maintenance of plants including watering and feeding, To receive, check, log and store the delivery of stock where required, To develop marketing ideas and promote relevant stock which could include live demonstrations and interactive displays to promote unique merchandise, Assisting in the ongoing promotion of all Garden Events To maintain a high standard of display in the Garden Shop & Centre, and to merchandise in making best use of the space available. Horticulture Programme & Event Management To support the Head of Horticulture & Garden Retail with organising events, including the profiling of seasonal goods/plants and creating seasonal display areas. Building and maintaining excellent working relationships with colleagues, student, services members, suppliers, and customers of Festina Lente Communication Communicating effectively with stakeholders (internally and externally), as well as visitors, volunteers and staff members across the business. Education and experience Proven experience in retail, preferably in a garden centre and nursery setting. Working knowledge of horticulture, plant care, and gardening practices.

jobs.title: Social Care Worker – Children Residential Services- Brookville, Doon, Co. Limerick
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Child and Family Agency has responsibility for the following range of services: • Child Protection and Welfare • Parenting, Family Support and Early Help Services • Alternative Care • Birth Information & Tracing and Adoption • Tusla Education Support Services (TESS) • Children’s Service Regulation • Counselling and Therapeutic Supports Further information is available on www.tusla.ie Purpose of role: The policy of Tusla Child and Family Agency is to enable children / young people to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. The Social Care Worker will provide care, protection, and support to vulnerable or dependent clients, individually or in groups, in conjunction with the wider multidisciplinary team and other relevant agencies. The primary aim is to provide intervention necessary to address the child / young person’s issues or the issues that are preventing them from living at home or in relative / foster care. S/he will ensure the welfare of those under his/her care and will act as an advocate as appropriate. Social Care Workers in a Residential setting work as part of a multidisciplinary team to provide care to service users. Children / young people may be referred to a residential setting for a number of reasons by the Social Work department e.g. family breakdown / separation, history of neglect, sexual / physical abuse, addiction or mental health issues. Residential care aims to provide a therapeutic care placement to service users who most often present with emotional or behavioural difficulties and cannot live with their own families. Applicants must by the closing date of application have the following: Be registered in the Social Care Worker Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained at CORU (or have entitlement to be registered and obtain registration prior to appointment). Proof of CORU application 5 will be required. AND • Maintain live annual registration on the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board at CORU. AND • Must have the requisite knowledge and ability (including a high standard of suitability and professional ability) for the proper discharge of the duties of the office. Main Duties and Responsibilities Working with Children • To participate in the development and implementation of Care and Placement Plans and to ensure appropriate recording of same • To promote the rights and responsibilities of each child/young person within the centre. • To promote physical, emotional, social and religious welfare of each young person in care. • To encourage attendance at school, training centres, medical and clinical appointments. • To be responsible for the organisation of personal documents, arrangements, information and finance on behalf of the young person. • To liaise with the parent, family, general services and other agencies on behalf of the young person.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Lastning og losning efter behov

Vi forventer, at du

  • Gerne har CE-kørekort

  • Har gyldigt EU-kvalifikationsbevis/chaufføruddannelsesbevis

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for bil og gods

Vi søger chauffører til både dag- og natkørsel.

Arbejdstiderne afhænger af den konkrete rute og aftales nærmere ved ansættelsen. Angiv gerne i din ansøgning, om du foretrækker dag-, nat- eller begge typer kørsel.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast arbejde og faste ruter

  • Ordentlige arbejdsforhold

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende vilkår

  • Moderne og velholdte lastbiler

  • En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje

  • Mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed i vækst

  • Mulighed for et langsigtet samarbejde for den rette chauffør

Skriv gerne tydeligt, om du søger dagkørsel eller natkørsel.

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt / efter aftale
Ansættelse: Fuldtid

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

jobs.title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

Chef wanted for stable company

Bollinis Restaurant ApS

Do you have a flair for good food, and do you thrive in a kitchen with lots of life? We are extremely busy at Bollinis and are therefore looking for a skilled full-time chef to strengthen our team.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Operating Partner & General Manager (Profit Sharing & Equity)
jobs.description:
Operating Partner & General Manager – RAY'S Chicken

We run RAY'S Chicken at Hejrevej in Nordvest, sharing a roof and a taproom with Gamma Brewing. We take a lot of pride in what we do: 24-hour buttermilk marinades, custom spice rubs, homemade sauces, and fried chicken that stands out in Copenhagen.

We are ready to build RAY'S into a multi-location brand. To do that, we need a partner on the ground to take over the daily operation of our flagship location, dial in our systems, and build the foundation for our next openings.

This role comes with base pay, direct profit sharing, and an equity track.

What the Job Looks Like

You will start on the floor. To run and expand this business, you need to understand every moving part firsthand.

  • Step 1: Learn the Shop You'll spend your first weeks working the line—prepping chicken, running the fryers, packing orders, handling Wolt and takeaway rushes, and talking to guests.

  • Step 2: Take Full Ownership of Hejrevej Once you know the rhythm of the place, you take the reins of day-to-day operations: scheduling the crew, ordering from suppliers, keeping food costs tight, staying on top of Fødevarestyrelsen hygiene standards, and making sure the food quality never slips.

  • Step 3: Build for Expansion You'll help turn our daily workflows into clear, repeatable routines so that training new staff is easy. When we are ready to open location number two, you will be deeply involved in site setup, hiring, and launch.

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need years of high-end restaurant experience. If you have run a busy kitchen or managed a bar, great. But if your background is in retail, small business, logistics, or running physical projects and you love fast-paced, hands-on work, we want to hear from you.

Here is what actually matters to us:

  • High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs fixing. If a station is dirty, an order is delayed, or inventory is running low, you jump in and solve it.

  • Comfortable on Your Feet:  You enjoy the energy of a packed Friday night shift and you lead your team by working alongside them.

  • Organized & Practical: You notice small details. You can build simple checklists, manage inventory without wasting stock, and keep a kitchen running cleanly under pressure.

  • Good with People: You stay calm and constructive when the ticket machine is going non-stop and the room is full. You treat your team with respect and set a solid pace.

  • Long-Term Mindset: You want to build something real and share in the financial upside through profit distribution and equity as the business grows.

The Deal

  • Compensation: Base salary after experience with a road map to profit sharing.

  • Equity Pathway: Clear, milestone-based equity vesting as you take full operational ownership and we expand.

  • Direct Access: You work directly alongside the founders. No bureaucracy, no corporate politics—good ideas get tested and put into action immediately.

  • Great Location: A vibrant base at Hejrevej 6B in Nordvest, working alongside the Gamma Brewing team.

How to Apply

Send us your CV along with a short email telling us:

  1. What you have built, managed, or fixed in previous jobs.

  2. Why running and scaling a food business at this stage makes sense for you.

  • Email: work@diamondslice.dk

  • Subject: Rays Partner

jobs.title: Commercial Building Estimator
jobs.description:
For more than 60 years, Complex Co. has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


As our commercial building pipeline continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Commercial Building Estimator to play a key role in shaping successful tenders, strengthening estimating capability, and supporting the continued expansion of our commercial building arm.


This role will be responsible for delivering accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for commercial building & construction projects, while also providing day-to-day technical advice and mentoring to the estimating team.


This is a hands-on, influential role for someone who brings strong technical estimating expertise, sound commercial judgement, and the confidence to lead pricing activity across commercial building and construction opportunities.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for commercial building and construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Estimators
  • Act as first point of escalation for estimating queries and technical issues
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers


About you

  • Minimum 8+ years' experience in commercial building and construction estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex commercial building tenders
  • Strong understanding of construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like the role for you please apply or reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au


We are also advertising this role on SEEK Commercial Building Estimator Job in Canberra ACT - SEEK SEEK - Australia's no. 1 jobs, employment, career and recruitment site

jobs.title: Wireperson
jobs.description:
Description Trant Te-Tech design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality.
We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton.

The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing.What Youll Be DoingTechnical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring
  • Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling.
  • Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels.
  • Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements.
Technical Support & Collaboration
  • Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings.
  • Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes.
  • Follow work instructions and build documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets.
  • Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency.
  • Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements.
SHE&Q and Compliance
  • Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing.
  • Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies.
  • Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation.
  • Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area.
  • Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times.
Key Interfaces:
Internal Interfaces
  • Workshop Supervisor.
  • Production Manager.
  • Test Engineer.
  • Design & Engineering Teams.
  • Automation Team.
  • Stores / Logistic.
  • Quality Team.
External Interfaces
  • Clients / Inspectors (as required)
  • Suppliers (limited)
Core Values

Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.

What Were Looking ForEssential
  • NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings.
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements.
  • Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies.
  • Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring.
  • Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs.
  • Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment.
  • Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role.
Desirable
  • 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification.
  • Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021.
  • Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems.
  • First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification.
  • Experience wiring MCCs and control panels.
  • Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation.
  • Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults.
  • Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds.
Why Join Trant ?At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day.

Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful.

Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential.

Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference.

Our company benefits package includes:
  • Competitive rates.
  • 28 days holiday (including bank holidays).
  • Options to buy additional holiday via salary sacrifice.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Employee assistance program.
  • Discretionary annual bonus.
Join us and be part of something bigger.

jobs.title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
jobs.description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

jobs.title: PRIPRAVNIK/PRIPRAVNICA KNJIGOVOĐA/KNJIGOVOTKINJA
jobs.description:
Brandom priča je započela prije 20 godina, početkom suradnje dvoje zaljubljenika u poreze, reviziju i knjigovodstvo Branke Topolovec i Domagoja Hladike. Konkretno i objektivno pružamo kompletnu uslugu s područja knjigovodstva, poreznog savjetovanja, obračuna plaća i revizije. Subjektivni pogled i iskustvo svakako donosi najvažniju stranu poslovanja, a to je briga o našim klijentima i individualan pristup svakom zadatku. Naši klijenti su uglavnom hrvatska društva sa stranim vlasništvom. Podrška koju pružamo odnosi se na cjelokupni proces – od osnivanja društva do usluga korištenja poslovne adrese i ureda. Zbog povećanja obujma poslova proširujemo odjel i tražimo dvije osobe koje će nam se pridružiti na radnom mjestu Pripravnik knjigovođa. Pogledajte uvjete natječaja i prijavite se! Veselimo se pojačanju u našem timu. Opis poslova:
  • administrativna i operativna podrška mentoru knjigovođi
  • obavljanje knjiženja ulaznih/izlaznih računa i bankovnih izvoda, usklađenja knjigovodstvene dokumentacije
  • arhiviranje dokumentacije, predaja mjesečnih, kvartalnih i godišnjih izvještaja financijskim institucijama
  • svi ostali knjigovodstveno - računovodstveni poslovi
Uvjeti:
  • stručna sprema - SSS
  • poznavanje rada u MS Office
  • pouzdanost, komunikativnost, odgovornost
  • organizacijske sposobnosti i siguran profesionalni pristup
Nudimo:
  • ugovor na neodređeno s probnim rokom od 6 mjeseci
  • profesionalna usavršavanja i razvoj individualnih kompetencija
  • stimulativna primanja.
Naši stručnjaci oslanjaju se na sveobuhvatno znanje i širinu iskustva dobivenu iz rada s različitim industrijama. Jasno možemo razaznati karakteristike različitih klijenata i tako objektivno pristupiti svakom od njih. Želite li da vaša karijera raste i razvija se uz podršku profesionalaca s dugogodišnjim iskustvom nemojte dvoumiti. Prijavite se!

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

Kako se prijaviti?

Ako prepoznaješ sebe u ovom opisu i želiš postati dio našeg tima, pošalji nam svoj životopis (CV) i kratko motivacijsko pismo na e-mail adresu: ldcagro1@gmail.com s naslovom "Prijava za posao: Sistem inženjer".

Grafik/grafička, Grafici a výtvarníci v multimédiích
jobs.description:
První kontakt e-mailem.

Pro naši centrálu v Brně-Králově Poli hledáme šikovného grafika nebo grafičku, který/á má cit pro vizuál, dobré nápady a hlavně je umí převést do reality.
Co ti můžeme nabídnout
o    zajímavou a různorodou práci s velkým prostorem pro vlastní nápady a seberealizaci
o    nástupní mzdu od 37 100 Kč, po zapracování zapojení do našeho systému bonusů a odměn - výsledné finanční ohodnocení tak můžeš ovlivnit svojí prací a výsledky
o    příjemné pracovní prostředí v Brně-Králově Poli v nové klimatizované budově
o    fajn kolegy a šéfa, se kterým se dá normálně domluvit
o    zázemí stabilní české společnosti s historií více než 20 let
o    MultiSport kartu, slevy na firemní produkty a servis telefonů, neomezený zaměstnanecký tarif s internetem zcela zdarma
o    pracovní dobu od pondělí do pátku od 8:00 do 16:45, případně dle dohody
o    dobrou kávu na pracovišti zdarma
o    možnost nástupu ihned nebo dle dohody
Co bude náplní tvojí práce
o    péče o jednotný vizuální styl naší firmy a jeho další rozvoj
o    tvorba reklamních bannerů, kampaní a další grafiky pro náš web a e-shop
o    návrhy grafiky pro prodejny, výlohy, vitríny, prodejní pulty, plakáty, billboardy i firemní auta
o    příprava grafických podkladů pro tisk a další výrobu
o    produktové focení telefonů, příslušenství a dalšího sortimentu pro náš e-shop
o    úprava a retuš produktových fotografií
o    pravidelná kontrola vizuální podoby našich brněnských prodejen a hledání možností, jak jejich vzhled dál zlepšovat
o    realizace polepů a reklamní grafiky přímo na prodejnách - od návrhu až po finální instalaci
o    spolupráce s kolegy napříč firmou při přípravě akcí, kampaní a dalších projektů
Co od tebe očekáváme
o    cit pro grafiku, detail a jednotný vizuální styl
o    dobré nápady a schopnost dotáhnout je od prvního návrhu až po výsledek
o    samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědnost za odvedenou práci
o    znalost CorelDRAW, Adobe Photoshop a Adobe Lightroom
o    schopnost nafotit produkty tak, aby na našem e-shopu vypadaly atraktivně
o    praktickou zručnost - samolepicí grafiku na výlohu zvládneš nejen navrhnout, ale také správně aplikovat
o    chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady a říct, když vidíš něco, co by šlo udělat lépe
o    spolehlivost a schopnost pracovat samostatně
o    řidičský průkaz skupiny B

Zaujali jsme tě?
Pošli nám svůj životopis s fotografií, krátký průvodní dopis, proč tě tahle práce zaujala, a hlavně několik ukázek své práce nebo odkaz na portfolio na email prace@mobilprovas.cz
Nemusíš nám posílat desítky projektů. Raději vyber pár věcí, na kterých je dobře vidět, co umíš a jakým způsobem přemýšlíš nad grafikou.
Pokud nás tvůj profil a práce zaujmou, ozveme se ti telefonicky a následně tě pozveme na osobní pohovor.

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
multisport karta, zaměstnanecké slevy, neomezený zaměstnanecký tarif s internetem ZDARMA
