jobs.title: Residential Valuer
jobs.description:
Introduction:

About The Company

Acumentis is Australia's only independent ASX-listed property valuation and advisory firm. With 350+ team members across 45 locations, we combine national scale with local support and a strong focus on service, inclusion and professional development.

Description:

About The Role

As a Residential Valuer, you will be a key member of our team, collaborating with fellow Valuers and Directors to achieve Acumentis' business objectives and regional goals. Your responsibilities will include:

  • High-Quality Valuations: Deliver valuations of the highest quality, adhering to client and company guidelines, and meeting required service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Market Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of sales trends and market conditions to inform valuation practices.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, contributing to business development initiatives.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Report regularly to the Regional Director and work closely to achieve targeted outcomes.


This position is also open to an Associate Director or Director role for the right candidate.

Skills and Experiences:

About You

Youâll be a great fit for us if:

  • You have a minimum 2 year's relevant experience in residential valuations
  • You possess tertiary qualifications in a relevant Property Degree
  • You have a Certified Practising Valuer (CPV) Qualification
  • You have strong working knowledge of the residential property market in Port Macquarie and surrounding areas.
  • You have a great ability to create and maintain working relationships with clients and colleagues


Weâll be a great fit for you if:

  • Youâd like an extra day of leave for your birthday, study or volunteer opportunities
  • Youâd like to take advantage of employee benefits such as bank partnerships, employee discounts and a full wellness calendar of activities - with new benefits added each month!
  • Youâre looking to join a business with a strong national presence, where relocation can be supported
  • Youâd like a position with a strong client base and steady stream of work
  • Youâd like to ensure your life/work balance through flexible work arrangements
  • Youâd like mentoring from industry leaders to guide your career, and create a guaranteed pathway for our twice-yearly promotion program


It is a condition of employment that staff are to obtain National Police Clearance (paid for by the business).

How To Apply

If working with Acumentis in this period of growth sounds like something you are looking for, please apply online via the link provided. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact the People Team (people@acumentis.com.au). We are unable to consider emailed applications.

Acumentis embraces and values the diversity of culture, working arrangements, sexual orientation and gender identity to ensure our workforce is representative of the community that we work within. We promote a workplace that actively seeks to include and welcome the unique contributions of all people. We embrace and celebrate the value of Indigenous people, their skills and their contribution to our organisation.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist - Island of Ireland (Restaurator/in im Steinmetz- und Steinbildhauerhandwerk/Master Professional für Restaurierung im Handwerk)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

This role requires residence in the Repub

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

WORKING HOURS: 40 HOURS PER WEEK

We are seeking a Building Maintenance Technician to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of building infrastructure and systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of facilities.

A high school diploma (or equivalent) and a valid trade license

jobs.title: Support Systems Lead (NYC)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Systems Lead at Replit, you'll build and own the systems that let support scale as fast as the product does. You'll own the tools our team works in every day, the technical setup behind self-service and AI-driven support, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it current as Replit ships.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You'll shape how our support systems adapt to new products, new surfaces, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and turning ad hoc fixes into infrastructure the whole team can rely on.

You'll combine hands-on technical depth with systems thinking to keep builders moving, whether they get unblocked through self-service, an AI agent, or a person. This is an individual contributor role to start, with room to grow and build out a team as support scales.



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Configure and maintain Zendesk and the surrounding support stack, from the day-to-day workflow and automation setup to business rules and permissions, keeping it able to flex and scale as needs change.

 - Build and maintain assignment logic, queues, tagging and taxonomy, and escalation paths, keeping them running cleanly as volume and workflows change.

 - Set up and maintain support tooling, workflows, and access across internal agents, outsourced vendors, and regions, keeping the systems working for each group as the stack changes.

 - Partner with Engineering on the technical requirements for self-service and in-product support surfaces, and build the entry points, help widgets, and routing behind them.

 - Spot the repetitive steps in agent and admin workflows before they become bottlenecks, and build the automations, bulk actions, and scripts, including in Replit, that take them out.

 - Take in tooling and systems requests from across support, run tool and vendor evaluations for the support stack, and lead a migration if we change platforms.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years in support operations, support systems, tooling, or a similar technical operations role.

 - Hands-on administration of a ticketing platform like Zendesk: building triggers and automations, macros, views, and SLAs, and managing routing, groups, and permissions.

 - Experience building and maintaining integrations across SaaS tools using APIs and webhooks.

 - Comfortable troubleshooting directly and working with engineers on more complex system needs.

 - Strong judgment about prioritization in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments.

 - Comfort taking on cross-functional problems, including ones that sit between support, tooling, and engineering



NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Scripting with Python or similar to build automations, bulk actions, and internal tooling.

 - Experience standing up self-service or in-product support surfaces.

 - Experience making systems work across both BPO and in-house teams.

 - Zendesk certification.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Kom og bliv en del af Danmarks førende krisecenter  Krisecenter Guldborgsund søger en erfaren socialrådgiver til en fast stilling
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer?

Kan du kombinere høj socialfaglighed med empati, struktur og handlekraft, og trives du i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Krisecenter Guldborgsund arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe sikkerhed, nye handlemuligheder og en vej videre for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer. Vi er et hus i rivende udvikling, og vi har høje ambitioner, både på vores beboeres og vores fagligheds vegne.

Hvem er vi?

Krisecenter Guldborgsund har 21 lejligheder med plads til voksne og op mod 30 medfølgende børn, og sommetider også familiens kæledyr.

Fælles for vores beboere er, at de har været udsat for vold i nære relationer og derfor har søgt ophold hos os.

Vi er et stort hus, hvor der sker meget i løbet af en dag. Det kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket, være fleksibel og samtidig holde fast i struktur, faglighed og dokumentation.

Hos os arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi tror på, at den bedste indsats skabes, når forskellige perspektiver bringes i spil.

Din rolle som rådgiver

Som rådgiver får du en central rolle i den enkelte borgers ophold og forløb på krisecenteret.

Arbejdet spænder fra den første visitation og vurdering af sikkerhedsbehov til samtaler, risikovurderinger, koordinering, myndighedssamarbejde og støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse efter volden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Åben rådgivning til borgere, som ikke er indskrevet på krisecenteret.

  • Visitationssamtaler og vurdering af indskrivningsgrundlag og sikkerhedsbehov.

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende opfølgning på risikovurderinger og relevante sikkerhedstiltag.

  • Ugentlige samtaler med de borgere, du er kontaktperson for.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning omkring blandt andet bolig, økonomi, sociale ydelser, bopæl og forældremyndighed.

  • Koordinering af borgernes sager på tværs af myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Handleplansmøder med borgere og betalingskommuner.

  • Udarbejdelse af opholdsplaner

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde omkring både voksne og medfølgende børn.

  • Journalføring, notatpligt og øvrig relevant socialfaglig dokumentation.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger først og fremmest en erfaren socialrådgiver, som hviler i sin faglighed og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver

  • Har minimum 5 års relevant erhvervserfaring.

  • Har solid socialfaglig erfaring og gerne erfaring med udsatte borgere, vold i nære relationer, myndighedsarbejde, familieområdet eller lignende.

  • Er stærk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Kan skabe en professionel og tillidsfuld relation til mennesker, der befinder sig i en krisesituation.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket, også når planerne pludselig ændrer sig.

  • Forstår betydningen af grundig og rettidig dokumentation.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser tværfagligt samarbejde som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

  • Har mod på at være en aktiv del af huset og beboernes hverdag , vi er et krisecenter, ikke kun en kontorarbejdsplads.

Vi lægger vægt på faglighed og erfaring, men også på hvem du er som menneske. Vi bruger mange timer sammen, og derfor betyder humor, engagement, fleksibilitet og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet også noget for os.

Team og organisering

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er kendetegnet ved et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team bestående af leder, faglig koordinator, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, psykoterapeut, psykolog, administrativ medarbejder, pedel og rengøringspersonale.

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af faggrupper og forventer, at alle bidrager til huset og den fælles opgave.

Arbejdstid

Rådgivernes arbejdstid er som udgangspunkt placeret i dagtimerne, typisk kl. 8.00-15.00 og enkelte dage kl. 8.00-16.00.

I denne stilling vil onsdag være den faste ugentlige lange arbejdsdag med arbejdstid frem til kl. 18.00.

Du bestemmer selv om du ønsker 30, 32 eller 37 timer ugentligt.

Derudover indgår rådgiverne i:

  • Weekendvagt hver 8. weekend, lørdag og søndag kl. 10.00-16.00.

  • Helligdagsvagter, typisk 1-2 vagter afhængigt af de pågældende helligdage.

Personalegruppen planlægger i høj grad selv fordelingen af sommerferie og helligdagsvagter. Det fungerer rigtig godt i praksis, og medarbejderne er gode til at koordinere indbyrdes og tage hensyn til både hinandens ønsker og krisecenterets behov for bemanding.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på en arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde har reel betydning for mennesker i en vanskelig livssituation.

  • Et stærkt og engageret tværfagligt miljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og plads til udvikling.

  • En hverdag med både selvstændighed, ansvar og mulighed for faglig sparring.

  • En organisation i udvikling, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed, samarbejde, humor og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Og ikke mindst: de bedste og sjoveste kollegaer – en god blanding af både mænd og kvinder.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er en fast stilling med ansættelse fra 1/11-2026

Ansøgning samt CV sendes til linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. septmber 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt: 24. septmeber 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Linda Møllgren
Leder, Krisecenter Guldborgsund
Telefon: 51 93 07 82 mellem kl. 11.00-14.00
Mail: linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Vi søger ikke bare en socialrådgiver, der kan løse en række opgaver. Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores hus, vores faglige udvikling og den forskel, vi hver eneste dag forsøger at skabe for mennesker udsat for vold i nære relationer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation is open for appointment from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter. The position is available for a period of 20 months and is based at Aalborg University’s campus in Aalborg.

You will be part of the research group Batteries, which is placed in the section for Mechatronic Systems. The position is closely connected to our activities within applied battery research, and your work will contribute to the development of new knowledge within this field.

Your work tasks
In this position you will conduct research within battery state estimation, with a particular focus on emerging sodium-ion battery technology. You will be involved in both independent and collaborative research activities in close interaction with colleagues in the group and external partners in Denmark and abroad.

You will work with the design and execution of research studies, the analysis and interpretation of data, and the dissemination of results in high-quality scientific outlets. Your daily work will typically involve a combination of independent research and collaboration in project teams, where you help develop concepts, methods and solutions that are relevant for the energy sector.

In particular, you will be involved in a research project related to development of a battery management system (BMS) tailored for sodium-ion batteries. The tasks include battery cell characterization and modelling based on laboratory tests, and development of algorithms for estimating the charge level, health, and power capability which includes robustness against different operation conditions. The position is a part of a research project and prototype battery modules will be produced by one of the partners. The tasks include testing of these prototype modules as well. Sodium-ion batteries is a relatively new technology, and they have their own electrochemical properties. One of the key questions of this research project is to obtain a better understanding of the difference between emerging sodium-ion batteries and traditional lithium-ion based batteries when it comes to the battery state estimation and management.

You will be expected to contribute to scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals and to present your work at conferences, workshops and meetings with partners. You will collaborate with researchers across the department and, where relevant, with industrial or public stakeholders. The position may include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of students at bachelor’s and master’s level, for example in the form of project supervision or involvement in courses related to your expertise. Depending on project needs, you may also take part in preparing applications for external research funding and in supporting the development of new research directions at the department.

Your competencies
You hold a PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Electrochemistry or a closely related field or can document equivalent scientific qualifications at PhD level. Your research profile is clearly connected to battery state estimation, and you can demonstrate experience with development of battery electric equivalent circuit models and algorithms for estimating the charge, health, and power based on direct methods (e.g. open circuit voltage), model-based methods (e.g. Kalman filtering), data driven methods (e.g. machine learning or neural networks), etc. The experience could come from lithium-ion, lithium-ion capacitor, sodium-ion, or other battery technologies.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
jobs.description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

jobs.title: Assistant, Tenure-Track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Software Engineering and Software Technology
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invite applications for one or more positions within software engineering and software technology. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the software engineering and software technology research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI for Software Engineering and Software Engineering for AI

  • Software Architecture and Design, including Architecting for AI Systems and AI-assisted Architecting

  • LLM-based, Agentic, and Multi-agent Software Systems

  • Human-AI collaboration in Software Development

  • Software Engineering for Physical AI and Embodied Systems

  • Self-Adaptive and Autonomous Software Systems

  • AI Orchestration and Infrastructure for AI Compute Offloading

  • Software Engineering for Embedded, Cyber-Physical and IoT-Edge-Cloud Systems

  • Governance, Compliance and Accountability of AI-Enabled Software

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Software Operation, Evolution, Maintenance, Recovery and Modernization

  • Software Reliability Engineering

  • Empirical Software Engineering

  • Requirements Engineering, Specification, and Modelling

 

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship. 

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as ICSE, FSE, ASE, ICSA, ECSA, MLSys, DATE, RE, SEAMS, ICSME, SANER, MODELS, ESEM, ICPE and CAiSE, EICS; and in journals such as TSE, TOSEM, EMSE, JSS, IST and IEEE Software.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam (Associate Professor): mtmo@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Co od Vás očekáváme?

English at Pembroke is taught by a large, dynamic team across Years 7 to 12, spanning both SACE and the International Baccalaureate. Our Middle School curriculum has been recently redesigned around conceptual threads and a portfolio-based approach to assessment that prioritises the process of learning, not just its products. Our teachers enjoy considerable freedom in text selection, within a framework of high academic expectations, and our faculty culture is one of collegiality, intellectual curiosity and serious engagement with pedagogy. Our staff contribute to curriculum design, and are supported to grow as practitioners at every career stage.


About the Role

Successful applicants will teach across the secondary years, with allocations shaped by experience and strengths. Depending on the appointment, this may include Middle School classes, senior SACE English subjects, or IB Diploma Language A courses.


Key Responsibilities include:

  • Delivering engaging, rigorous and innovative English lessons that foster a love of learning
  • Supporting students to develop strong literacy, analytical and communication skills
  • Providing purposeful assessment and feedback that supports every students' growth
  • Contributing to a positive and collaborative culture across the Middle and Senior Schools
  • Actively participating in the life of the School through co-curricular and pastoral care contributions.


About You

You are an effective teacher first and foremost, with demonstrated impact on student learning and a command of your subject that lets you teach with both rigour and imagination.


You will bring:

  • Strong subject knowledge and a love of literature and language that students can feel
  • Evidence-informed, responsive pedagogy and high expectations of every learner
  • Capacity or willingness to teach across SACE and IB pathways (IB experience is valued but not required; training and support are provided)
  • Strong communication with students, families and colleagues
  • A collaborative disposition and a genuine interest in contributing to faculty and school life


Applications at All Career Stages

We welcome applications from experienced practitioners and from graduate and early-career teachers alike. Early-career appointees are supported through structured mentoring and induction as part of a faculty that takes professional growth seriously.


Required for Employment (Prior to Commencement)

  • Current Working with Children Check (South Australia)
  • Current Plink RRHAN-EC training: Masterclass and Fundamentals, including Protective Practices
  • First Aid and CPR

Whether in the classroom, on the sporting field, or behind the scenes, every role contributes to shaping the rich and inclusive culture of the School. With opportunities for professional growth, a strong sense of belonging, and a genuine appreciation for staff, Pembroke is a place where your work is seen, valued, and celebrated.


Read more in The Heart of Pembroke - Celebrating our Staff.


Pembroke School is a co-educational, non-denominational, day and boarding School from Early Learning Centre to Year 12. Renowned for academic excellence and a broad, inclusive program, Pembroke offers the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) and is also an International Baccalaureate World School, offering the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Primary Years Programme (PYP).


Pembroke is a vibrant and exciting School catering for a diverse community of students. With over 1,700 students, the School offers a broad-ranging curriculum and an outstanding choice of co-curricular opportunities. The School employs over 300 permanent and fixed-term staff, plus more than 150 casual employees.

Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 2)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS strojarskog smjera

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 1 smjena - prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.335,14 € do 1.535,40 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • kontroliranje, popravljanje, ugradnja i održavanje strojarske opreme, uređaja i crpki u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda i crpnim stanicama,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme, remont opreme, servisi opreme,
  • zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zapornica i opreme koja se koristi u pročišćavanju otpadnih voda ,
  • održavanje strojarske opreme i crpki (kontrola nastanka korozije, zaštita adekvatnim premazima),
  • rukovanje i upravljanje strojo opremom, podmazivanje i kontrola nivoa ulja,
  • praćenje intervala za redovite servise opreme,
  • briga oko pravovremene nabavke rezervnih dijelova,
  • održavanje opreme u službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda (pranje, čišćenje),
  • rukovanje s opasnim kemikalijama,
  • nadopuna kemikalija u odgovarajuće spremnike prema radnim postupcima,,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti slijedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar (pisarnica) ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/ i Grada Zadra.

Rok za predaju prijava je 07.09.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično, bez navođenja razloga.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK / POMOĆNICA U NASTAVI
jobs.description:
Opis poslova: pomoć u komunikaciji, izvršavanju školskih zadataka, pomoć pri kretanju, obavljanju higijenskih potreba te ostalim zadacima za vrijeme školskih i izvannastavnih aktivnosti, suradnja s učiteljima, roditeljima i stručnim suradnicima.

U sklopu projekta „Uz pomoćnike u nastavi do inkluzivnog obrazovanja u Primorsko-goranskoj županiji“ koji se provodi u okviru instrumenta "Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama, faza VII." temeljem poziva Europskog socijalnog fonda u sklopu Operativnog programa "Učinkoviti ljudski potencijali" 2021. – 2027., Osnovna škola Jurja Klovića Tribalj koju zastupa ravnateljica Vilma Renate Car Katnić, prof. objavljuje

NATJEČAJ za prijavu kandidata za izvršavanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi

1. Pomoćnik u nastavi - dva izvršitelja/ice na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme od 27 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena

Na natječaj za radno mjesto mogu se ravnopravno prijaviti osobe oba spola, a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu korišteni su neutralno i odnose se i na muške i ženske kandidate.

Riječi i pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje korišteni u ovom natječaju odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod, bez obzira na to jesu li korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu.

U sklopu projekta „Uz pomoćnike u nastavi do inkluzivnog obrazovanja u Primorsko-goranskoj županiji“ raspisuje se natječaj za izbor pomoćnika u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama, a koji su temeljem rješenja o primjerenom programu školovanja integrirani u redovni sustav osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja.

Posao pomoćnika u nastavi obuhvaća pomoć u komunikaciji, izvršavanju školskih zadataka, pomoć pri kretanju, obavljanju higijenskih potreba te ostalim zadacima za vrijeme školskih i izvannastavnih aktivnosti.

Od pomoćnika se očekuje otvorenost i spremnost za suradnju s učiteljima, roditeljima i stručnim suradnicima.

Uvjeti:

  • završeno najmanje četverogodišnje srednjoškolsko obrazovanje
  • protiv osobe nije pokrenut kazneni postupak ili koja je pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnim i srednjim školama (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23) i članka 23. Zakona o asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23).
  • završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi ili edukacija za pomoćnika

Uz potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  1. životopis
  2. dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja ( preslika diplome ili potvrda o stečenoj stručnoj spremi),
  3. dokaz o državljanstvu,
  4. potvrda o završenom programu edukacije odraslih odnosno edukacije za pomoćnika u nastavi,
  5. uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  6. dokaz da kandidatu nije pravomoćno izrečena prekršajno pravna sankcija za nasilje u obitelji (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  7. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje.

Za vrijeme trajanja projekta s odabranim pomoćnicima sklopit će se ugovor o radu na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme kojim će se definirati međusobna prava i obaveze.

Odabrani pomoćnici obvezni su proći 20-satnu edukaciju za osposobljavanje za rad s učenicima s teškoćama, ukoliko kandidat nema završen program edukacije za poslove pomoćnika u nastavi u minimalnom trajanju od 20 sati

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo na prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužni su se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo i priložiti dokument o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je navedeno pravo vidljivo te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostv arivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-

%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostv arivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-

%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se na adresu Osnovna škola Jurja Klovića Tribalj, Tribalj 21, 51243 Tribalj s naznakom: „NATJEČAJ ZA POMOĆNIKA U NASTAVI“

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Prije donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata, kandidati prijavljeni na natječaj čije su prijave pravodobne, potpune i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja bit će pozvani na razgovor (intervju) radi utvrđivanja njihovog znanja, radnih sposobnosti, interesa i motivacije temeljem kojih se može očekivati da će s uspjehom obavljati poslove pomoćnika u nastavi. O datumu, vremenu i mjestu održavanja razgovora (intervjua) s kandidatima isti će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice Škole. Ako kandidat ne pristupi razgovoru (intervjuu), smatra se da je povukao prijavu za natječaj. Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Osnovnoj školi Jurja Klovića Tribalj za prikupljanje, korištenje i obradu svih dostavljenih podataka u svrhu provedbe natječaja sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka i objavom osobnih podataka (ime, prezime, titula) na mrežnoj stranici škole, u svrhu obavještavanja o rezultatima natječaja.

jobs.title: STROJAR/KA PROJEKTANT/ICA MEHANIČKIH SKLOPOVA
jobs.description:
Tražimo iskusnog/u strojara/ku projektanta/icu za rad na razvoju i projektiranju složenih mehaničkih sklopova.
Opis posla:
Projektiranje mehaničkih sklopova, robota, proizvodnih linija i gusjeničara različitih veličina
Izrada 3D modela i tehničkih nacrta u SolidWorks-u
Izrada kompletne projektne dokumentacije (nacrti, specifikacije, BOM-ovi)
Sudjelovanje u razvoju novih proizvoda od idejnog rješenja do finalne dokumentacije
Suradnja s ostalim članovima tima (konstrukcija, proizvodnja, nabava)
Optimizacija postojećih konstrukcija s ciljem poboljšanja funkcionalnosti, pouzdanosti i troškova

Uvjeti:
Visoka stručna sprema (strojarstvo ili srodno)
Minimalno 5 godina relevantnog iskustva u projektiranju mehaničkih sklopova
Odlično poznavanje SolidWorks-a (3D modeliranje, sklopovi, izrada nacrta)
Iskustvo u izradi kompletne projektne dokumentacije
Poznavanje principa projektiranja pokretnih mehanizama, pogona i konstrukcija
Samostalnost, preciznost i orijentiranost na detalje
Poznavanje engleskog jezika je prednost

Prednosti:
Iskustvo rada s 3D printerima (prototipiranje i aditivna proizvodnja)
Poznavanje CNC strojne obrade i projektiranje dijelova prilagođenih CNC tehnologiji
Iskustvo u projektiranju robota, automatizacije ili mobilnih platformi
Poznavanje FEM analiza
Iskustvo rada s ERP/PDM sustavima
Nudimo zanimljive i izazovne projekte, mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja te rad u dinamičnom okruženju.
Neto plaća između 1800 i 2300 ovisno o iskustvu i sposobnostima

jobs.title: Elternzeitvertretung/barselsvikar für/til Kulturvereinbarung/Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig (Kulturmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Elternzeitvertretung für die Kulturvereinbarung Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Möchten Sie Kulturaktivitäten mit entwickeln und umsetzen, die Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene über die deutsch-dänische Grenze hinweg zusammenbringen?

Ein vielseitiger deutsch-dänischer Arbeitsplatz sucht eine engagierte Projektmitarbeiterin bzw. einen engagierten Projektmitarbeiter für eine Elternzeitvertretung ab dem 1. November 2026. Ihre Aufgaben liegen überwiegend im Bereich der Aktivitäten der Kulturvereinbarung Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Die Kulturvereinbarung wurde zwischen dem Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, dem Kreis Nordfriesland, der Stadt Flensburg, der Haderslev Kommune, der Aabenraa Kommune, der Tønder Kommune, der Sønderborg Kommune, der Region Syddanmark und dem Land Schleswig-Holstein geschlossen.

Die Umsetzung der Kulturvereinbarung wird durch eine Förderung des dänischen Kulturministeriums unterstützt. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Stärkung kultureller Gemeinschaften und des Wohlbefindens, die Förderung von Demokratie und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe in der Grenzregion sowie die Unterstützung von Begegnungen und Kooperationen über die Grenze hinweg.

Sie werden beim Regionskontor & Infocenter angestellt und Teil des Teams für Kultur, Sprache und bürgernahe Aktivitäten. Durch Ihre unterschiedlichen Aufgaben arbeiten Sie eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen auf beiden Seiten der Grenze, Kulturschaffenden, Schulen, Kindergärten und weiteren Kooperationspartnern zusammen.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

•  Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines deutsch-dänischen Kindertheaterstücks

•  Planung und Durchführung eines Projekts für Schülerinnen und Schüler zu den Herausforderungen des Klimawandels und Möglichkeiten des Klimaschutzes aus der Perspektive von Kindern

•  Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung deutsch-dänischer Demokratiecamps und Demokratiesalons

•  Planung und Koordination deutsch-dänischer Begegnungen und Erfahrungsaustausche

•  Kommunikation und Vermittlung der Aktivitäten der Kulturvereinbarung

•  Unterstützung bei den weiteren Aufgaben des Teams im abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag.

Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Sie:

•  über eine relevante Ausbildung bzw. einen relevanten Studienabschluss verfügen

•  sowohl Dänisch als auch Deutsch so gut beherrschen, dass Sie sich mündlich und schriftlich sicher und problemlos in beiden Sprachen verständigen können

•  Erfahrung mit der grenzüberschreitenden Zusammenarbeit haben oder sich dafür interessieren

•  auf Netzwerke im Kultur- und Freizeitbereich in Dänemark und Deutschland zurückgreifen

können

•  Erfahrung in der Projektarbeit haben und effizient und strukturiert arbeiten

•  gerne in interdisziplinären Teams arbeiten und aktiv dazu beitragen, Lösungen zu finden, wenn Plan A nicht funktioniert.

Es wird erwartet, dass Sie Ihre Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten können, da auch Abend- und Wochenendtermine stattfinden. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir bieten:

•  eine spannende und eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit mit konkreten Projektaktivitäten

•  die Möglichkeit, sich mit Themen wie Lebensqualität, Gemeinschaft, Demokratie und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe in einem deutsch-dänischen Kontext zu beschäftigen

•  eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kulturverwaltungen und Kulturschaffenden auf beiden Seiten der Grenze

•  flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Montag und Dienstag sind feste Präsenztage.

Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich am Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, 6330 Padborg, etwa 10 km von der Grenze entfernt. Sie sollten jedoch damit rechnen, an Sitzungen und Aktivitäten in der gesamten Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig teilzunehmen.

Vergütung und Beschäftigungsbedingungen

Es handelt sich um eine Elternzeitvertretung vom 1. November 2026 bis voraussichtlich zum 31.Oktober 2027 mit einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 26 Stunden. Die Beschäftigung steht unterdem Vorbehalt möglicher Änderungen des Budgets.

Die Vergütung und Beschäftigungsbedingungen richten sich nach dem geltenden Tarifvertrag.

Bewerbungsgespräche

Bewerbungsfrist: 17. September 2026

Bewerbungsgespräche: 23. September 2026

Arbeitsbeginn: 1. November 2026

Weitere Fragen

Wenn Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie sich gerne an uns wenden:

Barselsvikar til Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Vil du være med til at udvikle og gennemføre kulturaktiviteter, der bringer børn, unge og voksne sammen på tværs af den dansk-tyske grænse?En alsidig dansk-tysk arbejdsplads søger en engageret projektmedarbejder til et barselsvikariat fra den 1. november 2026. Dine opgaver vil fortrinsvis være aktiviteter under Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Kulturaftalen er indgået mellem Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, Kreis Nordfriesland, Stadt Flensburg, Haderslev Kommune, Aabenraa Kommune, Tønder Kommune, Sønderborg Kommune, Region Syddanmark og delstaten Schleswig-Holstein. Kulturaftalen gennemføres med et tilskud fra det danske kulturministerium. Fokus er på at styrke kulturelle fællesskaber og trivsel, fremme demokrati og medborgerskab i grænselandet samt understøtte møder og samarbejder på tværs af grænsen.

Du bliver ansat på Regionskontor & Infocenter og bliver en del af teamet for kultur, sprog og borgernære aktiviteter. Gennem de forskellige opgaver kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med kollegaer fra begge sider af grænsen, kulturaktører, skoler, børnehaver og andre samarbejdspartnere.

Jobbet vil bl.a. omfatte:

•  At være med til at udvikle og gennemføre en dansk-tysk børneteaterforestilling

•  At stå for et projekt for elever om klimaudfordringer og klimahandling i børnehøjde

•  At være med til at gennemføre dansk-tyske demokraticamps og demokratisaloner

•  At planlægge og koordinere dansk-tyske møder og erfaringsudveksling

•  At formidle kulturaftalens aktiviteter

•  At bidrage til teamets øvrige opgaver og være en hjælpende hånd for kollegaerne i en travl hverdag.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

•  har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund

•  behersker både dansk og tysk så godt, at du mundtligt og skriftligt ubesværet kan kommunikere på begge sprog

•  har erfaring med eller interesse for det grænseoverskridende samarbejde

•  kan trække på netværk inden for kultur- og fritidsområdet i både Danmark og Tyskland

•  har erfaring med projektarbejde og arbejder effektivt og struktureret

•  trives i tværfaglige teams og bidrager aktivt til at finde løsninger, når plan A ikke lykkes.

Det forventes, at du kan tilrettelægge din arbejdstid fleksibelt, da der både vil være aften- og weekendmøder. Det forudsættes, at du har kørekort til personbil.

Vi tilbyder:

•  et spændende og selvstændigt job med konkrete projektaktiviteter

•  mulighed for at arbejde med emner som livskvalitet, fællesskaber, demokrati og medborgerskab i en dansk-tysk kontekst

•  tæt samarbejde med kulturforvaltninger og -aktører på begge sider af grænsen

•  fleksibel arbejdstid og muligheder for hjemmearbejde. Mandag og tirsdag er faste fremmødedage.

Du får arbejdsplads på Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, 6330 Padborg ca. 10 km. fra grænsen, men du kan forvente at skulle til møder og aktiviteter i hele Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Der er tale om et barselsvikariat fra den 1. november 2026 til forventeligt den 31. oktober 2027 på 26 timer ugentligt. Ansættelsen er med forbehold for eventuelle budgetændringer. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

The Sourcer executes all strategic sourcing activities in partnership with the Private Destinations talent acquisition initiatives across entry levels and functions.

The goal is to ensure that the organization can consistently proactively deploy the right people, in the right place, at the right time, at the most efficient cost, and for them to be fully engaged.

  • Assists with recruitment marketing and events initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelorâs degree in human resource management, business administration, or related field from an accredited college or university or the international equivalent required.
  • Minimum two (2) yearsâ experience in working for a global/international or reputable local organization in the same capacity.
  • Working knowledge of computers, internet access, and the ability to navigate within an automated HRIS system as well as variety software packages such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; familiar with social media and relevant company/brand efforts.
  • Good working knowledge in recruitment strategies and talent pool management
  • Knowledge of accepted human resources practices and the laws governing employment and fair treatment of employees globally.
  • Must be tactful, resolute, and committed to providing excellent customer service.
  • Must have a flexible approach to change, is able to work effectively in a variety of situations, seeks improvements and looks to the future.

We know there's a lot to consider. As you go through the application process, our recruiters will be glad to provide guidance, and more relevant details to answer any additional questions. Thank you again for your interest in Royal Caribbean Group. We'll hope to see you onboard soon!

jobs.title: Sagsbehandlende ergoterapeut eller fysioterapeut til Hjælpemiddelafdelingen 37 timer/uge (Barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Sagsbehandler med blik for hele mennesket til Hjælpemiddelafdelingen

Tryg i lovgivningen – modig i mødet.

Vores kollega skal på barsel og derfor søger vi en barselsvikar.

Du er tryg i lovgivningen, og du har evnen til at se hele mennesket og skabe muligheder i fællesskab.

I Hjælpemiddelafdelingen i Kolding Kommune arbejder vi med en helhedsorienteret tilgang og skaber meningsfulde forløb sammen med borgerne. Vores vision 'Selvværd og Sammenhæng' er vores fælles kompas: Vi stiller spørgsmål, før vi giver svar – og vi skaber løsninger sammen med borgeren.

Om stillingen

Stillingen har fokus på hjælpemidler og boligændringer

Som en del af vores afdeling får du ansvar for hele processen omkring ansøgning, afgørelser og opfølgning – altid i tæt dialog med borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere. Vi arbejder systemisk, nysgerrigt og helhedsorienteret. Hos os er du ikke bare sagsbehandler – du er med til at udvikle løsninger, der giver mening for borgerne.

Vi er ca. 30 medarbejdere med en faglig leder og en afdelingschef.
 

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • er uddannet ergoterapeut eller fysioterapeut

  • har solid erfaring med sagsbehandling og et stærkt fagligt fundament

  • tør udfordre vaner og finde nye løsninger sammen med borgeren

  • kan balancere relation og faglighed, og bringer professionel empati ind i dit arbejde

  • trives med både korte og lange sagsforløb og kan navigere i kompleksitet

  • arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt – og samtidig bidrager til fællesskabet

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • en arbejdsplads, hvor du kan udvikle og styrke gode forløb med borgerne

  • en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor du er med til at forme både løsninger og arbejdskultur

  • at du bliver en del af et stærkt Myndighedsteam på hjælpemiddelområdet, med et fagligt miljø hvor sparring, læring og udvikling prioriteres

  • en ledelse, der tror på tillid, tydelighed og åben dialog

  • fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar i et barselsvikariat på 37 timer

Om Kolding Kommune

Hjælpemiddelafdelingen er organiseret i Senior-, Sundheds- og Fritidsforvaltningen, hvor vi arbejder ud fra en fælles tilgang 'Selvværd og Sammenhæng'. Derfor skal du også være i stand til at se dig selv indarbejde elementerne fra 'Selvværd og Sammenhæng' naturligt i dine arbejdsgange.

Vi ser borgeren som et helt menneske. Derfor stiller vi spørgsmål, frem for at give svar – og vi finder de gode løsninger sammen med borgeren. Og fordi vi bruger vores faglighed og samarbejder på tværs, kan vi skabe de bedste rammer for borgerens liv.

Find mere information om levereglerne og en hel masse mere om Selvværd og Sammenhæng på vores hjemmeside www.selvvaerdogsammenhaeng.dk.
 

Interesseret?

For at høre mere om stillingen er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os.

Afdelingschef Bettina Mumm på telefon 51 29 96 79 eller via mail befi@kolding.dk

Faglig leder Linda Luxhøi på telefon 40 38 90 53 eller via mail lilux@kolding.dk
 

Løn:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne om lokal løndannelse.
 

Arbejdssted: Hjælpemiddelafdelingen Ålegården 2-4, 6000 Kolding.  

Arbejdstid: 37 timer ugentligt

Ansættelsesvilkår: Barselsvikariat pr. 1. november 2026

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 17. september 2026

Der udsendes indkaldelse til samtaler d. 17. september 2026

Samtaler afholdes d. 24. september 2026
 

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk via knappen ”Søg stilling” under stillingsannoncen. Vedhæft venligst dokumentation for uddannelse.
 

Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.

Alle stillinger er fuldtidsstillinger medmindre andet er angivet. Kolding Kommune opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen. Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.  

Overvejer du at flytte til Kolding Kommune? Læs mere om mulighederne for at bo og leve i Kolding Kommune på www.komtilkolding.dk
